A new collapsible sidebar in AI mode shows your most recent searches.

Google is doubling down on Gemini AI in its desktop search, despite protestations from users and employees alike. The latest feature is a collapsible sidebar in AI mode that shows your most recent searches, in case you want to jump back to a previous query. "In testing, this sidebar made a big difference for making progress and continuing to explore the web," wrote VP of search Robby Stein on X .

The new sidebar is only available in Google Search's AI mode. Clicking anywhere on the left of the AI search window opens up the sidebar, showing all recent searches, both AI and organic. Then, selecting any of the sidebar descriptions opens up an AI mode search window on the subject. You can close the AI search sidebar at any time by clicking on the "close sidebar" icon at the top right.

sourceContent.headline: This 16-Year-Old Founded an AI Missile Startup. He’s Targeting ‘Cost per Kill’
sourceContent.description: Henrijs Dandzbergs dropped out of high school to join startup accelerator Y Combinator. With a new breed of missile, he wants to make killing as efficient as possible for the US and its military allies.
paragraphs: The prize included $10,000 in cash, a plane ticket to San Francisco, and free legal assistance with O-1 visa applications to stay in the US.
McKenzie-Wilson, the Unicorn Mafia director, launched a drone startup in his early twenties.
His startup’s guiding ambition, according to its investor one-pager, is to bring down the “cost per kill.”
At 16 years old, Henrijs Dandzbergs is too young to vote. Or drink. Or smoke. Or drive unsupervised. But he’s not too young to win half a million dollars for his AI-guided- missile startup.

In September, Dandzbergs, who was born in Latvia, was admitted to Y Combinator’s fall 2026 cohort. The startup accelerator counts companies like Airbnb, Stripe, DoorDash, and Reddit among its alumni; Dandzbergs is likely the youngest solo founder in its vaunted history.

His startup, Polemos Industries, is attempting to develop a new class of precision-guided missile that can be easily and cheaply manufactured, can be fired from portable launchers, and can resist jamming attempts. “I think missiles are the coolest thing,” Dandzbergs tells WIRED. “A lot of people that have found success in engineering early on have had a passion for blowing stuff up.”

sourceContent.description: Companies will soon be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent from Nous Research directly inside Microsoft Teams.
paragraphs: A new feature called "Collective Wisdom" lets employees share these skills with their team after review.
Hermes automatically turns successful workflows into reusable skills made up of a description and code.
Companies will soon be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent from Nous Research directly inside Microsoft Teams.

Companies will soon be able to run the open-source Hermes Agent from Nous Research directly inside Microsoft Teams. According to Nous Research , employees can hand off tasks like financial analysis, document drafting, or inbox sorting to Hermes and review the results in the same chat. The desktop app is also available in the Microsoft Store . The agents run in Azure Container Apps Sandboxes, meaning isolated microVMs.

Hermes automatically turns successful workflows into reusable skills made up of a description and code. A new feature called "Collective Wisdom" lets employees share these skills with their team after review. The collected knowledge stays within the company and doesn't feed into any AI provider's training data.

Nous Research is part of the portfolio at M12, Microsoft's venture capital fund. According to Nous, Hermes Agent is the most widely used open agent on OpenRouter, processing nearly two trillion tokens per day. For local agents on Windows PCs, Microsoft has been backing the competing open-source agent OpenClaw since earlier this year. Nous positions itself as a key US open-source institution to counter China's AI efforts and recently fine-tuned a version of Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on "Western values" with Arete-27B . Ad Ad

articles.title: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider, so you can connect the open source coding agent to models like Kimi K3.1 Pro using your standard AWS credential chain (named profiles or SSO) instead of a separate API key. This post shows how to configure the provider and send your first request.
articles.titleEn: Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Replace ${AWS_REGION} with your source Region (for example, us-west-2 for US West Oregon) and ${AWS_ACCOUNT_ID} with your 12-digit AWS account ID: The foundation-model ARN without a Region or account ID is intentional and required for global cross-Region routing.
You don’t need to place any AWS access key or manually generated Amazon Bedrock key in the Kimi Code config.toml .
If you set KIMI_CODE_HOME , use $KIMI_CODE_HOME/config.toml instead.

You don’t need to place any AWS access key or manually generated Amazon Bedrock key in the Kimi Code config.toml .

articles.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: This second installment reviews 13 more Amazon SageMaker AI inference launches from 2026, spanning configuration recommendations, fitting more models onto each GPU, serving models too large for one instance, cross-Region routing, and post-launch tuning, bringing the year's total to 26.
articles.titleEn: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Teams want to know which configuration the model should run on now that traffic is real, how to fit more models onto GPUs they already pay for, what to do when the next model is too large for one machine, why requests wait in one Region while GPUs sit idle in another, and why latency rose when nobody changed anything.
Inference recommendations launched in April as an API.
In the spring, they launched a customer support assistant on a 70B-parameter model behind a single SageMaker AI endpoint, using the launches from part 1.

articles.title: How personal agents will change customer experience
articles.descEn: Personal agents are becoming a new way for customers to interact with businesses. Here’s what that shift means for customer experience, trust, and brand control.
articles.titleEn: How personal agents will change customer experience
summaryLinesEn: Learn why your own agent is your digital front door, and how to serve customers directly through the personal agents acting for them Meta reported that more than 10 million people in the US and Canada set up Muse in its first six weeks.

Our new whitepaper, Personal agents and the enterprise , explores how personal agents could change demand and competition, how companies can serve customers directly and through their agents, and how to turn deeper engagement into lasting value.
Personal agents have been in consumers’ hands for only a few months, and adoption is increasing fast.

개인 에이전트가 소비자의 손에 들어온 지 불과 몇 달밖에 되지 않았으며 채택률이 빠르게 증가하고 있음

articles.title: Anthropic IPO will create thousands of multimillionaire employees
articles.descEn: The average Anthropic employee could be worth over $40 million after the company's IPO today, according to SEC filings and investors.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic IPO will create thousands of multimillionaire employees
summaryLinesEn: If the stock trades at $83 a share, the combined wealth of Anthropic employees will be around $232 billion, based on their share count in the filings.
Yet because many of the employees are later hires, earlier employees could have supersized gains since they've accumulated more stock.
According to SEC filings, the artificial intelligence company has generated 1.77 billion options for employees, with a strike price of $2.91 a share.

articles.title: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
articles.descEn: OpenAI's internal use of coding agents is growing fast, with theoretical token costs now exceeding researchers' base salaries. Even though teams are reluctant to work without these tools, the models still produce a lot of "AI slop" beyond routine tasks.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI's own researchers now say they value their AI tools more than nearly half their colleagues
summaryLinesEn: In an internal, non-representative survey of 101 employees, researchers said at the median that they would rather give up 40 percent of their team's staff or 30 percent of their compute capacity than go three months without current coding agents.
Among the top 10 percent of users, that theoretical value doubled to $23,000 per day.

High success rates on routine tasks, weaknesses in code scaffolding Between March and October, the estimated success rate of autonomous agents working without human intervention on two- to four-hour tasks rose from 23 to 46 percent, according to OpenAI.

articles.title: Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—Itself
articles.descEn: Investors betting a barnstorming $107 billion will weigh whether the company’s AI safety strategy and growing public anger towards data centers could impact its growth.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—Itself
summaryLinesEn: After closing the largest initial public offering in history on Wednesday, Anthropic has about $200 billion in the bank, more than every tech giant besides Alphabet.
For some time, OpenAI was expected to go public first, but executive departures , shifting priorities , and legal troubles have introduced roadblocks.
Because of how Anthropic must account for compensating employees with stock, it’s still wildly unprofitable—over $104 billion in losses this year through September.

articles.title: Employees call out Google over AI Search in schools - Engadget
articles.descEn: The Alphabet Workers Union voiced concern over Google requiring its AI tools be bundled with Search.
articles.titleEn: Employees call out Google over AI Search in schools - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The claim seems to dismiss Google's decades of operation before it even launched Gemini and other public-facing AI tools.
Earlier this month, Google set out a policy that would essentially require schools to have some AI features enabled in order for their students to use the company's Search tools.
"Cutting off access to Search for schools that don't wish to use AI will not help persuade our users, and will more likely result in them shutting out Google products altogether."

articles.title: Small businesses use social media and AI | About Verizon
articles.descEn: A new Verizon Business survey reveals small business owners rely on social media and AI tools to drive holiday sales and streamline operations.
articles.titleEn: Small businesses use social media and AI | About Verizon
summaryLinesEn: BASKING RIDGE, N.J. —As small businesses gear up for the demanding holiday season, a new survey from Verizon Business reveals that owners are turning to their own social media savvy and AI to drive sales and manage operations.

Rather than relying on Black Friday, Cyber Monday or other major retail tentpole moments, small business owners are prioritizing direct customer engagement and digital storefronts to capture holiday demand.

To explore solutions and resources designed to help small businesses manage peak demand, streamline operations, and secure their connections, visit: Verizon’s Small Business Solutions About the survey Verizon Business surveyed 600 U.S. small business owners and decision-makers at businesses with 1 – 500 employees, including an oversample of 100 Hispanic/Latino respondents.

localization.title: 중소기업은 소셜 미디어와 AI를 사용합니다 | 버라이존 소개
summaryLines: BASKING RIDGE, N.J · — 소기업들이 까다로운 휴가 시즌을 준비하면서 Verizon Business의 새로운 설문조사에 따르면 소유주들이 판매를 촉진하고 운영을 관리하기 위해 소셜 미디어에 능숙하고 AI를 활용하고 있는 것으로 나타남
블랙 프라이데이, 사이버 먼데이 또는 기타 소매업의 주요 순간에 의존하는 대신 중소기업 소유자는 휴일 수요를 포착하기 위해 직접적인 고객 참여 및 디지털 매장에 우선순위를 두고 있음

중소기업이 최대 수요를 관리하고, 운영을 간소화하고, 연결을 보호하는 데 도움이 되도록 고안된 솔루션과 리소스를 살펴보려면 다음을 방문하십시오 · Verizon의 중소기업 솔루션 설문 조사 정보 Verizon Business는 100명의 히스패닉/라틴계 응답자를 포함하여 600명의 미국 중소기업 소유주와 직원 수 1~500명 규모 기업의 의사 결정자를 대상으로 설문조사를 실시함

articles.title: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
articles.descEn: In some of these instances, employees said Muse surfaced messages about childcare requests they never made, career advice they never asked for, product orders they never placed, and bank account balances that didn't belong to them.
articles.titleEn: Meta’s AI agent Muse is mixing up conversations and exposing private data, report says
summaryLinesEn: Meta employees have raised concerns that the company’s AI agent Muse has been mixing up conversations across different accounts and exposing private user data, according to a new Reuters report that looked at internal company posts.
Launched in September, Muse is one of the fastest-growing apps on record, with more than 10 million downloads.
Provides movers and shakers with the info they need to start their day.

articles.title: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
articles.descEn: Google DeepMind has released Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth model in seven weeks, which is nearly 2x faster than its sibling Carbon, outperforms it on most benchmarks and comes in at a significantly lower price.
articles.titleEn: Google's latest AI model is faster, cheaper and smarter than its flagship predecessor from just weeks ago
summaryLinesEn: Ad According to Artificial Analysis, per-task costs for Neon at xhigh come in at $6.44, roughly 17 percent below Carbon's undiscounted figure of $7.76.

Ad The Cost Advantage Comes from List Price, Not Token Efficiency Through Google AI Studio and Gemini for Business , one million input tokens costs three dollars (or $0.15 when cached) and one million output tokens costs fifteen dollars.
In Google's own evaluations, Neon also leads individual categories on the Vals Index , Zapier's AutomationBench (56.3 percent) and science tests such as RiemannBench (84.0 percent).

summaryLinesEn: The company is currently fulfilling Indiegogo orders, where rings were priced at $139, but says its retail price will be $199 when it launches.

Another option is Aina's far fancier ring , which was announced at the start of November and will ship early next year for $399.

articles.title: Canva will let users switch off most generative AI - Engadget
articles.descEn: Canva is rolling out new settings to purge most generative AI from its app.
articles.titleEn: Canva will let users switch off most generative AI - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The library setting can be reached by navigating to "Your Account" and then the AI personalization section.
That's because those options don't leverage generative AI, only the content of an existing image, and using those features doesn't add the AI tag to the resulting image's metadata.
For managing the platform-wide AI tools, it's under the "permissions" section of the settings menu, with the text "Enable generative AI features."

articles.titleEn: Superhuman unveils personal AI assistant and expands Go across entire suite - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: “Superhuman is solving for the last mile of AI: the gap between deployment and adoption,” said Chief Executive Shishir Mehrotra.

Anthropic PBC also recently launched Claude Duet , a similar proactive AI agent for professionals and small businesses in private preview, that completes tasks when asked and keeps working in the background.
The company said the new Go assistant acts like an extra set of eyes and ears, watching out for users throughout their day, finding tasks they need to do, and keeping up with their “need to know.”

articles.title: AI infrastructure economics favor Vultr's global footprint - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: AI infrastructure economics now reward proven ROI, and Vultr's Kevin Cochrane says global reach and sovereignty rules shape cloud decisions.
articles.titleEn: AI infrastructure economics favor Vultr's global footprint - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Sovereignty is the AI story everyone mentions and few have planned for ahead of 2027 AI infrastructure economics are entering a more sober phase as enterprises move past standing up AI factories and start asking how to run them profitably.
That shift rewards cloud providers with an operating track record rather than a single speculative wager.
Enterprises are now making a flight to quality toward stable, cost-efficient platforms, according to Kevin Cochrane (pictured), chief marketing officer of Vultr.

articles.title: HPC meets AI agents as Google Cloud targets time to discovery - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: HPC is merging with AI, and Google Cloud agents can tie scarce compute together to cut time to discovery for researchers at SC26 in Chicago.
articles.titleEn: HPC meets AI agents as Google Cloud targets time to discovery - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: “What we’re seeing, for example, with computer-aided engineering, is that you can actually identify ahead of time which are non-essential parameters and you don’t run the simulation, thereby reducing the total simulation time,” she said.
The metric that matters is shifting from peak performance to time to discovery.

Researchers need more compute than any single site can provide, and cloud providers are now pitching AI agents as the layer that ties scattered resources together, according to Annie Ma-Weaver (pictured, left), head of high-performance computing product at Google Cloud, a unit of Google LLC.

articles.titleEn: Google's latest midtier model Gemini 4 Neon is three times faster than Carbon and wins on some metrics - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Everpure beats expectations as AI accelerates revenue growth for ninth straight quarter Six days, six outages: Why reliability isn't resilience Google Cloud brings AI agents to the supercomputing bottleneck Google upgrades Gemini’s agentic Task mode with new model, e-commerce features Anthropic's record-breaking IPO priced at $83 per share, higher than expected Fintech startup Payhawk valued at $2B in $280M round CLOUD - BY MARIA DEUTSCHER .
Surprisingly, though Carbon is positioned as the company’s strongest model, Neon’s performance surpassed it on some tasks, according to benchmarks the company published today.
Google said it’s priced at a cost of $3 per million input tokens, 15 cents per million cached input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.

articles.descEn: Enterprise AI infrastructure is evolving beyond GPUs as agentic workloads drive demand for CPUs, secure execution, data sovereignty and cloud platforms.
articles.titleEn: Enterprise AI infrastructure moves beyond GPUs - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: Enterprise AI is pushing cloud infrastructure beyond the GPU Enterprise adoption of artificial intelligence is creating new requirements for enterprise AI infrastructure.
That shift is creating an opportunity for neocloud providers, but it is also changing what enterprises expect from them.
Infrastructure providers increasingly need to support the full application lifecycle rather than simply supply specialized hardware.

articles.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
articles.descEn: Google's latest update to Gemini brings an AI agent to the Mac that can organize files, fill out forms, and tackle multistep workflows.
articles.titleEn: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
summaryLinesEn: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella explains why he asked 60K employees to quit Julie Bort Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO Julie Bort FBI says Artex AI open source hacking tool used to breach networks in ‘under three hours’ Zack Whittaker Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang Anthony Ha Jensen Huang didn’t show confidence in his successor, report says Ivan Mehta

Google also only recently began admitting early testers to try its revamped “CC” AI agent, announced in September , which is designed to help families stay organized across email, calendars, chats, and tasks.
The feature is initially available in English in the U.S. and requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription.

summaryLines: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella는 6만 명의 직원에게 Julie Bort를 그만두라고 요청한 이유를 설명함 · Amazon과 Google은 IPO 후 Anthropic의 거의 30%를 소유하게 될 것임 · Julie Bort FBI는 Artex AI 오픈 소스 해킹 도구가 '3시간 이내에' 네트워크를 침해하는 데 사용되었다고 밝힘 · Zack Whittaker Elon Musk와 다른 기술 임원들은 Nvidia에 Jensen Huang을 복직시킬 것을 요구하는 청원서에 서명함 · Anthony Ha Jensen Huang은 그의 후임자에 대한 신뢰를 보이지 않았다고 보고서에 따르면 Ivan Mehta는 말함
또한 Google은 9월에 발표된 개선된 "CC" AI 에이전트를 사용해 볼 수 있는 초기 테스터를 최근에야 인정하기 시작함 · 이 에이전트는 가족이 이메일, 캘린더, 채팅 및 작업을 체계적으로 정리할 수 있도록 설계됨

articles.title: When tech workers have to quit their jobs to raise the alarm, it’s time to worry | Isabelle Ferreras
articles.descEn: We have no hope of making AI safe for humanity if tech bosses are allowed to run their companies like autocracies, says sociologist Isabelle Ferreras
articles.titleEn: When tech workers have to quit their jobs to raise the alarm, it’s time to worry | Isabelle Ferreras
summaryLinesEn: Remember what happened at Meta over the summer: Mark Zuckerberg’s firm faced a backlash from employees after Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp introduced a tool that tracked staff keystrokes, mouse clicks and content displayed on computer screens to collect data for training its AI models.
Tech workers also need a collective standing over corporate strategy, independent channels to report safety breaches and formal representation inside frontier labs before models are deployed.

Last month, the person who oversaw safety reports for OpenAI’s product releases said he was quitting the ChatGPT creator because the company’s culture was “broken” and the entire AI industry was too careless in developing the technology.

summaryLines: 여름 동안 Meta에서 무슨 일이 일어났는지 기억해 보십시오 · Mark Zuckerberg의 회사는 Facebook, Instagram 및 WhatsApp이 AI 모델 훈련을 위한 데이터를 수집하기 위해 직원의 키 입력, 마우스 클릭 및 컴퓨터 화면에 표시되는 콘텐츠를 추적하는 도구를 도입한 후 직원들의 반발에 직면함
또한 기술 인력은 기업 전략에 대한 집단적 입장, 안전 위반을 보고할 수 있는 독립적인 채널, 모델을 배포하기 전에 프런티어 연구소 내부의 공식 대표가 필요함
지난 달 OpenAI의 제품 출시에 대한 안전 보고서를 감독한 사람은 회사의 문화가 "깨졌고" 전체 AI 산업이 기술 개발에 너무 부주의했기 때문에 ChatGPT 제작자를 그만두겠다고 말함

articles.descEn: Even if you’ve never used an AI tool, Verizon AI Skills for America makes it easy to learn skills you can put to use right away at your current job or in your hunt for a new one.

summaryLinesEn: AI training like this can be expensive, costing more than $700 a year.
Start, pause or pick back up whenever it works, around a job, a class or a shift.
As the biggest shift in how we work in a generation happens now, this AI training can help you get more done and build skills you can put to work.

articles.title: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
articles.descEn: The company’s alternate-universe internet serves as a massive sandbox that allows the Chrome team to properly train AI browsing agents—without the risk of them going rogue.
articles.titleEn: Google Built a Giant ‘Mirror Dimension’ Internet to Test Its Chrome AI Agents
summaryLinesEn: To construct it, the Chrome team gathered armies of website and web app development agents guided by a purpose-built AI harness to quickly create realistic web services and data flows—down to details like entering promo codes on a shopping site or populating social media pages.
As the Google Chrome team has worked to develop AI browsing features using the company's Gemini models , they realized they need to go the extra mile to keep things from going haywire.
“Web-use” agents need to be familiar with the open internet, how to navigate real websites and platforms, and how to be hardened against web attacks.

summaryLines: 이를 구축하기 위해 Chrome 팀은 쇼핑 사이트에 프로모션 코드를 입력하거나 소셜 미디어 페이지를 채우는 것과 같은 세부 사항에 이르기까지 현실적인 웹 서비스와 데이터 흐름을 신속하게 생성하기 위해 특수 제작된 AI 하네스의 안내에 따라 웹사이트 및 웹 앱 개발 에이전트 군대를 모았음
Google Chrome 팀은 회사의 Gemini 모델을 사용하여 AI 탐색 기능을 개발하면서 문제가 발생하지 않도록 하려면 추가 노력이 필요하다는 것을 깨달았음
"웹 사용" 에이전트는 개방형 인터넷, 실제 웹사이트와 플랫폼을 탐색하는 방법, 웹 공격에 대비하는 방법에 익숙해야 함

articles.title: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
articles.descEn: Token prices for AI models fell 21 percent in six weeks while usage volume hit a record high, according to the Ramp AI Index. Anthropic dominates with nearly 59 percent of token spending. Data from Ramp, Stripe and OpenRouter independently show the same pattern: the AI industry is still growing, but revenue momentum is cooling.
articles.titleEn: AI industry growth remains strong, but the pace is slowing
summaryLinesEn: The average price per million tokens for OpenAI and Anthropic combined fell to $0.45, according to Ramp, down 11.2 percent from the prior month.
In the week ending November 15, 2026, Anthropic accounted for 58.7 percent of all token spending, according to the Ramp AI Index , up 1.7 percentage points from the prior month.

In October 2026 , 56.8 percent of all tracked US companies paid for AI products or services, according to Ramp, up one percentage point from September and 13.3 percentage points more than a year earlier.

articles.titleEn: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
summaryLinesEn: The company brought its AI Mode button to its search bar last year, which opens up a chatbot-like search experience within Google.

articles.title: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
articles.descEn: Are the recent outages in the airline booking systems, banking platforms, and productivity platforms really a coincidence? There's actually likely something deeper going on, cybersecurity experts say.
articles.titleEn: These tech outages are giving Y2K, AI agent style
summaryLinesEn: “It’s not rapid adoption of AI yet causing these outages,” she said.

In less technical terms, she said the outage may have been caused (and preliminary findings point to this) when the FAA was trying to modernize its telecommunications infrastructure and the transition overwhelmed parts of its legacy hardware, where the new tech likely operated at a normal modern capacity while the legacy hardware couldn’t keep up.
Organizations need a more steadfast approach to AI adoption, including more testing and prioritizing what needs to be fixed and when, DeWalt said.

summaryLines: “AI가 빠르게 채택되지 않아 이러한 중단이 발생하고 있음” · 라고 그녀는 말함
덜 기술적인 용어로 그녀는 FAA가 통신 인프라를 현대화하려고 시도하고 전환으로 인해 레거시 하드웨어가 따라잡을 수 없는 동안 새로운 기술이 정상적인 최신 용량으로 작동할 가능성이 있는 레거시 하드웨어의 일부를 압도했을 때 정전이 발생했을 수 있다고 말했습니다(그리고 예비 조사 결과는 이를 지적합니다)
조직은 더 많은 테스트를 수행하고 수정해야 할 사항과 시기의 우선순위를 지정하는 등 AI 채택에 대한 보다 확고한 접근 방식이 필요하다고 DeWalt는 말함

articles.title: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
articles.descEn: Stripe Treasury now lets agents transfer funds, convert currencies, and pay vendors within limits you set. Give agents the access they need to help run your business, with customizable controls and human approvals.
articles.titleEn: Give your agents controlled access to analyze your data and move funds
summaryLinesEn: A payables agent could monitor balances across accounts, transfer funds to keep bill pay accounts topped up, and prepare vendor payments.
Now, we’re adding write access and customizable controls that enable agents to move money on Stripe.

More than 24,000 businesses already use Stripe Treasury for agents , giving agents read access to financial data to work on those tasks, including reviewing transactions, building cash flow models, and reconciling payments.

articles.title: Improving Developer Experience in the Age of Agents | Weaviate
articles.descEn: Coding agents may be changing how developers work - what does that mean for developer experience? Here's how we are starting to think about both.
articles.titleEn: Improving Developer Experience in the Age of Agents | Weaviate
summaryLinesEn: We set up several agents to run the same task in a repeatable way, and explored their logs and outputs.
Developers still need to understand the problem, give agents good instructions, set up the right environment, and verify the result.

That means a good experience needs to serve both the developer and the agent working between the developer and the product: For developers, that means helping them make sound architectural decisions, communicate their intent to agents, and verify outcomes.
articles.summary:
We set up several agents to run the same task in a repeatable way, and explored their logs and outputs.

articles.title: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization now supports Full Fine-Tuning (FFT). This post explores when FFT outperforms LoRA across key benchmarks, examines the spectral properties of model weight matrices behind the quality gap, shares practical hyperparameter tuning guidelines, and shows how to get started.
articles.titleEn: Full Fine-Tuning (FFT) on SageMaker AI Serverless Model Customization | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Serverless Model Customization on SageMaker AI lets data scientists and machine learning (ML) engineers focus on model fine-tuning without managing infrastructure or GPU capacity planning.

Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) have emerged as a practical solution for fine-tuning LLMs to downstream tasks, reducing GPU capacity requirements by updating only a small subset of LLM parameters.
Figure 4: Serverless model customization job with training metrics tracked in MLflow Switching from Full Fine-Tuning to LoRA requires only one change: set TrainingType.FULL to TrainingType.LORA .

localization.title: SageMaker AI 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의에 대한 전체 미세 조정(FFT) | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: SageMaker AI의 서버리스 모델 사용자 지정을 통해 데이터 과학자와 기계 학습(ML) 엔지니어는 인프라 또는 GPU 용량 계획을 관리하지 않고도 모델 미세 조정에 집중할 수 있음
LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)와 같은 매개변수 효율적인 미세 조정(PEFT) 방법은 LLM 매개변수의 작은 하위 집합만 업데이트하여 GPU 용량 요구 사항을 줄이는 다운스트림 작업에 대한 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 실용적인 솔루션으로 등장함
그림 4: MLflow에서 훈련 지표를 추적하는 서버리스 모델 사용자 정의 작업 전체 미세 조정에서 LoRA로 전환하려면 TrainingType.FULL을 TrainingType.LORA로 설정하는 한 가지 변경만 필요함

sourceContent.headline: From "Lungs Sound Clear" to a Complete Exam | Abridge — Abridge
sourceContent.description: Casey Hribar, MD shows how Abridge turns what you say in the room into a structured, accurate physical exam, and how to set it up the way you practice.
paragraphs: Before your next clinic day, open Abridge on web or desktop and go to your preferences and settings to set up your exam the way you’d like it.
My note needs an exam that keeps right and left straight, explains the findings that support the diagnosis, and includes normal observations from what I examined without claiming anything I didn’t.
The exam needs to be in a specific structure that is rarely narrative in nature.

A two-year-old comes in holding the side of her head. I look in both ears, check her throat, feel her neck, and listen to her chest. Out loud, I say just a few things to her parents: “Her eardrum is red and bulging, but the other side looks good. Her throat looks fine. Lungs sound clear.”

Those few spoken sentences are only part of what belongs in my note. My note needs an exam that keeps right and left straight, explains the findings that support the diagnosis, and includes normal observations from what I examined without claiming anything I didn’t.

Anyone reading “lungs clear to auscultation bilaterally” should be able to trust that someone listened. Those findings also help the next clinician understand what I assessed and give a coder, auditor, or payer the evidence behind the diagnoses I code. The exam needs to be in a specific structure that is rarely narrative in nature. And, it needs to have a lot of jargon I wouldn’t say to a two-year-old and her parents.

articles.title: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
articles.descEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report reveal the benefits and challenges of implementing AI.
articles.titleEn: Key findings from our 2025 enterprise AI adoption report
summaryLinesEn: For our 2025 report, Generative AI adoption in the enterprise, we surveyed a diverse group of 1,600 knowledge workers actively using AI in the workplace — including 800 C-suite executives and 800 employees across the US.

Despite clear benefits, enterprise leaders report division and power struggles from AI adoption While executives are highly optimistic about the future business impact of AI, 42% say the process of adopting generative AI is tearing their company apart.
Enterprises without a formal AI strategy report only 37% success in AI adoption, compared to 80% for those with a strategy.

articles.title: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
articles.descEn: Discover HFS Research’s new framework for trusted, enterprise-grade LLMs and learn how WRITER’s agent supervision suite and Palmyra X5 model help CIOs govern and scale agentic AI safely across the business.
articles.titleEn: From chaos to control: why enterprises need a new framework for trusted LLMs
summaryLinesEn: Today, 75% of knowledge workers use GenAI at work, but only about a third of organizations have formal AI governance in place For CIOs, this creates a familiar and uncomfortable reality: AI enthusiasm is accelerating faster than enterprise readiness.

Our newly introduced agent supervision suite delivers the governance foundation the report calls for — providing centralized visibility into usage and cost, global guardrails for sensitive data, runtime permissions and approvals, and deep integrations with your existing observability and security platforms.
And they need a model where IT can maintain oversight even as business teams accelerate adoption.

A workload migration becomes a review-and-approve step rather than a research project.

articles.title: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how to run two memory-bounded Kubernetes Pods on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU using open-source NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS. This walkthrough builds a custom Amazon Linux 2023 image, installs KAI Scheduler and the GPU Fractioning Operator, and validates per-Pod GPU-memory contracts with enforcement and metrics.
articles.titleEn: Using NVIDIA Run:ai GPU Fractioning on Amazon EKS | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Two Pods each requesting nvidia.com/gpu: 1 cannot run concurrently on that node, even when their combined GPU-memory demand fits.
Its GPU Fractioning Operator can help several teams share one or two GPUs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) .
We validated this walkthrough on October 22, 2026, using NVIDIA driver 615.71.10.
articles.summary:

articles.title: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now offers enhanced observability to help you diagnose GPU training issues faster. It brings together diagnostic and profiling capabilities for training workloads on both Amazon EKS and Slurm orchestrators, pinpointing issues across GPU, network, and host layers.
articles.titleEn: Introducing enhanced infrastructure observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Enhanced observability collects telemetry at two levels: Default metrics (enabled automatically) cover cluster health, CPU/disk/OS-level usage, GPU utilization and temperature, and per-job resource utilization.
Today, we are announcing enhanced observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, a new capability that helps you diagnose GPU training issues faster.
Figure 1: Creating a HyperPod cluster on Amazon EKS with Custom setup In the Custom setup workflow, expand the HyperPod observability section: Enable HyperPod Observability is checked by default.

Today, we are announcing enhanced observability in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, a new capability that helps you diagnose GPU training issues faster.

Figure 1: Creating a HyperPod cluster on Amazon EKS with Custom setup In the Custom setup workflow, expand the HyperPod observability section: Enable HyperPod Observability is checked by default.

articles.title: Small businesses, big results: How teams scale with AI
articles.descEn: See how small businesses scale using Google Workspace with Gemini to automate tasks and boost revenue. Get the details on these AI-driven results.
articles.titleEn: Small businesses, big results: How teams scale with AI
summaryLinesEn: Behind almost every small business is a small team wearing every hat at once: running sales, marketing, and logistics on the shop floor — or on the go.
In 2025, when Elan Halpern’s homemade yogurt experiments outgrew her kitchen, she and her co-founder, Kiki Couchman, launched their probiotic Greek yogurt brand, Sourmilk .
With a little help from Gemini, the duo has been able to operate like a 10-person team and scale into more than 100 grocery stores within the brand’s first year.

articles.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1, a reasoning model built for real-time complex dialog, is available today on AWS Marketplace and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. Discover it, evaluate it on your own data, and deploy it to a secure SageMaker endpoint in your own AWS account.
articles.titleEn: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Dialog-RSN-1 shows up in the SageMaker JumpStart catalog with overview and sample notebooks in one place, so your team can understand the model before spending a dollar on infrastructure.
Because the model reasons directly over the caller’s audio, it picks up tone, hesitation, and timing, the signals a plain transcript loses, and decides for itself the right moment to respond.
From the same model card you choose Deploy, and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart stands up a real-time inference endpoint with a pre-configured serving stack.

articles.title: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
articles.descEn: Sierra today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation. The award was presented to Bret Taylor, Co-founder and CEO of Sierra, at J.P. Morgan’s 18th annual Technology Innovation Symposium.
articles.titleEn: Sierra inducted into JPMorganChase Hall of Innovation
summaryLinesEn: Established in 2011, the Hall of Innovation recognises privately held technology companies that have made a significant impact at JPMorganChase through their innovation, business value, and close collaboration with the firm’s teams.
Sierra, the leading customer experience AI platform, today announced its induction into JPMorganChase’s Hall of Innovation.

“Agentic AI has the potential to create simpler, more intuitive experiences for customers, but realising that potential requires getting trust, security and controls right from the start,” said Gill Haus, Chief Information Officer of Chase.

localization.title: Sierra는 JPMorganChase 혁신의 전당에 입성함
summaryLines: 2011년에 설립된 혁신의 전당(Hall of Innovation)은 혁신, 비즈니스 가치 및 회사 팀과의 긴밀한 협력을 통해 JPMorganChase에 중대한 영향을 미친 비상장 기술 기업을 표창함
최고의 고객 경험 AI 플랫폼인 Sierra는 오늘 JPMorganChase의 혁신 전당에 입성한다고 발표함
Chase의 최고 정보 책임자(CIO)인 Gill Haus는 “Agentic AI는 고객을 위해 더 간단하고 직관적인 경험을 제공할 수 있는 잠재력을 갖고 있지만, 그 잠재력을 실현하려면 처음부터 신뢰, 보안 및 통제력을 확보해야 함” · 라고 말함

articles.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
articles.descEn: Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API lets agents access hundreds of tools while reducing input tokens. Load schemas on demand. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
summaryLinesEn: Load tool parameter schemas on demand instead of sending your full tool library in every prompt,designed to reduce input tokens and keep tool selection accurate as your agent scales.
Tool Retrieval works with Gemini 3.6 and later models to support your complex agent tasks.
We are launching Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API to help your agents manage large tool libraries more efficiently.

articles.title: How partners use Genie's free tier on Azure Databricks | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Every Azure Databricks user gets $10 of free Genie usage a month. See how partners use Genie budgets to roll out AI to every user with predictable costs.
articles.titleEn: How partners use Genie's free tier on Azure Databricks | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Every Azure Databricks user gets $10 of free Genie usage a month, and Genie budgets let admins control any spend beyond it.
Genie is built to meet that bar: every user gets free monthly usage so everyone can benefit, and budget controls are ready for when usage ramps.
Some customers block consumption-based AI tools entirely, and others hold off on a trial because they worry about what happens to costs as usage grows.

articles.title: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call. Added as a gateway interceptor, Skyflow de-identifies data before any tool, model, or log sees it, and restores it for authorized callers, with no change to your agent code.
articles.titleEn: Protect agent tool calls with Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The Skyflow interceptor de-identifies data before it reaches a tool, restores it before the agent reads the result, and replaces documents with clean copies before the agent opens them.
The controls need to sit where every tool call passes, so authorization, content safety, and data protection apply the same way to every agent and tool.
In this post, we show how Skyflow and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway keep sensitive data out of the tools your AI agents call, and out of the model context those tools feed.

articles.title: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI gives your application one invocation path across the endpoints and inference components you already run, in one or more AWS Regions and AWS accounts. The router prefers its own Region and shifts new requests to another destination only when the local one can't serve reliably.
articles.titleEn: Keep inference running through regional capacity shortfalls with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Serving a model from more than one AWS Region is a well-established pattern for highly available inference: when one Region runs short of GPU capacity, requests move to another.

To use that capacity, your application must detect a struggling endpoint and switch Regions, decide which errors are safe to retry without running the model twice, move traffic back after recovery without flapping, and manage access to endpoints in other accounts.
When autoscaling can’t add instances of the type your endpoint needs, requests throttle and time out, even when the same model has spare capacity in another Region.

summaryLines: 둘 이상의 AWS 리전에서 모델을 제공하는 것은 고가용성 추론을 위한 잘 확립된 패턴임 · 한 리전의 GPU 용량이 부족하면 요청이 다른 리전으로 이동함

articles.title: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Cisco and AWS used Cisco Transformation Fest and AWS AI League to turn hands-on AI learning into a culture of building. A Cisco engineer won the 2025 AWS AI League global title and 1,200 engineers competed in 2026. This post shares Cisco's journey, lessons from the 2026 winning agent built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and how to host your own league.
articles.titleEn: From learning to leaderboard: How Cisco upskilled 1,200 engineers in agentic AI with AWS AI League | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The program is built on five tenets the team summarized as SCALE : Figure 3: 2026 Cisco AWS Transformation Fest 4.0 AWS AI League finalists Transformation Fest brings together several formats: AWS GameDays, AWS AI League, sessions where Cisco leaders share best practices and success stories with peers, and sessions on Amazon and AWS culture.

It turns hands-on AI learning into a gamified competition, where participants customize models and build agents on AWS, get instant feedback on a live leaderboard, and compete in a game-show-style finale.
In this post, we share how Cisco and AWS used Cisco Transformation Fest and AWS AI League to build a lasting culture of learning by doing.

articles.title: Optimize AI economics on Amazon Bedrock with Accenture’s sequenced approach | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: As enterprises scale AI on Amazon Bedrock, token spend can grow even as per-token prices fall. This post walks through six composable optimization levers, shows how Accenture applied them across four client engagements, and recommends a sequence for cutting AI token spend on your own workloads.
articles.titleEn: Optimize AI economics on Amazon Bedrock with Accenture’s sequenced approach | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Distilled models in Amazon Bedrock are up to 500 percent faster and up to 75 percent less expensive than original models, with less than 2 percent accuracy loss for use cases such as RAG.
Amazon Bedrock batch inference processes non-urgent workloads asynchronously as a group at 50 percent lower cost than on-demand pricing for select models (see Amazon Bedrock Pricing ).

In an AWS benchmark on 63,796 real chatbot queries, a 0.90 similarity threshold produced a 74.5 percent cache hit rate, 92.3 percent accuracy, and 72.5 percent cost savings ( see ElastiCache semantic caching benchmarks ).

In an AWS benchmark on 63,796 real chatbot queries, a 0.90 similarity threshold produced a 74.5 percent cache hit rate, 92.3 percent accuracy, and 72.5 percent cost savings ( see ElastiCache semantic caching benchmarks ).

summaryLines: Amazon Bedrock의 증류 모델은 원본 모델보다 최대 500% 더 빠르고 최대 75% 저렴하며 RAG와 같은 사용 사례의 경우 정확도 손실이 2% 미만임

summaryLinesEn: A similar share (55%) approve of Democratic congressional leaders’ policies and plans for the country, according to a new Pew Research Center survey.

summaryLines: 새로운 퓨 리서치 센터(Pew Research Center) 조사에 따르면 비슷한 비율(55%)이 민주당 의회 지도자들의 국가 정책과 계획을 지지하는 것으로 나타남
이 질문에 대한 공화당의 의견은 올해 1월 이후 바뀌었음 · 공화당원의 61%는 트럼프 대통령이 민주당 지도자들에게 맞서야 한다고 답했고, 37%는 민주당 지도자들과 협력해야 한다고 답함
트럼프 대통령이 그렇게 할 것이라고 답한 미국인(27%)보다 민주당 의원이 경제에 더 나은 접근 방식을 가질 것이라고 답한 미국인(45%)이 18포인트 차이로 더 많았음

articles.title: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.
articles.descEn: Google Quantum AI research proves contextuality powers quantum algorithms at scale. See how our processor beat classical limits. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: How we’re putting one of quantum mechanics’ deepest features to the test at scale.
summaryLinesEn: Using it, our qubits won a well-known coordination game 98.3% of the time, beating the 88.9% classical limit, and outperformed constrained classical strategies in tasks spanning up to 105 qubits.
In simple terms, contextuality means a system’s properties aren’t fixed in advance; what you measure depends on which other compatible measurements you make alongside it.

Today, in new research published on the cover of Science , Google Quantum AI demonstrated that contextuality — a quantum property scientists believe powers certain quantum algorithms — survives at scale on our quantum processor.

summaryLines: 이를 사용하여 우리의 큐비트는 잘 알려진 조정 게임에서 98.3%의 시간 동안 승리하여 88.9%의 클래식 한계를 극복했으며 최대 105큐비트에 걸친 작업에서 제한된 클래식 전략보다 성능이 뛰어났음
간단히 말해서 상황성은 시스템의 속성이 미리 고정되지 않음을 의미함 · 측정하는 내용은 이와 함께 수행하는 다른 호환 가능한 측정에 따라 달라짐
오늘 Science 표지에 발표된 새로운 연구에서 Google Quantum AI는 과학자들이 특정 양자 알고리즘을 강화한다고 믿는 양자 속성인 상황성(Contextuality)이 양자 프로세서에서 대규모로 살아남는다는 것을 보여주었음

Agents can reason through complex problems, but enterprise systems-especially in regulated industries-must remain controlled and auditable.

articles.title: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Voice cloning in Amazon Polly is now generally available. Give Amazon Polly a few minutes of recordings from a consenting speaker, and it builds a custom voice that reads new text in that speaker's voice. Cloned voices run on the Amazon Polly generative engine and support seven languages.
articles.titleEn: Amazon Polly launches voice cloning: A unique voice for your brand | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Building a cloned voice is free for Amazon Polly customers, and Amazon Polly charges for cloned voice usage on a pay-as-you-go basis, see Amazon Polly Pricing page for details.
Hannah: a real recording, then her cloned voice on a support line.
You can send up to 10 recordings per voice, and up to 15 minutes of audio in total.

articles.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
articles.descEn: NVIDIA and Microsoft expand tools for enterprises to customize AI models and deploy applications across cloud and local infrastructure.
articles.titleEn: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
summaryLinesEn: In MLPerf Inference v6.1 , Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65.
Alongside expanding customer access to NVIDIA technologies, Microsoft is using NVIDIA software and accelerated computing in its own AI development and services.

NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs.

It also adds lifecycle hooks so you can run deterministic allow or deny checks at defined points in the agent loop.

summaryLinesEn: AgentCore achieves this by connecting the harness to the services required for production agents, including session persistence, streaming responses, usage metadata, observability, AgentCore memory, Identity, Gateway, Browser, Code Interpreter, and customer-provided containers.

articles.title: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: See how curated Genie Agents and modeled knowledge in Genie Ontology raised Genie One accuracy to 95% on 125 questions, and how to apply it to your data.
articles.titleEn: Genie One Accuracy: Why Curated Agents Need Governed Context | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Across 125 questions about a fictional insurer, Genie One scored 93–95% using curated Genie Agents together with governed business context (Metric Views, Domains/Subdomains and Pages), 83% with either agents or the governed layer alone, and 64% with tables alone.
In a separate change test, updating one Metric View and its Page moved all 12 related Genie One answers to the new definition without any agent edits.

Metric Views, Domains, Subdomains, and Pages help Genie One answer definition questions that would otherwise rely on tribal knowledge, while agents are needed for questions that require answers from unstructured data such as PDFs.

localization.title: Genie One 정확성 · 선별된 에이전트에 통제된 컨텍스트가 필요한 이유 | 데이터브릭스 블로그
summaryLines: 가상의 보험사에 대한 125개 질문에서 Genie One은 관리되는 비즈니스 컨텍스트(메트릭 보기, 도메인/하위 도메인 및 페이지)와 함께 큐레이트된 Genie 에이전트를 사용하여 93~95%, 에이전트 또는 관리되는 레이어만 사용하면 83%, 테이블만 사용하면 64%를 기록함
별도의 변경 테스트에서 하나의 Metric View와 해당 페이지를 업데이트하면 에이전트 편집 없이 관련된 12개의 Genie One 답변이 모두 새 정의로 이동됨
메트릭 뷰, 도메인, 하위 도메인 및 페이지는 Genie One이 부족 지식에 의존하는 정의 질문에 답하는 데 도움이 되는 반면, PDF와 같은 구조화되지 않은 데이터의 답변이 필요한 질문에는 에이전트가 필요함

articles.title: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: For organizations hiring hundreds or thousands of people, every interview presents the same challenge: How do you give candidates a consistent opportunity to demonstrate their skills while gathering the evidence needed to make informed hiring decisions? Structured behavioral interviews offer a research-backed approach to this challenge. They use consistent, job-related questions and clear scoring criteria […]
articles.titleEn: Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Scoring alignment reached 97.6% when candidates provided clear evidence and 92.9% when only considering candidate concern signals, which identify behaviors that may indicate a poor fit for the intended role .

Decades of research in industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology have shown that structured interviews help organizations evaluate candidates and predict job performance (Schmidt & Hunter, 1998; Sackett et al., 2022).

Connect Talent uses structured questions, adaptive follow-ups, and evidence-based scoring to help organizations gather consistent, job-related information while giving more candidates the opportunity to demonstrate their strengths.

summaryLines: 후보자가 명확한 증거를 제공한 경우 점수 정렬은 97.6%에 이르렀고, 의도한 역할에 적합하지 않음을 나타낼 수 있는 행동을 식별하는 후보자의 우려 신호만 고려한 경우에는 92.9%에 도달함
산업-조직(I-O) 심리학에 대한 수십 년간의 연구에 따르면 구조화된 인터뷰는 조직이 후보자를 평가하고 업무 성과를 예측하는 데 도움이 되는 것으로 나타났습니다(Schmidt & Hunter, 1998; Sackett et al., 2022)
Connect Talent는 구조화된 질문, 적응형 후속 조치, 증거 기반 채점을 사용하여 조직이 일관적인 직무 관련 정보를 수집하는 동시에 더 많은 후보자에게 자신의 강점을 보여줄 수 있는 기회를 제공하도록 돕음

articles.title: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints by default and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost. It tracks latency, GPU utilization, and serving configuration, then sends a finding through AWS Health with a one-click path to benchmark alternatives in SageMaker Studio before you apply any change.
articles.titleEn: Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: A representative notification reads as follows: Subject: [Action may be required] SageMaker AI inference improvements for your endpoint SageMaker AI tracks the latency and capacity usage of your inference endpoints by default, and found improvements for one of them.

Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost by using Generative AI optimized inference recommendations feature with Agentic experience in Amazon SageMaker Studio .

Traffic patterns evolve, prompts grow longer, serving engines such as vLLM ship new releases, SageMaker inference develops new optimization techniques, and new fine-tuned checkpoints change the resources your model needs.

articles.descEn: [What the blog will cover and what’s in it for readers, 160 characters max]
articles.titleEn: Genie ZeroOps, now in public beta: An autonomous agent that fixes data pipelines, with lessons from 80,000 customer issues | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: In June we introduced Genie ZeroOps , an autonomous agent that detects, investigates, and resolves data pipeline issues, such as upstream schema changes or data quality anomalies.

So we built shared inboxes, custom agent instructions, and one-click PRs to help data teams triage faster. by Jeff Chou , Kristóf Molnár , Lennart Kats , Danny Chiao and Ray Zhu Genie ZeroOps is built and refined from observations across over 80,000 customer pipeline issues.

Based on extensive private preview testing with hundreds of customers, we’ve added new features to help data teams triage issues faster - including inbox sharing, notifications, one-click PR creation, and the ability to add custom business instructions to follow specific company workflows.

summaryLines: 지난 6월에는 업스트림 스키마 변경이나 데이터 품질 이상과 같은 데이터 파이프라인 문제를 감지, 조사, 해결하는 자율 에이전트인 Genie ZeroOps를 출시함
그래서 우리는 공유 받은 편지함, 맞춤형 상담원 지침, 원클릭 PR을 구축하여 데이터 팀이 더 빠르게 분류할 수 있도록 함 · Jeff Chou, Kristóf Molnár, Lennart Kats, Danny Chiao 및 Ray Zhu 작성 Genie ZeroOps는 80,000개 이상의 고객 파이프라인 문제에 대한 관찰을 통해 구축되고 개선됨
수백 명의 고객을 대상으로 한 광범위한 비공개 미리 보기 테스트를 기반으로 받은 편지함 공유, 알림, 원클릭 PR 생성, 특정 회사 워크플로를 따르기 위한 사용자 지정 비즈니스 지침을 추가하는 기능 등 데이터 팀이 문제를 더 빠르게 분류하는 데 도움이 되는 새로운 기능을 추가함

articles.title: Why PostgreSQL 19 shipped late | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: PostgreSQL 19 shipped about a month after the usual September to October window for major PostgreSQL releases. The delay came from the project's focus on quality.
articles.titleEn: Why PostgreSQL 19 shipped late | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: CVEs fixed per quarterly update release went from one to four up to 28 by August 2026, and commits back-patched to the release branch rose 61%.
The project is adapting, and AI scrutiny is a chance to make PostgreSQL better than it's ever been.
The delay came from the project's focus on quality.

The delay came from the project's focus on quality.

articles.title: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: When hundreds of agents serve thousands of developers, governance cannot be an afterthought. The BMW Group shares the practices and patterns its R&D teams use to build, govern, and operate AI agents at enterprise scale without sacrificing speed, quality, or compliance.
articles.titleEn: How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: At the BMW Group’s R&D, more than 12,500 developers work on approximately 500 million lines of vehicle software code.
While research, frameworks, and guidelines now facilitate building agents, industrializing and operating high-quality agents in an efficient, scalable manner remains a significant challenge.
This software is augmented by the BMW Connected Vehicle backend, a cloud-based system of more than 1,300 microservices providing digital services for 24 million vehicles in the field.

articles.titleEn: Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In this test run against a $0.01 seller, it compared two listings before buying: When the run finishes, the sample will print the payment with its amount, AWS Marketplace product ID, and processPaymentId .

Today we extend that autonomy to AWS Marketplace , so agents can discover and buy x402-enabled software, APIs, data, and content, and pay in USD on the agent developer’s AWS bill, removing the need for stablecoin wallets or API keys.

summaryLines: 0.01달러 판매자에 대한 이 테스트 실행에서는 구매하기 전에 두 개의 목록을 비교함 · 실행이 완료되면 샘플은 해당 금액, AWS Marketplace 제품 ID 및 processPaymentId와 함께 결제를 인쇄함
이제 우리는 이러한 자율성을 AWS Marketplace로 확장하여 에이전트가 x402 지원 소프트웨어, API, 데이터 및 콘텐츠를 검색 및 구매하고 에이전트 개발자의 AWS 청구서를 USD로 지불할 수 있으므로 스테이블코인 지갑이나 API 키가 필요하지 않음
기존 가드레일은 그대로 이어지며, 개발자는 AgentCore 정책을 사용하여 지출 한도와 승인된 판매자를 설정할 수 있으며, AgentCore 결제에 따라 결제 세션 한도가 적용되므로 에이전트가 초과 지출을 할 수 없음

articles.titleEn: Qualcomm offers test drive of its rack-scale Nvidia AI challenger
summaryLinesEn: Here’s the evidence underwriters expect Chase, Visa, Mastercard confirm third-party cyberattacks that may have exposed customers' info First service outages, then data breaches…what's next?!
Qualcomm says the system supports models ranging from 7 billion to 10 trillion parameters, including long-context, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workloads.

summaryLines: Chase, Visa, Mastercard가 고객 정보를 노출했을 수 있는 제3자 사이버 공격을 확인했다고 보험사가 예상하는 증거는 다음과 같음 · 첫 번째 서비스 중단, 그 다음에는 데이터 침해...다음은 무엇일까요
Qualcomm에 따르면 이 시스템은 긴 컨텍스트, RAG(검색 증강 생성) 및 에이전트 워크로드를 포함하여 70억 ~ 10조 개의 매개변수에 이르는 모델을 지원함
Qualcomm의 부사장 겸 데이터 센터 총괄 관리자인 Tony Pialis는 "AI 추론은 데이터 센터에서 가장 크고 중요한 컴퓨팅 워크로드 중 하나가 되고 있으며 업계에는 보다 효율적인 접근 방식이 필요함" · 라고 말함

articles.titleEn: Verizon Survey: Small Businesses Turn to Social Media & AI for Holidays
summaryLinesEn: 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- As small businesses gear up for the demanding holiday season, a new survey from Verizon Business reveals that owners are turning to their own social media savvy and AI to drive sales and manage operations.

Activating social media and community to drive sales Rather than relying on Black Friday, Cyber Monday or other major retail tentpole moments, small business owners are prioritizing direct customer engagement and digital storefronts to capture holiday demand.

To explore solutions and resources designed to help small businesses manage peak demand, streamline operations, and secure their connections, visit: Verizon's Small Business Solutions About the survey Verizon Business surveyed 600 U.S. small business owners and decision-makers at businesses with 1–500 employees, including an oversample of 100 Hispanic/Latino respondents.

localization.title: Verizon 설문조사 · 중소기업은 휴일에 소셜 미디어 및 AI를 활용함
summaryLines: 2026년 9월 19일 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- 중소기업이 까다로운 휴가 시즌을 준비하면서 Verizon Business의 새로운 설문 조사에 따르면 소유자는 판매를 촉진하고 운영을 관리하기 위해 소셜 미디어에 능숙하고 AI를 활용하고 있는 것으로 나타남
판매 촉진을 위해 소셜 미디어 및 커뮤니티 활성화 블랙 프라이데이, 사이버 먼데이 또는 기타 소매업의 주요 순간에 의존하는 대신 중소기업 소유자는 휴일 수요를 포착하기 위해 직접적인 고객 참여 및 디지털 매장에 우선순위를 두고 있음

중소기업이 최대 수요를 관리하고, 운영을 간소화하고, 연결을 보호하는 데 도움이 되도록 고안된 솔루션과 리소스를 살펴보려면 다음을 방문하십시오 · Verizon의 중소기업 솔루션 설문조사 정보 Verizon Business는 100명의 히스패닉/라틴계 응답자를 포함한 600명의 미국 중소기업 소유주와 직원 수 1~500명 규모 기업의 의사 결정자를 대상으로 설문 조사를 실시함

articles.descEn: For a while, the only thing Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) had in common was that they both made chips. Nvidia rode the AI boom to become one of the world’s most valuable companies, while Intel spent years trying to repair its business. Now they share a problem: shareholders who aren’t sure what comes next. articles.titleEn: Nvidia vs. Intel: One AI Stock Is Worth the Drama, the Other Isn’t Worth the Wait, Says Investor
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia's revenue more than doubled year over year to $115.8 billion, and interim CEO Colette Kress raised the fiscal 2028 growth forecast to 75% from 70%.
TCA's model assumes revenue grows about 9% next year and allows for a recovery to a 6% net margin, roughly the sector median.
TCA also expects Nvidia to use up its remaining buyback authorization of about $227 billion by the end of fiscal 2028, as management has said it will, which would shrink the share count.

articles.title: Broadcom (AVGO) Named In ECB Warning On AI Debt Financing
articles.descEn: Broadcom (NasdaqGS: AVGO) has been named in a new European Central Bank warning on AI related debt financing risks. In its latest financial stability review, the ECB flags rapid growth of off balance sheet debt tied to AI infrastructure spending. The central bank highlights historical parallels with the dotcom and subprime periods, focusing on leverage used by large technology groups. The ECB's warning on AI driven debt structures around Broadcom and peers sits alongside wider financial...

articles.title: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
articles.descEn: Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.
articles.titleEn: Mistral plays catch-up with Vibe Desktop as rivals already command full operating systems
summaryLinesEn: The agent can work either in a local repository or in a cloud sandbox, and the app uses Git worktrees to keep parallel tasks in the same project separate.

Mistral caught up on the model side in October with Large 4 , but in head-to-head comparisons it still trails Gemini 4 Carbon and Claude Opus 5.5 by a wide margin and also falls behind the strongest open models from China.
Mistral's AI agent Vibe now has its own desktop app.

articles.title: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
articles.descEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) put its AI story back in focus with fresh upgrades to the Dell AI Factory with NVIDIA, adding new data tools, liquid cooled storage and large scale infrastructure management. Despite the AI Factory updates, Dell Technologies’ recent share price action has cooled. The 30-day share price return is down 28.54% and the 90-day share price return is down 26.23%, while the year-to-date share price return stands at 152.57% and the 1-year total shareholder return reaches...
articles.titleEn: Dell Technologies (DELL) Could Be 46% Undervalued Following AI Factory Updates
summaryLinesEn: Dell Technologies last closed at $322.79, while the analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St estimates fair value at $594.16.

Dell Technologies is experiencing accelerating demand for AI servers and data center solutions as enterprises globally increase investments in AI and machine learning workloads and digital transformation, supported by more than US$130b of AI server orders in the past 12 months, a US$95b AI backlog and a pipeline that is multiples of backlog, which ties directly to future revenue and earnings.
Still, Dell Technologies faces real pressure points if AI server margins remain in the mid single digits or if tight component supply slows the conversion of its large backlog.

localization.title: Dell Technologies(DELL)는 AI 공장 업데이트로 인해 46% 저평가될 수 있음
summaryLines: Dell Technologies는 마지막으로 $322.79로 마감했으며 Simply Wall St의 분석가 합의 Narrative는 공정 가치를 $594.16으로 추정함

Dell Technologies는 지난 12개월 동안 미화 1,300억 달러 이상의 AI 서버 주문, 미화 950억 달러의 AI 백로그 및 향후 수익 및 수익과 직접적으로 연결되는 파이프라인의 지원을 받아 기업이 전 세계적으로 AI 및 머신 러닝 워크로드와 디지털 변혁에 대한 투자를 늘리면서 AI 서버 및 데이터 센터 솔루션에 대한 수요가 가속화되고 있음을 경험하고 있음
그럼에도 불구하고, Dell Technologies는 AI 서버 마진이 한 자릿수 중반에 머물거나 빠듯한 구성 요소 공급으로 인해 대규모 백로그의 전환이 느려지는 경우 실제 압력 포인트에 직면함

articles.title: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
articles.descEn: CAMPBELL, Calif., November 18, 2026--Mirantis, delivering open, standards based infrastructure for the next generation of AI clouds, today announced it has joined the Lenovo AI Innovators program to help cloud providers and enterprises turn Lenovo AI infrastructure into production AI services.
articles.titleEn: Mirantis Joins Lenovo AI Innovators to Help Cloud Providers Turn GPU Infrastructure into AI Services
summaryLinesEn: For cloud providers, these capabilities make GPU capacity faster to deliver and simpler to operate at scale, and provide a foundation to offer additional managed AI services.
For enterprises, the capabilities provide a foundation for private AI environments that give teams access to accelerated computing while maintaining centralized operational control.

"Cloud providers and enterprises are investing in GPUs to deliver services, support developers and build new revenue streams," said Richard Borenstein, senior vice president of business development, Mirantis.

articles.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
articles.descEn: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a new frontier model built for software development, knowledge work, and science. It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a context window of one million tokens. At $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, Neon is priced above previous Gemini 4 models.
articles.titleEn: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth new Gemini model in a month
summaryLinesEn: The model is live today through the API at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, above Carbon and Argon's introductory rate of $2/$10 (doubling to $4/$20 on December 1 ) and twice the price of Hydrogen at $1.50/$7.50.
It handles text, images, video, audio, and PDFs, with support for Computer Use , code execution, file search, and grounding via Google Search and Maps.
It's also Google's fourth new Gemini 4 model in four weeks.

articles.title: Microsoft is replacing outside AI models in its own products with cheaper in-house alternatives
articles.descEn: Microsoft's AI division MAI unveiled seven new models for code, security, images, language, and routing at Ignite. MAI Code 2 reaches 98 percent of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at 40 percent of the cost, according to Microsoft. The models are built for running AI agents around the clock in enterprises.
articles.titleEn: Microsoft is replacing outside AI models in its own products with cheaper in-house alternatives
summaryLinesEn: It's said to match GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 at 65 and 20 percent of their respective costs.
The Model Router in Foundry now also selects automatically from an expanded pool of models.

MAI Code 2 approaches GPT-6.1 Sol and Opus 5.5 at a promotional price According to Microsoft , MAI Code 2 averages 98 percent of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance across four benchmarks at 40 percent of the cost.

articles.title: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
articles.descEn: Google's new temporary threads let users have conversations in AI Mode without adding them to their search history or influencing future recommendations.
articles.titleEn: Google's AI feature in Search gets its own incognito mode
summaryLinesEn: The option could be convenient to use at those times when you start digging deeper into a particular topic via AI Mode and realize that you don’t want the discussion to become a part of your search history because of its personal nature.
Google’s search engine has long offered an incognito mode for all those search queries you don’t want logged or associated with your account.
Now, Google’s AI Mode in Search is getting a similar feature.

articles.title: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
articles.descEn: Nvidia and AMD earnings show booming demand. This is why a frontier slowdown might not derail it.
articles.titleEn: Remember the frontier AI pause? Chip companies don’t either
summaryLinesEn: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink AMD rides data center riches to ‘largest and most profitable’ quarter in history Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make Chipmaker AMD, meanwhile, reported its biggest quarter ever earlier this month, with revenue up 45 percent to $13.4 billion .

The people building the most powerful models were warning about what those models might be capable of, and investors were suddenly wondering what would happen to chip demand if the labs eased up on new models.
The impact could show up sooner in orders placed with chip manufacturers like TSMC.

summaryLines: Qualcomm은 스마트폰 판매가 감소하는 AMD가 데이터 센터 부자들을 역사상 '가장 크고 수익성이 높은' 분기로 끌어올리면서 데이터 센터에 큰 투자를 하고 있음 · Intel은 Chipmaker AMD가 만들 수 있는 모든 저렴한 노트북 칩을 판매하고 있다고 밝힘 · 한편, Chipmaker AMD는 이번 달 초 매출이 45% 증가한 134억 달러로 역대 최대 분기를 보고함

articles.title: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
articles.descEn: The AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of a prize-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after its own review. Pangram also classified over 80 percent of the author's personal texts as machine-written. French publisher Gallimard plans to start screening manuscripts with the tool.
articles.titleEn: Pangram flags 99 percent of an award-winning Peruvian novel as AI-generated, but the publisher stands by its author
summaryLinesEn: AI detection tool Pangram flags 99 percent of the award-winning novel "Donde el agua trabaja" by Peruvian author David Silva Rojas as AI-generated.
According to the newspaper El País, Pangram had also attributed more than 80 percent of text from interviews, an essay, and the author's Instagram denial to AI.
Despite these allegations, Mexican publisher Almadía is standing by the award after reviewing documents from the author, according to an essay in The Point Magazine .

articles.title: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
articles.descEn: OpenAI is giving four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, direct access to unreleased models, source code, and training data for the first time. The embedded reviews are designed to uncover hidden misbehavior and safety gaps. OpenAI can redact or delay reports, so how independent this oversight actually turns out to be remains an open question.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI opens its AI systems to four independent on-site auditors for the first time
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI and Transluce are also planning an eight-week follow-up review for early 2027.
OpenAI is giving four outside audit organizations direct access to its internal AI systems to investigate safety risks and model behavior on-site.
The company expects some friction early on but is already considering more reviews, including ones focused on company culture and internal processes.

articles.title: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
articles.descEn: Artex and similar penetration testing tools allow newbie hackers to scan targeted systems for vulnerabilities and successfully wage attacks using prompts fed to chatbots.
articles.titleEn: Criminals Have a New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
summaryLinesEn: Over the past year, security researchers have warned that AI agents could vastly speed up cybercriminals’ ability to launch cyberattacks, breach companies , and ultimately steal money, data, or sensitive information from those compromised systems.
Hackers also don’t need to be skilled to use the tools, researchers say, and attacks that would have taken days are completed in just hours.

Pinpointing the number of cybercriminals using Artex and other frameworks isn’t easy; however, thousands of instances of the systems being set up have been exposed to the internet, according to analysis by Censys and the Shadowserver Foundation.

articles.title: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
articles.descEn: Thomas Nagel has done landmark work on consciousness in nonhumans; this week, he won the million-dollar Berggruen Prize for his contributions to the field. And he has a lot of thoughts on AI.
articles.titleEn: ‘Just Ridiculous’: A Famed Philosopher Takes on AI Consciousness
summaryLinesEn: Over 50 years ago, philosopher Thomas Nagel asked the question, “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?”

We have strong reasons to believe that while there may be consciousness elsewhere in the universe, it would require the appearance of some kind of organism with something analogous to a nervous system.
It’s been 52 years since you wrote “What Is It Like to Be a Bat?,” which has become an iconic paper about understanding consciousness in non-humans.

articles.titleEn: Over a Third of Gen Z-ers Rely on AI for Friendship
summaryLinesEn: In “ Friendship in an Online-Offline World: Digital Life, Connection and Wellbeing ” researchers from public polling firm Gallup and the Digital Wellness Lab at Boston Children’s Hospital found that more than one-third of Gen Z (33 percent) rely on AI for companionship.

While researchers are wary of classifying the report as a permanent shift in how young people form relationships, they say it does signal a growing reliance on AI companionship as part of a pattern of digital social engagement unfolding among Gen Z.

In the US, where state legislators have introduced bills to curb addictive design features, a majority of Americans support banning kids under 16 from using social media, according to a recent Pew Research survey .

localization.title: Z세대의 3분의 1 이상이 우정을 위해 AI에 의존함
summaryLines: 공공 여론 조사 회사인 Gallup과 Boston Children's Hospital의 Digital Wellness Lab의 연구원들은 “온라인-오프라인 세계의 우정 · 디지털 생활, 연결 및 웰빙”에서 Z세대의 3분의 1 이상(33%)이 동료애를 위해 AI에 의존한다는 사실을 발견함
연구자들은 이 보고서를 젊은이들이 관계를 형성하는 방식의 영구적인 변화로 분류하는 것을 경계하지만, 이는 Z세대 사이에 펼쳐지는 디지털 사회적 참여 패턴의 일부로 AI 동반자 관계에 대한 의존도가 높아지고 있음을 의미한다고 말함
최근 퓨 리서치(Pew Research) 조사에 따르면 주 의회가 중독성 있는 디자인 기능을 억제하기 위한 법안을 발의한 미국에서는 미국인 대다수가 16세 미만 어린이의 소셜 미디어 사용 금지를 지지하는 것으로 나타남

articles.title: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
articles.descEn: Osmo’s smell model is already being used in the fragrance industry. But are medical diagnostics and threat detection a sniff too far?
articles.titleEn: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
summaryLinesEn: A lot of the company’s work has been in creating its own dataset of more than 10 million human labels and 800 million “scent tokens,” which describe the exact molecules and concentrations that go into creating specific odors.

The Gates Foundation, which invested $5 million when Osmo launched, later gave the company a $3.5 million grant to assess molecules that repel disease-carrying insects, and Osmo identified eight substances that were more repellent than DEET.
It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents.

summaryLines: 회사의 많은 작업은 특정 냄새를 생성하는 데 사용되는 정확한 분자와 농도를 설명하는 천만 개 이상의 인간 라벨과 8억 개 이상의 "향기 토큰"으로 구성된 자체 데이터 세트를 만드는 것이었음
Osmo가 설립되었을 때 500만 달러를 투자한 Gates 재단은 나중에 질병을 옮기는 곤충을 퇴치하는 분자를 평가하기 위해 회사에 350만 달러의 보조금을 제공했으며 Osmo는 DEET보다 더 강한 퇴치 효과가 있는 8가지 물질을 확인함
자사의 기술은 이미 향수 산업에서 브랜드가 새로운 향기를 디자인하고 제조하는 데 사용되고 있다고 밝힘

articles.title: Introducing FlowForma Agent Trust: Every AI Agent, Under Control
articles.descEn: FlowForma, the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust, an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor. It manages processes, people and agents side by side, holding AI to the same standard as a member of the team: visible, accountable and under control.
articles.titleEn: Introducing FlowForma Agent Trust: Every AI Agent, Under Control
summaryLinesEn: FlowForma Contract runs procurement, contract and tender management, FlowForma Assure speeds up vendor security assessment, and FlowForma Agent Trust governs, monitors and optimizes AI agents.

18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FlowForma , the AI and process automation company, today launched FlowForma Agent Trust , an AI agent governance hub that brings oversight to every agent an organization runs, from any platform or vendor.
FlowForma Agent Trust discovers every AI agent at work in an organization and checks what it delivers against real outcomes, human corrections and cost.

articles.title: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Memory bottlenecks leave GPUs idle as inference grows, but photonics and shared HBM pools can cut data movement energy to a quarter of copper.
articles.titleEn: Memory bottlenecks in AI: How photonics and shared pools help - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: AI’s hidden energy tax: More than 80% of scale-up traffic is just memory moving around Memory bottlenecks are emerging as one of the costliest problems in AI infrastructure as inference overtakes training.
More than 80 percent of scale-up network traffic is memory transactions, and a shared pool means much of that data never moves at all, he noted.
Each appliance holds 16 terabytes of HBM and DDR5 memory that servers across multiple racks can share, Mills explained.
