articles.title: Business development in the agentic AI era puts CPUs first - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: Business development for compute is shifting as agentic AI drives CPU demand and data center power limits shape server design and refresh plans.
articles.titleEn: Business development in the agentic AI era puts CPUs first - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: When Dell began planning its portfolio 2.5 years ago, enterprise customers forecast rack power holding at 15 to 20 kilowatts and said they often ran out of power before filling a rack, according to Schmidt.
A single EPYC 9006 server can take 13 legacy machines out of production while cutting the system power needed for cooling by 80 percent, Schmidt noted.
Agentic AI puts the CPU back at center stage as Dell and AMD chase every watt Agentic AI is rewriting the business development playbook for chipmakers and server builders.

articles.title: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
articles.descEn: The HP OmniBook 3 with the Snapdragon X processor is rated for up to 41 hours of battery life. Here’s how to stretch each charge.
articles.titleEn: Does a Laptop Powered by Snapdragon Really Last All Week? What to Expect From the HP OmniBook 3 - CNET
summaryLinesEn: Quick Answer: Some professionals may be able to get through a full working week on a single charge with the HP OmniBook 3 with Snapdragon X , which Currys rates at up to 41 hours of battery life.
The HP OmniBook 3 has a secret weapon for power efficiency: the first-generation Snapdragon X (the eight-core X1-26-100) processor.
If you’re putting the laptop away for the whole weekend, shutting it down (or using Hibernate if available, which uses even less power than sleep) can help preserve a charge for Monday morning.

articles.title: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
articles.descEn: Editing the AI’s memory is one way you can shape its responses.
articles.titleEn: You can now see and edit what Google Gemini remembers about you - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: Depending on what you share, Gemini's picture of you can be fairly intimate, which makes the ability to edit the AI's memory all the more important.
The AI isn't able to create any memories unless it can remember and access your inputs, so Keep Activity needs to be on for this to work.

Besides the ability to connect and use other applications and services, a lot of AI assistants' utility comes from their capacity to shape their responses based on what they learn and remember about you.

articles.titleEn: AI found a hole in Java, and it starts with 'AAAAAAAA...' - Engadget

(A White House spokesperson previously told WIRED that the new rule would “crack down on the smuggling of advanced US SI chips” and “help ensure that America’s most advanced chips go first to US SI innovators, not Chinese shell companies.”)

summaryLines: Bloomberg에 따르면 Megaspeed가 2024년과 2025년에 말레이시아와 인도네시아로 수입한 약 136,000개의 AI 칩 중 약 50,000개가 Nvidia의 초기 재고 확인에서 제외됨
Biden 행정부가 점점 더 복잡해지는 제한 사항을 연속적으로 도입하고, 칩 제조업체들이 이를 피할 수 있는 점점 더 정교한 방법을 찾으면서 규칙을 강화하기 위해 안간힘을 쓰면서 국의 업무는 더욱 어려워졌음
(백악관 대변인은 이전에 WIRED에 새로운 규정이 “첨단 미국 SI 칩의 밀수를 단속하고” “미국의 가장 진보된 칩이 중국 쉘 회사가 아닌 미국 SI 혁신가에게 먼저 전달되도록 보장하는 데 도움이 될 것”이라고 WIRED에 말했습니다.)

articles.title: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
articles.descEn: Fallout from the Nvidia scandal has made any negotiations around AI difficult, officials say.
articles.titleEn: Even His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AI
summaryLinesEn: While Trump has sought to forge friendlier economic relations with China, the administration this week announced it would move forward with a new rule clamping down on China's ability to remotely access US-made AI chips in foreign data centers.

Back in September, the Trump administration moved to set up an AI incident hotline between Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese vice premier He Lifeng to account for situations just like this one.
Part of the reason progress hasn’t been made yet is due to differing views on what the biggest risks are with AI—and both nations have different incentives on making incidents public, officials say.

summaryLines: 트럼프 대통령은 중국과 보다 우호적인 경제 관계를 구축하려고 노력했지만, 이번 주 행정부는 외국 데이터 센터에서 미국산 AI 칩에 원격으로 접근하는 중국의 능력을 단속하는 새로운 규정을 추진할 것이라고 발표함
지난 9월 트럼프 행정부는 이와 같은 상황을 설명하기 위해 스콧 베센트(Scott Bessent) 재무장관과 허리펑(He Lifeng) 중국 부총리 사이에 AI 사건 핫라인을 개설하기로 함
아직 진전이 이루어지지 않은 이유 중 하나는 AI의 가장 큰 위험이 무엇인지에 대한 서로 다른 견해 때문이며, 두 국가 모두 사건을 공개하는 데 서로 다른 인센티브를 갖고 있다고 관계자는 말함

articles.title: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
articles.descEn: While the Branch Nvidians try to reinstate Jensen Huang, Collette Kress, Nvidia’s acting CEO, has to lead the company. The earnings call hinted at how.
articles.titleEn: What is Nvidia without AI’s sugar daddy in charge?
summaryLinesEn: For instance, if Elon Musk is telling the truth , then Jensen Huang (the former CEO of Nvidia, a company with a market cap of about $3 trillion) has been making deals that were “a handshake with Jensen” with suppliers — “not a written contract,” Musk wrote.
But after listening to Nvidia’s first earnings call with its new CEO, Colette Kress, I do think something may have shifted.
This is an important thing, though — as SemiAnalysis noted in its bizarrely conspiratorial post on the situation, Nvidia is successful because it has choked off the supply chain .

summaryLinesEn: The agency says the project will be on public land located at the former Clark Air Base built in the early 1900s when the Philippines was a US territory.

articles.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
articles.descEn: Microsoft's CEO says AI agents could disrupt advertising-driven business models, forcing companies like Amazon to rethink how they compete for customers.
articles.titleEn: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
summaryLinesEn: Speaking at The New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the tech executive argued that the shift to an agentic web could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions, similar to how the transition from web portals like Yahoo to search engines like Google did years ago.
“And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued.
“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella.

articles.title: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable'
articles.descEn: The Microsoft CEO downplayed the recent Outlook outage while noting that AI was causing both opportunities and new challenges for securing much of the connected world.
articles.titleEn: Amidst fears of AI cyberattacks, Satya Nadella says lots of critical infrastructure is 'unpatchable'
summaryLinesEn: In other words: The smartification of the economy, in which much of the world’s “dumb” devices were hooked up to the internet, is now causing tremendous headaches.
“The patch [now] needs to go instantly from being available to being patched in production, because it’s being exploited in the wild, right?
“Remember, there is a lot of stuff in our critical infrastructure that’s unpatchable,” Nadella said.

articles.title: Huawei's Stellar Glow Fades, Honor's Radiance Dims: Key Shifts in China's Smartphone Brand Landscape
articles.descEn: Against the backdrop of its ongoing IPO process, Honor has sparked widespread industry discussions with its frequent cross-sector strategic layouts in recent times. This in-depth analysis explores the core driving forces behind the smartphone giant’s aggressive cross-domain expansion amid its IPO preparation: covering how it breaks through the bottleneck of homogeneous competition in the consumer electronics track, builds a full-scenario smart ecosystem to elevate its pre-IPO valuation logic, locks in long-term growth curves through cross-sector technological synergy, and responds to the new demands of global consumer smart life. The content also sorts out the key layout directions of Honor’s cross-sector moves, providing professional insights for industry insiders, investors and technology followers to grasp Honor’s long-term development strategy beyond the capital market.
articles.titleEn: Huawei's Stellar Glow Fades, Honor's Radiance Dims: Key Shifts in China's Smartphone Brand Landscape
summaryLinesEn: According to Caixin reports, in November 2020, when Shenzhen state-owned capital acquired Honor from Huawei, the transaction price was about 40 billion US dollars (about 260 billion RMB at the exchange rate at that time).

Guided by the Alpha Strategy, Honor has successively launched product lines such as the Magic8, Magic9, and Magic V6 series, and launched AI services including the YOYO intelligent agent family, YOYO Task, and AI call assistant.

According to disclosures by digital blogger "Smart Chip Insider", in the first half of 2026, products in the 0-2000 yuan price range accounted for 49% of Honor's mobile phone sales, only 1 percentage point lower than Xiaomi, which is known for its cost-effective positioning.

articles.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
summaryLinesEn: On the Open ASR Leaderboard multilingual track, Rumble-2-Flash averages a 6.96% error rate across Chinese, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Hindi, Dutch and English.

Runs anywhere : native support in 🤗 Transformers and vLLM, no custom code Output control : numbers as digits or words, fillers, verbatim repeats, forced language Extremely fast : an hour of audio in about half a second, with over 7,000 RTFx on full batches Holds up on real phone calls : on par with NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe (30B) on a 302-hour call-centre benchmark audio accepts a local path, a URL, a NumPy array, or a list of these.
It's a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages that competes with models 3-60x its size.

summaryLines: Open ASR Leaderboard 다국어 트랙에서 Rumble-2-Flash는 중국어, 독일어, 프랑스어, 이탈리아어, 스페인어, 포르투갈어, 힌디어, 네덜란드어 및 영어에서 평균 6.96%의 오류율을 기록함

40개 이상의 언어에 대한 0.5B 매개변수 음성 인식 모델로 크기가 3~60배인 모델과 경쟁함

articles.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
articles.descEn: We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
articles.titleEn: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
summaryLinesEn: To try it, install Transformers from that PR: Then, moving from OLMoE to the real target, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: That repo holds the output of the project's conversion script : the dense weights, the experts quantized to 3 bits, and the n-gram table.

I ran all of them on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on one A10G (24 GB), with plenty of RAM, and Harry Mellor reran vLLM with better flags: Offloading only the experts doubles vLLM's speed, and FP8 helps on top (half the bytes per expert, more of the model on the GPU). vLLM's other offload backend, which copies groups of layers ahead of time, ran under 1 tok/s.
I had a dual boot with Ubuntu, but their games ended up taking most of the two terabytes of disk.

articles.title: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
articles.descEn: AlphaGenome 2 is our next-generation DNA sequence model that bridges single-cell biology and human genetics, predicting how variants affect human cell types.
articles.titleEn: AlphaGenome 2: Deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease
summaryLinesEn: We trained AlphaGenome 2 on both bulk and single-cell data from human and mouse samples, including over 107 million individual cell profiles.
We expanded its reach with AlphaGenome Atlas , a platform containing predictions for all 9 billion possible single-letter changes in the human genome.

AlphaGenome 2 extends enhancer-gene mapping to primary human cell types — such as brain astrocytes, which support and protect neurons — helping researchers connect regulatory variants to their target genes in the specific cells where disease unfolds.

articles.title: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Learn how adaptive concurrency limits helped Databricks raise cluster-creation request-rate limits by 7.5× while protecting long-running workflows.
articles.titleEn: How we raised Databricks cluster rate limits by 7.5× | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Conservative limits turned away customer requests despite spare capacity, yet kept accepting requests when our services or dependencies, such as cloud providers, slowed down.
Engineers manually lowered limits to shed load during incidents and raised them again after recovery.

In this post, we'll explore why fixed request-rate limits can fall short for these long-running operations, how adaptive concurrency limits help, and what we learned applying them to cluster creation for Databricks classic compute.

Conservative limits turned away customer requests despite spare capacity, yet kept accepting requests when our services or dependencies, such as cloud providers, slowed down.

Engineers manually lowered limits to shed load during incidents and raised them again after recovery.

In this post, we'll explore why fixed request-rate limits can fall short for these long-running operations, how adaptive concurrency limits help, and what we learned applying them to cluster creation for Databricks classic compute.

articles.title: Africa’s Digital Progress Accelerates, but 64% Usage Gap Shows Next Challenge for Policymakers
articles.descEn: GSMA Digital Africa Index 2026 finds seven more countries joining the continent’s leading group for digital development and enabling policy 18 November 2026, Cape Town: Africa is making measurable progress on digital development and enabling policy, but turning widespread mobile broadband coverage into meaningful digital participation remains a critical challenge, according to the GSMA’s flagship […]
articles.titleEn: Africa’s Digital Progress Accelerates, but 64% Usage Gap Shows Next Challenge for Policymakers
summaryLinesEn: Mobile broadband networks now cover 92% of Africa’s population, yet only 28% use mobile internet on their own devices, leaving a 64% usage gap.
While the usage gap is a global challenge, it is largest in Africa, making accelerating adoption across the region particularly urgent.
With 64% of the population living within coverage but not using mobile internet, closing the usage gap requires us to tackle the barriers that continue to keep people offline.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Buddhist Population
articles.descEn: The number of Buddhists in the world is projected to continue shrinking through 2070.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Buddhist Population
summaryLinesEn: The most common projection method – used by researchers for more than a century – starts by estimating the size of a country’s population in groups (“cohorts”) divided by age and sex, such as the number of girls ages 0 to 4, 5 to 9, 10 to 14, etc.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.
By Pew Research Center’s projections, the Buddhist population is expected to continue shrinking steadily through 2070.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Hindu Population
articles.descEn: In the coming decades, Hindu population growth will lag behind that of other religious groups in India and the world overall.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Hindu Population
summaryLinesEn: India is home to the vast majority of the world’s Hindus, with 1.1 billion (or 95% of the global Hindu population) living there as of 2020.
The rankings are expected to shift in a few ways between 2020 and 2070: The U.S. will grow to have the fifth-largest Hindu population.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

articles.title: The Future of the Religiously Unaffiliated Population Around the World
articles.descEn: The number of people with no religion is projected to drop worldwide in the coming decades, driven by decline in China.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Religiously Unaffiliated Population Around the World
summaryLinesEn: We project future changes in the size and geographic distribution of seven religious groups – Christians, Muslims, Hindus, Buddhists, Jews, followers of all other religions and religiously unaffiliated people – between 2020 and 2070.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.
And 37 countries and territories will see the percentage of their population that is religiously unaffiliated increase substantially (i.e., by at least 5 percentage points).

articles.title: The Future of the Global Jewish Population
articles.descEn: The world’s Jewish population is projected to become increasingly concentrated in Israel over the coming decades.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Jewish Population
summaryLinesEn: If recent demographic trends continue, Israel will be home to 62% of the global Jewish population in 2070, up from 46% in 2020.

57 At the same time, because the global Jewish population is expected to grow at a slower pace than other religious groups analyzed in this study, Jews will make up a slightly smaller percentage of all the people in the world in 2070 (0.17%) than they did in 2020 (0.19%).
Because of these divergent trends in the U.S. and Israel, the share of the global Jewish population living in America is projected to shrink, from 39% in 2020 to 26% in 2070.

summaryLines: 최근의 인구통계학적 추세가 계속된다면 이스라엘의 유대인 인구 비율은 2020년 46%에서 2070년에는 62%로 증가할 것임

articles.title: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
articles.descEn: Between 2020 and 2070, the world’s Muslim population is expected to grow more than all other religious groups combined.
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Muslim Population
summaryLinesEn: According to Pew Research Center’s projections, the global Muslim population will grow in number by 80% between 2020 and 2070, while the global non-Muslim population will increase by 11%.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

The Muslim population will grow by 9 million in the United States but will still account for a relatively small percentage of the country’s total population (4%). 54 countries and territories will have Muslim majorities, including 35 places where Muslims will make up at least 90% of the population.

articles.title: The Future of the Global Population of Other Religions
articles.descEn: Followers of other religions are projected to grow more geographically dispersed in the coming decades
articles.titleEn: The Future of the Global Population of Other Religions
summaryLinesEn: Meanwhile, 29% of the global population of other religions is projected to live in sub-Saharan Africa by the end of the projection period, up from 16% in 2020.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

This group is projected to make up a larger share of the North American population in 2070 (about 3.0%) than in 2020 (1.4%), but the region is expected to continue to have far more Christians and religiously unaffiliated people than followers of other religions.

articles.title: The Future of Religion in Europe
articles.descEn: A slim majority of Europeans are projected to be Christian in 2070, while the percentage who are Muslim will double to 13%.
articles.titleEn: The Future of Religion in Europe
summaryLinesEn: The study anticipates that Europe’s Christian population will decrease by more than a third in absolute numbers in coming decades, from 505 million in 2020 to 324 million in 2070.
Due to lower fertility rates and an older population than other regions, Europe is the only major region in the world that we project will have a smaller total population in 2070 than it did in 2020.

In Europe, Christians will decline by at least 5 percentage points as a share of the population in 30 countries, while the Muslim share of the population will rise by 5 points or more in 21 countries.

articles.descEn: Our projections detail why Muslims will soon become the world’s largest religious group and Christians will be the second largest.
articles.titleEn: The Future of World Religions: Population Growth Projections, 2020-2070
summaryLinesEn: 2 And people who have no religious affiliation – sometimes called religious “nones” – are projected to drop substantially as a share of the world population, from 24% in 2020 to 17% in 2070.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

The most common projection method – used by researchers for more than a century – starts by estimating the size of a country’s population in groups (“cohorts”) divided by age and sex, such as the number of girls ages 0 to 4, 5 to 9, 10 to 14, etc.

articles.descEn: Muslims will outnumber Christians by 2035, driven by higher fertility, but both groups are projected to keep growing in the decades ahead.
articles.titleEn: Islam Will Soon Be the World’s Largest Religion, but Christianity Will Keep Growing Too
summaryLinesEn: The United States had the world’s largest Christian population in 2020, and it is expected to witness the greatest decline in the number of Christians, dropping from 217 million in 2020 to 174 million in 2070.
Despite this shift, Muslim population growth will not slow the rise of the Christian population.
This research is part of the Pew-Templeton Global Religious Futures project , which analyzes religious change and its impact on societies around the world.

articles.title: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
articles.descEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.
articles.titleEn: Two-Thirds of Americans Disapprove of Trump’s Handling of the Russia-Ukraine War
summaryLinesEn: Around four-in-ten Americans say Trump is favoring Russia too much in the conflict, while a much smaller share (7%) say he is favoring Ukraine too much.

As has been the case for most of the last few years, about half of adults (49%) say the U.S. has a responsibility to help Ukraine defend itself from Russia. 34% of Republicans continue to say the U.S. has this responsibility.
The share of Americans saying Trump is favoring Russia too much (39%) is 6 percentage points higher than in August 2025.

summaryLinesEn: But Figure 4 shows that the most common use, for both coding agent users and others, is for coding up analysis of quantitative data: 97% of coding agent users and 77% of other AI users report using it to generate code.
The human sciences are shifting: for the first time, core research tasks can be handed off to machines.
These tools could accelerate science and make it more daring: fast research execution should mean cheap and plentiful discovery.

articles.title: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
articles.descEn: Announcement of the new Anthropic Economic Index and description of the new data on AI use in occupations
articles.titleEn: Introducing the Anthropic Economic Index
summaryLinesEn: The main findings from the Economic Index’s first paper are: Today, usage is concentrated in software development and technical writing tasks.
Economics Apr 22, 2026 Announcing the Anthropic Economic Index Survey In the coming years, AI systems will have a major impact on the ways people work.

We’d therefore expect AI to be adopted selectively for different tasks across different occupations, and that analyzing tasks—in addition to jobs as a whole—would give us a fuller picture of how AI is being integrated into the economy.

articles.title: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
articles.descEn: The second update from the Anthropic Economic Index on how people are using AI.
articles.titleEn: Economic Index: Insights from Claude 3.7 Sonnet
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re releasing our second research report from the Index, covering usage data on Claude.ai following the launch of Claude 3.7 Sonnet —our newest and most capable model with strengths in agentic coding and a new “extended thinking” mode.

Last month, we launched the Anthropic Economic Index —a new initiative where we’re regularly releasing data and research aimed at understanding AI's effects on labor markets and the economy over time.

While this increase in coding usage was expected due to Claude 3.7 Sonnet’s improved scores on coding benchmarks, the increase in these other categories could reflect either ongoing diffusion of AI throughout the economy, novel applications of coding to those domains, or unexpected capability improvements in the model.

localization.title: 경제 지수 · Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 통찰력
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 에이전트 코딩과 새로운 "확장 사고" 모드의 강점을 갖춘 최신이자 가장 유능한 모델인 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 출시 이후 Claude.ai의 사용 데이터를 다루는 Index의 두 번째 연구 보고서를 발표함
지난 달 우리는 시간이 지남에 따라 AI가 노동 시장과 경제에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위한 데이터와 연구를 정기적으로 공개하는 새로운 이니셔티브인 인류 경제 지수(Anthropic Economic Index)를 시작함
코딩 사용량의 이러한 증가는 Claude 3.7 Sonnet의 코딩 벤치마크 점수 향상으로 인해 예상되었지만, 이러한 다른 범주의 증가는 경제 전반에 걸친 AI의 지속적인 확산, 해당 영역에 대한 새로운 코딩 적용 또는 모델의 예상치 못한 기능 향상을 반영할 수 있음

articles.title: How people use Claude for support and advice
articles.descEn: Only 2.9% of Claude conversations involve emotional support, advice, or companionship. We share research on affective use and how we're building safeguards.
articles.titleEn: How people use Claude for support and advice
summaryLinesEn: Takeaway: Affective conversations are a small but meaningful slice of Claude usage (2.9%), with most people primarily using AI for work tasks and content creation.
Takeaway: People tend to shift towards slightly more positive emotional expressions while talking to Claude.

Less than 10% of coaching or counseling conversations involve Claude resisting user requests, and when it does, it's typically for safety reasons (for example, refusing to provide dangerous weight loss advice or support self-harm).

articles.title: Challenges in evaluating AI systems
articles.descEn: Insights from the red teaming approaches we've used to test our AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Challenges in evaluating AI systems
summaryLinesEn: Alignment Jun 16, 2025 SHADE-Arena: Evaluating sabotage and monitoring in LLM agents Most conversations around the societal impacts of artificial intelligence (AI) come down to discussing some quality of an AI system, such as its truthfulness, fairness, potential for misuse, and so on.
To speed up BIG-bench would require re-writing it in order to play well with our infrastructure—a significant engineering effort.

We hope that this post is useful to people who are developing AI governance initiatives that rely on evaluations, as well as people who are launching or scaling up organizations focused on evaluating AI systems.

articles.title: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
articles.descEn: A randomized trial with 52 developers found AI assistance lowered comprehension scores, except when used for explanations rather than delegation.
articles.titleEn: How AI assistance impacts the formation of coding skills
summaryLinesEn: In a randomized controlled trial, we examined 1) how quickly software developers picked up a new skill (in this case, a Python library) with and without AI assistance; and 2) whether using AI made them less likely to understand the code they’d just written.
Though preliminary, these results suggest important considerations as companies transition to a greater ratio of AI-written to human-written code.

Here, AI creates a potential tension: as coding grows more automated and speeds up work, humans will still need the skills to catch errors, guide output, and ultimately provide oversight for AI deployed in high-stakes environments.

localization.title: AI 지원이 코딩 기술 형성에 미치는 영향
summaryLines: 무작위 대조 시험에서 우리는 1) 소프트웨어 개발자가 AI 지원 유무에 관계없이 얼마나 빨리 새로운 기술(이 경우 Python 라이브러리)을 습득했는지; 2) AI를 사용하면 방금 작성한 코드를 이해할 가능성이 낮아졌는지 여부
비록 예비적이긴 하지만, 이러한 결과는 기업이 AI로 작성한 코드와 사람이 작성한 코드의 비율을 더 높이는 방식으로 전환함에 따라 중요한 고려 사항을 제시함
여기에서 AI는 잠재적인 긴장감을 조성함 · 코딩이 더욱 자동화되고 작업 속도가 빨라짐에 따라 인간에게는 여전히 오류를 포착하고 출력을 안내하며 궁극적으로 고위험 환경에 배포된 AI를 감독하는 기술이 필요함

articles.title: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
articles.descEn: Google for Mexico 2026 highlights how AI and local partnerships drive economic growth and social impact. See the latest innovations and report results.
articles.titleEn: Google for Mexico: Technology impact that goes beyond business
summaryLinesEn: Sebastian Valverde, Country Managing Director for Google Mexico, reports that our tools contributed 382 billion pesos to the local economy in 2025.
In our latest Economic Impact Report, we confirmed that Google’s tools contributed over 382 billion Mexican pesos in economic activity across Mexico in 2025.

And because the future belongs to the next generation, Google.org contributed with $1.65 million in funding to UNICEF to support digital literacy and online safety programmes for children and adolescents across Latin America.

localization.title: Google for Mexico: 비즈니스를 넘어서는 기술의 영향
summaryLines: Google Mexico의 국가 관리 이사인 Sebastian Valverde는 Google 도구가 2025년 지역 경제에 3,820억 페소를 기여했다고 보고함
최신 경제 영향 보고서에서는 Google 도구가 2025년 멕시코 전역의 경제 활동에 3,820억 페소가 넘는 멕시코 페소를 기여했음을 확인함
그리고 미래는 다음 세대에게 달려 있기 때문에 Google.org에서는 라틴 아메리카 전역의 어린이와 청소년을 위한 디지털 읽기 쓰기 능력 및 온라인 안전 프로그램을 지원하기 위해 UNICEF에 165만 달러의 기금을 기부함

articles.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
articles.descEn: A Blog post by Dharma-AI on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
summaryLinesEn: So we took 272 real supervised fine-tuning (SFT) jobs from our production pool of NVIDIA H200 GPUs, about 7,382 GPU-hours in total, and compared analytical estimates against learned predictors.
A CatBoost regressor that only sees information available before dispatch reaches R² = 0.98, with a mean absolute error of 1.71 h and a median error of 0.51 h in 5-fold cross-validation.
The short version: the usual FLOP-based estimate explains little of what we observed (R² = 0.31, MAE 12.41 h).

articles.title: Ghostwriter’s performance review
articles.descEn: We asked five customers for feedback on Ghostwriter. One theme runs through all of their answers: by the time someone sits down to look at a problem, Ghostwriter has usually found it, understood the cause, or drafted a change to fix it.
articles.titleEn: Ghostwriter’s performance review
summaryLinesEn: One theme runs through all of their answers: by the time someone sits down to look at a problem, Ghostwriter has usually found it, understood the cause, or drafted a change to fix it.
It had already found the likely cause and listed the affected customers, and it later confirmed when things recovered.
Ghostwriter is an AI teammate that helps our customers build their agents.

articles.title: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Stretto replaced its web-form lead capture with Tara, an AI voice agent built on Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that conducts bankruptcy intake interviews by phone and qualifies leads. See how Stretto, the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, and CI&T designed the voice architecture, validated it for sensitive conversations, and moved it to production.
articles.titleEn: How Stretto built an AI voice agent with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: When a caller dials the Bankruptcy.com number, Tara picks up, introduces herself, and guides the caller through a structured conversation.

The team chose Amazon Nova 2 Sonic over the previous voice solution for three reasons: Cost: Stretto reports a 95 percent reduction in per-minute voice cost compared to its previous solution, based on Amazon Bedrock on-demand pricing in us-east-1 as of April 2026.

Stretto used Twilio for telephony because Tara’s intake is fully automated, with no human agents taking calls, and because Stretto wanted a direct integration with Amazon Nova 2 Sonic that kept its existing AWS backend in place.

articles.title: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Many enterprises run a centralized network model: one account owns every VPC and a central firewall inspects all traffic. This post shows a tested pattern for connecting Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs and MCP servers in that model, with the VPC Lattice resource gateway in the network account so every hop crosses the firewall.
articles.titleEn: Connect Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to private APIs in a hub-and-spoke network with centralized inspection | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Share one resource configuration per backend with the AgentCore account through AWS RAM.
Self-managed mode, as documented, places it in subnets with direct access to the backend, which fits environments that do not require inspection between the Gateway and the tool.
Agents that call internal REST APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers through Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, must meet the same two requirements.

articles.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
articles.descEn: A Blog post by RadixArk on Hugging Face
articles.titleEn: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
summaryLinesEn: We trained it on long-horizon agent tasks with sessions up to 1M tokens, with just 1,200 curated tasks in 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs.

The learning runs on our internal training backend, which is built for agent training: each step learns from a handful of very long sessions, some as long as 1M tokens, folded into multiple trajectories via harness summarization. 57% lower training cost.
Each attempt gets up to 1.5 hours in a sandbox, with more than 100 tool calls and more than 256K output tokens.

articles.title: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Learn how Salesforce uses the cross-Region inference router in Amazon SageMaker AI to turn fragmented Regional capacity into reliable model serving. Salesforce adds capacity securely across Regions and accounts while keeping its data residency commitments, and sees per request where each call was served and why.
articles.titleEn: How Salesforce is advancing global-scale model serving with cross-Region inference routing in Amazon SageMaker AI | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Why serving these models makes capacity a reliability problem Salesforce’s Agentforce Foundation team serves customers from the Region their requests come from, across 30+ global Regions and hundreds of AWS accounts, and they provision capacity based on each customer’s traffic.

Traffic stays in us-west-2 while the local endpoint is saturated, shifts to us-east-2 once requests begin returning errors (peaking at about 78 percent), then returns gradually to us-west-2 over about 10 minutes after recovery
The team needed a managed, capacity-aware routing path.

articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now supports private certificate authorities (CAs), so your agents can connect to self-hosted identity providers that use a private CA. This post shows how to issue an IdP certificate with AWS Private CA, configure a credential provider to trust it, rotate the CA, and protect the certificate.
articles.titleEn: Private certificate authority support in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: In most Keycloak deployments, the discovery, JWKS, and token endpoints share one hostname.
With private CA support in AgentCore Identity , a capability of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, your agents can now connect to these IdPs while trusting the private CA that your organization already uses.
Regions : Private CA support depends on VPC Lattice and is available in the AWS Regions where AgentCore Identity supports private IdPs.

articles.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
articles.descEn: Google introduces Gemini 4 Neon, delivering frontier-level intelligence for complex coding and analysis at a lower cost. See what's new.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
summaryLinesEn: The model is priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached input tokens, a 95% discount) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window.

Delivers across enterprise, analytical, and scientific work Brings efficiency and control to production-grade workflows Built for fast, efficient, frontier-level cyber defense Neon ranks ahead of comparable models and #3 overall with a score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at its xhigh thinking level, landing just behind larger, slower models.

We found that with real-time safeguards at its highest thinking level, Neon resisted every attack within this Gray Swan benchmark, matching the 0.0% attack success rate reached only by other Gemini models.

articles.title: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
articles.descEn: Claude Fable 5.2 has solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes and the search for a theory of quantum gravity.
articles.titleEn: Claude Fable 5.2 solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
summaryLinesEn: He asked Claude to draw up a list of interesting open problems in theoretical physics, specifically focusing on black holes and the bootstrap method.

Bo Sundborg in 1999, and after him Ofer Aharony, Joseph Marsano, Shiraz Minwalla, Kyriakos Papadodimas, and Mark Van Raamsdonk, showed that even at weak coupling, the theory on the rim goes through a transition as it heats up.
Black holes are a natural testing ground, because they’re one of the few areas where both relativity and quantum mechanics matter—they pack immense mass into a very small space.

localization.title: Claude Fable 5.2는 블랙홀 물리학의 두 가지 미해결 문제를 해결함
summaryLines: 그는 Claude에게 이론 물리학에서 특히 블랙홀과 부트스트랩 방법에 초점을 맞춘 흥미로운 공개 문제 목록을 작성하도록 요청함
1999년 Bo Sundborg와 그 이후 Ofer Aharony, Joseph Marsano, Shiraz Minwalla, Kyriakos Papadodimas 및 Mark Van Raamsdonk는 약한 결합에서도 림에 대한 이론이 가열되면서 전환을 겪는다는 것을 보여주었음
블랙홀은 상대성이론과 양자역학이 모두 중요한 몇 안 되는 영역 중 하나이기 때문에 자연스러운 시험장임 · 블랙홀은 아주 작은 공간에 엄청난 질량을 담고 있음

articles.title: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Airbnb runs evals on real engineering tasks and uses Amazon Bedrock observability to choose models for its coding agents and control production costs. This post shows how cost per task guides model selection, why production spending can differ from eval results, and how to monitor latency, manage quotas, and attribute spend.
articles.titleEn: How Airbnb uses cost per task to operate coding agents on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Bedrock also publishes EstimatedTPMQuotaUsage , which measures your estimated tokens per minute (TPM) quota consumption, including cache write tokens and output burndown multipliers, across all inference APIs ( Converse , InvokeModel , ConverseStream , and InvokeModelWithResponseStream ).
As coding agents move into production, changes in models and usage can affect latency, capacity, and cost.
We explain how cost per task guides model selection and how production data helps us revisit those choices as usage changes.

articles.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
articles.descEn: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
articles.titleEn: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
summaryLinesEn: Below, we share an overview of what’s available at each CVP access level, as well as requirements for security and privacy controls: To assess the efficacy of our CVP protections, we ran Claude Opus 5.5 through CyScenarioBench—an evaluation that measures whether models can plan and execute multi-stage cyber operations under realistic constraints—with safeguards tuned for our different CVP tiers.

Frontier Red Team Oct 27, 2026 Discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in critical, real-world software with Claude We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
The changes we’re making to our Cyber Verification Program today are intended to extend the impact of Project Glasswing to a much larger number of cyber defenders.

articles.title: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: When looking to cut AI costs, teams often start with budgets or open-source models. But agent traces can reveal other opportunities to save.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Unity Gateway Insights | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: The $1.2M we found came from just seven small bugs in our MCP servers: $499K in wasted tokens plus 12,000 hours of engineers waiting on agents.

At Databricks, trace analysis surfaced several: offline replays showed no performance gain from upgrading from Opus 4.8 to Opus 5, so we stayed on the cheaper 4.8; fixing common MCP errors recovered an estimated $1.2M in costs a year ; and traces showed that simple prompts were going to expensive models, prompting us to adopt Smart Routing .
If you already have traffic flowing through Unity Gateway, open AI Gateway > Observability > Insights and generate a report for the last day, 7 days, or 30 days.

articles.title: Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Exa's neural search engine is backed by an in-house vector database, so the unit economics of embedding tens of billions of web documents drive the business. This post shares how Exa optimized embedding inference on AWS Neuron hardware (Inferentia2 and Trainium2) with custom NKI kernels, reaching a 47% gain in performance and cost per million documents.
articles.titleEn: Exa boosts embedding throughput by 50% to index billions of documents on AWS AI chips | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: We selected 30 billion high-priority documents for re-embedding.
In total, our final version was a 47% improvement in performance and cost per 1 million documents embedded, against our initial baseline.
Shifting hardware profiles lets us free up nodes other teams need or absorb their unused reserved compute.

articles.title: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
articles.descEn: Investor fears about AI balance sheets and debt are running high, especially for neoclouds. ETFs targeting the credit default swaps of AI issuers are coming.
articles.titleEn: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
summaryLinesEn: CoreWeave executives have taken their messaging about the debt public, with co-founder and chief strategy officer Brian Venturo posting on X.com on Wednesday that he had purchased $30 million in unsecured company bonds and was going to hold them until maturity in 2031.
Oracle CDS contracts have moved up over the past year from below 80 to a current range above 300.

"As AI infrastructure investment accelerates and companies take on significant capital commitments to fund that growth, we see an opportunity to give investors more targeted tools to manage credit risk and hedge potential financial stress across some of the biggest names driving the AI buildout," Sylvia Jablonski, CIO of Defiance ETFs, said in a statement to CNBC.

sourceContent.headline: Big bets against AI debt, from CoreWeave to Oracle and the Mag 7, could soon hit the ETF market
sourceContent.description: Investor fears about AI balance sheets and debt are running high, especially for neoclouds. ETFs targeting the credit default swaps of AI issuers are coming.
paragraphs: CoreWeave executives have taken their messaging about the debt public, with co-founder and chief strategy officer Brian Venturo posting on X.com on Wednesday that he had purchased $30 million in unsecured company bonds and was going to hold them until maturity in 2031.
Oracle CDS contracts have moved up over the past year from below 80 to a current range above 300.

"As AI infrastructure investment accelerates and companies take on significant capital commitments to fund that growth, we see an opportunity to give investors more targeted tools to manage credit risk and hedge potential financial stress across some of the biggest names driving the AI buildout," Sylvia Jablonski, CIO of Defiance ETFs, said in a statement to CNBC.
Concerns about the debt being issued by artificial intelligence companies, particularly so-called neocloud companies, have been running high all year and pushing up credit default swap spreads.
Tuttle Capital and Defiance have filed for ETFs that would use CDS to gain when credit risk worsens for AI-linked companies including CoreWeave and Oracle.
Jensen Huang’s exit as Nvidia CEO has added uncertainty around Nvidia’s role in financing parts of the AI build-out and the financial situation of many players in the sector.
sourceContent.text:
CoreWeave executives have taken their messaging about the debt public, with co-founder and chief strategy officer Brian Venturo posting on X.com on Wednesday that he had purchased $30 million in unsecured company bonds and was going to hold them until maturity in 2031.

Oracle CDS contracts have moved up over the past year from below 80 to a current range above 300.

"As AI infrastructure investment accelerates and companies take on significant capital commitments to fund that growth, we see an opportunity to give investors more targeted tools to manage credit risk and hedge potential financial stress across some of the biggest names driving the AI buildout," Sylvia Jablonski, CIO of Defiance ETFs, said in a statement to CNBC.

Concerns about the debt being issued by artificial intelligence companies, particularly so-called neocloud companies, have been running high all year and pushing up credit default swap spreads.

Tuttle Capital and Defiance have filed for ETFs that would use CDS to gain when credit risk worsens for AI-linked companies including CoreWeave and Oracle.

Jensen Huang’s exit as Nvidia CEO has added uncertainty around Nvidia’s role in financing parts of the AI build-out and the financial situation of many players in the sector.

"As AI infrastructure investment accelerates and companies take on significant capital commitments to fund that growth, we see an opportunity to give investors more targeted tools to manage credit risk and hedge potential financial stress across some of the biggest names driving the AI buildout," Sylvia Jablonski, CIO of Defiance ETFs, said in a statement to CNBC.

summaryLines: CoreWeave 경영진은 공동 창립자이자 최고 전략 책임자인 Brian Venturo가 수요일에 X.com에 3천만 달러의 무담보 회사 채권을 구입했으며 2031년 만기까지 이를 보유할 것이라고 게시하면서 부채 공개에 대한 메시지를 받았음
Oracle CDS 계약은 작년에 80 미만에서 현재 300 이상으로 증가함

Defiance ETFs의 CIO인 Sylvia Jablonski는 CNBC에 보낸 성명에서 "AI 인프라 투자가 가속화되고 기업들이 성장 자금을 조달하기 위해 상당한 자본을 투자함에 따라 우리는 투자자들에게 신용 위험을 관리하고 AI 구축을 주도하는 일부 유명 기업의 잠재적 금융 스트레스를 헤지할 수 있는 보다 표적화된 도구를 제공할 수 있는 기회를 보고 있습니다"라고 말함

summaryLinesEn: OneTrust has raised $1.13 billion to date, including $150 million in 2023 at a valuation of $4.5 billion.

articles.titleEn: Lam Research Corporation (LRCX): Long-Term Competitive Advantage Outweighs AI Buildout Volatility
summaryLinesEn: On November 16, 2026, Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) closed at $210.83 per share with a market capitalization of $263.36 billion.

This, despite the company reporting strong quarterly results underlined by accelerating revenue and operating income growth to 30% and 41%, year on-year, respectively, guiding for further acceleration into next quarter with revenue growth of over 50%.

We remain shareholders and believe that Lam is well positioned to benefit from several robust secular tailwinds – from the AI buildout which is driving broad demand for semiconductors, to the increasing complexity and verticalization of chips over time, which raises the number of etch and deposition steps, increasing the demand for Lam's tools."

localization.title: Lam Research Corporation(LRCX): 장기적인 경쟁 우위가 AI 구축 변동성을 능가함
summaryLines: 2026년 11월 16일 Lam Research Corporation(NASDAQ:LRCX)의 시가총액은 2,633억 6천만 달러로 주당 210.83달러로 마감됨
이는 회사가 매출 및 영업 이익 성장을 전년 동기 대비 각각 30% 및 41%로 가속화하여 강력한 분기별 결과를 보고했음에도 불구하고 50% 이상의 매출 성장으로 다음 분기에 더욱 가속화할 수 있도록 안내함
우리는 주주로 남아 있으며 Lam이 반도체에 대한 광범위한 수요를 주도하는 AI 구축에서부터 시간이 지남에 따라 칩의 복잡성 및 수직화 증가로 인해 식각 및 증착 단계 수가 증가하고 Lam의 도구에 대한 수요가 증가하는 등 여러 가지 강력한 세속적 순풍으로부터 이익을 얻을 수 있는 좋은 위치에 있다고 믿음"

articles.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
articles.descEn: Google is rebranding its Spark AI assistant as “tasks” and making it free for all Gemini users. It’s also rolling out additional capabilities for users in the US, including the ability for Gemini to call businesses and check out with Google Pay.
articles.titleEn: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
summaryLinesEn: Google first introduced its Spark AI agent in May , but it was only available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.

Users in the US will get access to a few other features, including the ability for the AI agent to call businesses to compare product pricing and check inventory, purchase items with Google Pay, and sign into accounts that support Google Password Manager.
Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as “Tasks” and making it free to use.

articles.title: AI Is Giving Optical Computing Another Shot
articles.descEn: The push to cut AI inference’s energy use could pay off in unexpected ways
articles.titleEn: AI Is Giving Optical Computing Another Shot
summaryLinesEn: Over the past few years, though, optical computing has emerged as a fast-growing industry: Market valuation of companies in this sector now totals US $2.22 billion, up from $0.4 billion in 2022.
Taking all of these caveats into account, optical-computing companies today are aiming for a 10- to 80-fold improvement in energy efficiency over today’s GPUs.
The idea of computing with light has been around for over 70 years, but until recently it’s remained largely in the realm of research.

articles.title: AI agents are starting to fill out medical forms and file insurance requests in place of human staff
articles.descEn: OpenAI wants GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6 Luna to automate administrative tasks in US healthcare through computer-use agents that operate existing clinic software and insurance portals the way a human would. Luna handles tasks like prior authorizations for about 8.5 cents each. Companies including CVS Health and Cigna Healthcare are already deploying the technology.
articles.titleEn: AI agents are starting to fill out medical forms and file insurance requests in place of human staff
summaryLinesEn: GPT-6 Astra scored 94.3 percent of possible points.
GPT-6 Luna, built for low API pricing , scored 91.8 percent and, according to OpenAI, cost about 8.5 cents per task, 98 percent less than Astra.
Physician reviewers rated 99 percent of the 325 tasks evaluated as clinically safe.

articles.title: AI Told These Ex-Google Guys How to Build a Billion-Dollar Weapons Business
articles.descEn: Google and Apple alumni Chad Steelberg and Andy Baynes are applying what they learned running software companies and designing iPhones to manufacturing lethal munitions.
articles.titleEn: AI Told These Ex-Google Guys How to Build a Billion-Dollar Weapons Business
summaryLinesEn: Today, he has proprietary munition and missile designs, several government partnerships, and a defense-as-a-service business valued at more than $1 billion.
In 2016, he bought a local life-science tech company with the aim of accelerating next-generation medicines through automating clinical trials and improving protein modeling.
After the Russian invasion, Baynes set himself up in Budapest for around six months to help with the logistics of evacuating women and children and moving equipment into the country.

articles.title: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
articles.descEn: After sounding an alarm about the issue, Apple is taking steps to limit Mac disk access to AI agents.
articles.titleEn: Apple adds new disk controls to prevent AI agents from running amok - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The issue rose to prominence in September, when Inc. columnist Jason Aten noticed that Meta's Muse Mac app was able to access his messages even though he thought he had denied that permission.

In its latest macOS beta, Apple introduced controls to ensure that users will need to take "very explicit" actions to grant apps like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini "this extraordinary level of [full disk] access."
As screen grabs from X user @madeby_ldt show, Apple's Full Disk Access setting now requires explicit permissions to be granted from a scary-looking pop-up screen.

articles.title: The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output
articles.descEn: The US is tightening its chip export controls. Data centers in third countries like Singapore and Malaysia will soon need a US license to buy Nvidia chips, closing the loophole that let Chinese firms rent cloud compute abroad. A Reuters investigation also reveals how China offsets its hardware shortage through industrial-scale distillation of US AI models.
articles.titleEn: The US wants to block China from renting AI power abroad but China already built a parallel supply chain from US AI output
summaryLinesEn: Nvidia's stock fell as much as 2.9 percent after the announcement, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped up to 5.5 percent.
US officials also confronted Chinese regulators in Chengdu as early as July because Washington sees mass distillation as the main reason for China's rapid AI catch-up, according to Reuters.
The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) at the US Commerce Department now wants to shut down that workaround with an interim rule .

articles.title: Proton's Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
articles.descEn: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.
articles.titleEn: Proton's Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
summaryLinesEn: The company says it’s investing in its infrastructure, with its first Nvidia B300 cluster built on Open Compute Project (OCP) standards now going live in Switzerland.
Only this week, for instance, Apple announced it was addressing those privacy concerns with tightened security settings for apps that request Full Disk Access, as the AI desktop apps do.

Already, the major model makers, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and others, offer desktop tools for working with their AI technologies, but doing so invites increased risk to users’ personal data .

articles.title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6.2 Astra for professional work and GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday work - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: GPT-6.2 Astra comes less than two months after OpenAI called off the planned October release of GPT-6.1 Astra, after internal testing found the model fell short on staying within scope and authorization.
The decision was announced the day before the company’s DevDay event in September, where GPT-6.1 Sol launched on its own.

Like GPT-6 Astra, both GPT-6.2 models meet the Critical threshold for cybersecurity under OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework, and their increased capabilities have led the company to launch them with tighter safeguards for higher-risk cybersecurity assistance that are also said to restrict some legitimate vulnerability research.

articles.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
articles.descEn: The French CEO of Hugging Face, a mega-hub of open-source AI software, says the attack by OpenAI models earlier this year proved one thing: Humanity can’t let AI be controlled by the few.
articles.titleEn: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
summaryLinesEn: Clément Delangue, CEO of the open-source AI company Hugging Face , may go down in history as one of the first people ever attacked by a rogue AI agent.
Delangue moved to the US more than a decade ago, “barely speaking English,” and built Hugging Face into a platform that supports tens of millions of AI developers.
Despite championing the democratization of AI, however, Hugging Face was acquired by one of the industry’s biggest players, Nvidia, for $12.93 billion in September.

articles.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
articles.descEn: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, two new models that are more capable and cheaper than their predecessors. In the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Astra ranks second behind Claude Fable 5.2, and it is the first released model to reach the High threshold for AI self-improvement on OpenAI's own scale. OpenAI itself classifies that as a risk.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
summaryLinesEn: On the internal GDPval-v2 benchmark, which includes consulting, finance, and design tasks, OpenAI says Astra gains 6.2 percentage points over its predecessor while using 22 percent fewer output tokens.
On the coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, which checks whether code changes meet the quality bar of real projects, Sol trails Astra by just 0.5 points at one-fifth the cost.

On Agents' Last Exam, a benchmark that tests multi-step professional workflows, GPT-6.2 Astra scores 5.2 points above its predecessor GPT-6 Astra at less than a third of the cost, according to OpenAI.

articles.title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram
articles.descEn: Meta’s rules allow AI-generated videos of people if they’re labeled. Earlier in November, a Meta executive shared an AI clip of rival Sam Altman.

summaryLinesEn: Leading up to the midterm elections, for example, political groups ran millions of dollars’ worth of AI-generated ads attacking opponents.

Meta requires AI-generated videos depicting people to be labeled as AI, like Wang’s post is.

articles.title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
articles.descEn: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.
articles.titleEn: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
summaryLinesEn: Tasks was initially launched to select testers back in May as Gemini Spark, a 24/7 agentic helper, and was expanded to U.S. subscribers of its Google AI Ultra tier.
Users merely flip a toggle within the app from Chat to Tasks, which enables the feature.

Unlike Gemini’s Chat, which merely allows users to talk to Google’s AI assistant for informational purposes, Tasks empowers the app to complete basic secretarial functions, deputizing it as a kind of personal assistant.

articles.title: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit
articles.descEn: Nvidia's interim CEO reaffirmed its open source AI strategy and plans to acquire Hugging Face, despite Jensen Huang's sudden departure.
articles.titleEn: Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang's exit
summaryLinesEn: Kress also spoke about Nvidia’s plans for Hugging Face, a platform for open source AI models that the company agreed to acquire for $12.9 billion in September, in what would be the second-largest acquisition in Nvidia’s history.
She also noted that open models were accelerating AI adoption, citing a 35-fold year-over-year surge in weekly token volume on OpenRouter, including a 3.5-fold increase over the past three months.
Correction: Due to a typo, an earlier version of this article incorrectly stated the number of developers served by Hugging Face; it is 18 million, not 118 million.

articles.title: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
articles.descEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents Microsoft Source
articles.titleEn: Microsoft and organizations across industries launch AI Transparency Initiative to strengthen enterprise trust in AI models and agents
summaryLinesEn: Follow the news from Microsoft Ignite, where Microsoft and industry leaders will share insights on how organizations can manage AI models and agents with confidence.

We’re proud to work with Microsoft on the AI Transparency Initiative to help establish open, industrywide standards that give organizations the visibility and control they need to deploy AI responsibly at scale.”

At Microsoft Ignite on Tuesday, Microsoft Chairman and CEO Satya Nadella announced the next phase of Microsoft’s commitment to making AI safer: the AI Transparency Initiative, a collaborative effort with customers and partners to establish a common, open approach to security and governance across models and providers.

articles.title: Built on object storage, served from cache | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Object storage gives Lakebase Postgres its foundation: durable, bottomless storage, instant branches and restores, and one copy of data for transactions and analytics (LTAP).
articles.titleEn: Built on object storage, served from cache | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: They come from old branches, restores, or databases waking up after weeks idle, and once that data is cached, the next reads are local again.

The common argument against running Postgres on object storage goes like this: Object storage is built for larger requests at higher latency, and a single read from it can take hundreds of milliseconds Therefore, a Postgres backed by object storage must be a slow Postgres
The rare reads that do reach object storage are one-offs.

articles.title: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
articles.descEn: NVIDIA’s Ian Buck kicked off the company’s week at SC26 in Chicago on Monday with new tools for AI agents, software that can plan experiments, run code and check results on researchers’ own systems. In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science, the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance […]
articles.titleEn: Ian Buck Kicks Off NVIDIA’s Week at SC26 as Science Enters the Age of Agents
summaryLinesEn: Nsight AI Porting Agent: NVIDIA’s new agent ported a routine from the Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) model to GPUs, Buck said, speeding it up more than 5x using about 150 million tokens.
In NVIDIA’s special address, Buck announced Nemotron for Science , the Rubin HPC GPU and an expanded Vera CPU platform for high-performance computing .
Buck said a simulation on Jülich’s JUPITER supercomputer showed that a technique called magic state cultivation can cut the operations needed for one logical step tenfold.

articles.title: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
articles.descEn: Learn how Arm architecture shapes cloud, gaming, and on-device AI workloads—and how to test, optimize, and scale your software for Arm.
articles.titleEn: Your users are already on Arm – is your software targeting it?
summaryLinesEn: With 99% of smartphones running on Arm, around 50% of Arm-based compute shipped to leading hyperscalers, and more than 350 billion Arm-based chips shipped to date, the Arm architecture already powers many of the platforms developers build for every day.
Once running, benchmarking tools such as Arm Performix can help provide insights into hotspots, memory usage, and CPU efficiency to guide optimization.
That means you can continue building through the operating systems, containers, libraries, and cloud services already in your workflow.

summaryLines: 99%의 스마트폰이 Arm에서 실행되고, Arm 기반 컴퓨팅의 약 50%가 주요 하이퍼스케일러에 배송되었으며, 현재까지 3,500억 개 이상의 Arm 기반 칩이 배송된 가운데 Arm 아키텍처는 이미 개발자가 매일 구축하는 많은 플랫폼을 지원하고 있음
일단 실행되면 Arm Performix와 같은 벤치마킹 도구는 핫스팟, 메모리 사용량 및 CPU 효율성에 대한 통찰력을 제공하여 최적화를 안내하는 데 도움이 될 수 있음
즉, 이미 워크플로에 있는 운영 체제, 컨테이너, 라이브러리 및 클라우드 서비스를 통해 계속해서 구축할 수 있음

articles.title: Arm enables the world’s fastest and most energy-efficient supercomputers
articles.descEn: The November 2026 TOP500 and Green500 rankings showcase the breadth of the Arm high-performance computing (HPC) ecosystem.
articles.titleEn: Arm enables the world’s fastest and most energy-efficient supercomputers
summaryLinesEn: ⚡ The latest milestone in our collaboration highlights the importance of CPU and accelerator co-design in scaling AI We're expanding Arm Flexible Access and Arm Total Access with the new Arm Cortex-M42 processor.

With 5 of the top 10 and 14 of the top 30 most energy-efficient systems incorporating Arm technology, the rankings reflect the growing adoption of Arm across supercomputing and AI platforms designed to deliver more compute within constrained power budgets.

Arm technology across the world’s leading supercomputers From the world’s most powerful supercomputers to the most energy-efficient systems, Arm technology is helping advance HPC through a diverse range of processors and platforms, including Arm-compatible custom processors and Arm Neoverse-based accelerated systems.

articles.title: GTA VI Pre-Orders Break $1B | Sensor Tower Report
articles.descEn: GTA VI's $1.1B in pre-orders is the largest pre-launch total on record. Here is what the launch means for every other game, and for the phones of its players.
articles.titleEn: GTA VI Pre-Orders Break $1B | Sensor Tower Report
summaryLinesEn: Sensor Tower estimates the game's audience on Android phones in the United States is 72% male and 57% under 35, with a typical age of 34 and middle-income purchasing power.
In the 28 days after Monster Hunter Wilds launched, daily active users across the rest of the PlayStation catalog worldwide fell 7.6% versus the 28 days before.

Sensor Tower's, The Attention Heist: GTA VI's Impact on Consumer Engagement report, sizes the launch, measures how past AAA releases affected the console market, and profiles the average GTA VI player on mobile.

articles.title: How ArisGlobal scaled generative AI inference on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: ArisGlobal runs NavaX, its life-sciences AI engine, on Amazon Bedrock. By caching the shared prompt prefix instead of each per-case document, ArisGlobal cut effective input cost by about 50% and overall monthly inference spend by about 40%, while onboarding more tenants without proportional cost growth.
articles.titleEn: How ArisGlobal scaled generative AI inference on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: As enterprise customers added distinct compliance requirements, the shared prompt prefix grew by about 150% over 6 months, while per-case inference costs increased by more than 200%.
When NavaX launched with its first enterprise tenant, the system prompt was lean.
By reversing the order and caching the shared prefix instead, ArisGlobal reduced effective input cost and supported additional tenants without proportional cost growth.

By reversing the order and caching the shared prefix instead, ArisGlobal reduced effective input cost and supported additional tenants without proportional cost growth.

articles.title: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
articles.descEn: Azure Databricks on Azure Government is in Beta. See what agencies can achieve today and what's next for AI as we work toward FedRAMP Class D and IL5.
articles.titleEn: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Government agencies and their mission-critical partners face a persistent dilemma: adopt the latest data and AI innovations, or meet the stringent security and compliance requirements their missions demand.
Databricks recently launched the FedRAMP Class D offering on Azure Commercial.

Government agencies and the hundreds of organizations that support them now have access to the modern data foundation already transforming industries across the commercial sector, including Unity Catalog, Databricks SQL, and serverless compute, with the complete suite of AI capabilities to follow, all within an environment working toward FedRAMP Class D (formerly “High”) and DoW IL5 authorization.

articles.title: Responsible AI for agentic AI: A phased roadmap for platform and application teams | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Enterprises adopting agentic AI at scale need platforms that embed responsible AI from the start. This post gives platform and application teams a three-phase roadmap (governance foundation, pilot deployment, and evaluation and hardening) that maps the AWS Responsible AI Lens pillars to each phase, with guidance on when to revisit each one.
articles.titleEn: Responsible AI for agentic AI: A phased roadmap for platform and application teams | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: Organizations are turning Responsible AI, which includes the pillars of security and privacy, veracity and robustness, fairness, safety, controllability, explainability, transparency, and governance into a growth strategy by addressing its expanding scope early.

We break the journey into three phases and present prioritized responsible AI pillars across a customizable 12-week implementation timeline, allowing the platform team to establish a solid responsible AI foundation while their first use cases take shape.
The application teams classify risks for each planned use case using a risk rubric.

summaryLines: 조직은 확장된 범위를 조기에 해결함으로써 보안 및 개인 정보 보호, 진실성 및 견고성, 공정성, 안전, 제어 가능성, 설명 가능성, 투명성 및 거버넌스의 핵심 요소를 포함하는 책임 있는 AI를 성장 전략으로 전환하고 있음
우리는 여정을 3단계로 나누고 사용자 정의 가능한 12주 구현 타임라인에 걸쳐 우선 순위가 지정된 책임 있는 AI 원칙을 제시함 · 이를 통해 플랫폼 팀은 첫 번째 사용 사례가 구체화되는 동안 견고한 책임 있는 AI 기반을 구축할 수 있음
애플리케이션 팀은 위험 기준표를 사용하여 계획된 각 사용 사례에 대한 위험을 분류함

articles.title: Google Wallet is now available on iOS in the U.S.
articles.descEn: Google Wallet is now available on iOS in the U.S. Manage your tickets, boarding passes, and receipts in one secure hub. Get the details.
articles.titleEn: Google Wallet is now available on iOS in the U.S.
summaryLinesEn: Today, we’re bringing Google Wallet to iOS users across the U.S., making it faster to get what you need and easier to organize purchases, tickets, boarding passes, and more in one easy place.

As we look toward the future of shopping, Google Wallet will also be a secure hub for managing agentic purchases across Google, and today’s update expands access to more people, no matter what type of device they use.
By automatically syncing with your Gmail and other Google apps, Google Wallet keeps your package tracking, digital boarding passes, concert tickets, and receipts anywhere easily across your devices.

localization.title: 이제 미국 iOS에서 Google Wallet을 사용할 수 있음
summaryLines: 오늘 우리는 미국 전역의 iOS 사용자에게 Google Wallet을 제공하여 필요한 것을 더 빠르게 얻고 구매, 티켓, 탑승권 등을 한 곳에서 쉽게 정리할 수 있도록 지원함
쇼핑의 미래를 내다보는 가운데 Google Wallet은 Google 전체에서 구매 대행사를 관리하기 위한 보안 허브가 될 것이며, 오늘 업데이트를 통해 사용하는 기기 유형에 관계없이 더 많은 사람들이 액세스할 수 있게 됨
Google 지갑은 Gmail 및 기타 Google 앱과 자동으로 동기화하여 모든 기기에서 쉽게 배송물 추적, 디지털 탑승권, 콘서트 티켓 및 영수증을 보관함

articles.descEn: Google Home updates bring keyless entry, smarter audio alerts, and faster Gemini performance. See what’s new in the November 2026 update.

summaryLinesEn: Faster Gemini for Home: Gemini for Home now handles everyday requests up to 20% faster and is expanding to six new countries, including India and Brazil.

articles.title: Temporary threads are now available in AI Mode in Search.
articles.descEn: Google AI Mode now offers temporary threads for private searches. Keep your history clean and avoid personalization. Try this new feature today.
articles.titleEn: Temporary threads are now available in AI Mode in Search.
summaryLinesEn: We’re introducing temporary threads in AI Mode, where you can explore and ask questions — whether that’s brainstorming a surprise gift or looking something up you don’t want resurfaced later like in your history or recommendations.
There’s no need to adjust your settings — you can quickly jump into a temporary thread for any query you don't want saved, and switch right back when you're done.
To get started, simply click the temporary threads icon in the upper right corner of AI Mode and start asking your questions.
articles.summary:
We’re introducing temporary threads in AI Mode, where you can explore and ask questions — whether that’s brainstorming a surprise gift or looking something up you don’t want resurfaced later like in your history or recommendations.

articles.title: Put Gemini to work for you
articles.descEn: Tasks in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries, with new features starting in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration to get things done on your behalf.
articles.titleEn: Put Gemini to work for you
summaryLinesEn: I recently stared down a nearly empty fridge rushing out the door in the morning, and I texted Gemini with the new RCS integration 2 : “Add lasagna, strawberries, cucumbers, and vanilla ice cream to our Instacart order.”
Because Gemini already knows we drive a 2019 Honda Odyssey and where we live through Personal Intelligence , it found the nearest shops on Google Maps and called both at once 1 .
Last month it saved us real money after we got hit with a surprise $389 electric bill.

articles.title: How LoanPro built an agentic AI loan servicing assistant with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: LoanPro worked with AWS Partner AllCloud and the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center to build a multi-agent AI assistant on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. It gives loan servicing agents instant borrower context and next-best-action recommendations, reducing customer call times by up to 15 percent.
articles.titleEn: How LoanPro built an agentic AI loan servicing assistant with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: According to LoanPro, the platform serves over 450 lenders, with loans managed on its platform reaching about 31 percent of US households.

Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed service that offers a choice of high-performing foundation models from leading AI companies through a single API, along with the capabilities you need to build generative AI applications with security, privacy, and responsible AI.
The assistant runs on Anthropic’s Claude Sonnet 5.5 , Claude Haiku 5.5 , and Claude Opus 5.5 on Amazon Bedrock (see Models at a glance in Amazon Bedrock ).

articles.title: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare — Abridge
articles.descEn: A clinical AI assistant has to know the patient and pass a health system review before the first question. Matt Troup and Janie Lee on why we built the Abridge Assistant.
articles.titleEn: Meet the AI Assistant for Healthcare — Abridge
summaryLinesEn: Most of the standalone tools I’ve used share the same problem, regardless of how much they tout AI.
Abridge led the shift to ambient AI in clinical documentation, centering the patient conversation and cutting the after-hours charting clinicians used to take home .
The tasks pile up right behind them, and each one means more time clicking through the chart before the shift ends.

articles.title: Healthcare Is Presence: Building the Learning Health System — Abridge
articles.descEn: How AI assistants could finally make the Learning Health System real, and allow clinicians to focus on the patient in front of them.
articles.titleEn: Healthcare Is Presence: Building the Learning Health System — Abridge
summaryLinesEn: The work might include entering data into a registry or a clinical trial management system, calling the inpatient pharmacy to get medications ready, navigating to a payer portal to get authorization for a life saving medication, and scheduling follow-up testing and an outpatient visit.

Twenty years ago, the Institute of Medicine introduced the concept of a Learning Health System: a system that continuously improves, so the right information gets to the right care team member at the right moment.
Today, we partner with more than 300 health systems and support more than 140 million encounters every year.

localization.title: 건강 관리는 존재임 · 학습 건강 시스템 구축 — Abridge
summaryLines: 작업에는 레지스트리 또는 임상시험 관리 시스템에 데이터를 입력하고, 입원환자 약국에 전화하여 약품을 준비하고, 지불인 포털로 이동하여 생명을 구하는 약품에 대한 승인을 받고, 후속 검사 및 외래환자 방문 일정을 잡는 것이 포함될 수 있음
20년 전, Institute of Medicine은 학습 건강 시스템(Learning Health System)이라는 개념을 도입함 · 이는 지속적으로 개선되어 올바른 정보가 적절한 순간에 적절한 진료팀 구성원에게 전달되도록 하는 시스템임
현재 우리는 300개 이상의 의료 시스템과 파트너십을 맺고 매년 1억 4천만 건 이상의 만남을 지원하고 있음

articles.title: Reason over time-series data with OpenTSLM on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: OpenTSLM, an open source family of time-series language models, is now available in Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. See how Nexthink and Aionic Labs apply it to proactive IT support, then deploy OpenTSLM to a real-time endpoint and fine-tune it on your own data with TimeNet and a SageMaker training job.
articles.titleEn: Reason over time-series data with OpenTSLM on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The model has 5.24 billion parameters in total, stored in bfloat16, so its weights take about 10.5 GB of GPU memory.
This data helps prevent production stoppages, diagnose vehicle faults, explain drops in data-center performance, and adjust pricing as supply and demand shift.
In SageMaker JumpStart, OpenTSLM also supports ml.g6.4xlarge , ml.g6.8xlarge , ml.g5.2xlarge , ml.g5.4xlarge , ml.g5.8xlarge , ml.g6e.xlarge , and ml.g6e.2xlarge .
