articles.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
articles.descEn: Bharat Semi says it has secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology with companies including General Atomics.
articles.titleEn: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
summaryLinesEn: Bharat Semi , an Indian semiconductor startup, has raised $24 million in seed funding to develop AI-enabled image sensors, as it seeks to win customers in the United States and elsewhere.

The New Delhi-based startup is developing programmable image sensors that combine image capture, processing, and AI capabilities on a single chip, reducing the need to send visual data to separate processors.
In 2024, Bharat Semi announced plans for a semiconductor fabrication project in India involving a technology partnership with the U.S.

articles.descEn: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images the way other AI models do. Instead of computing pixels, the language model writes Python code that places hundreds of thousands of simulated brushstrokes on a virtual canvas, complete with bristle texture and paint application. A single photorealistic parking garage scene took roughly 700,000 strokes, according to Anthropic employee Jake Eaton.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 doesn't generate images, it paints them
summaryLinesEn: On Anthropic's internal RoboDojo Sim benchmark, Fable 5.2 scored 64.9 percent compared with 29.8 percent for OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra, but fell behind its competitor in speed and fine motor control during a real-world test with a physical robot arm.
Fable 5.2 said it added the roughly seven-pixel wobble on purpose because a human arm doesn't draw a perfectly straight line either.

Anthropic's new language model Claude Fable 5.2 generates images by placing brushstrokes on a virtual canvas through Python code, simulating physical properties such as bristle texture and paint application.

articles.title: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
articles.descEn: Australia's central bank sees early signs that AI is hitting young entry-level workers in highly exposed jobs like software development and customer service. Since ChatGPT launched, job postings and employment among 15- to 24-year-olds in those fields have dropped more sharply than among older workers. Author Mike Major cautions against jumping to conclusions, however, noting that business cycle shifts and remote work trends could also explain the numbers.
articles.titleEn: Australia's central bank finds AI hitting young workers first, especially in software and customer service
summaryLinesEn: Ad An August 2025 Stanford study based on millions of US payroll records found a similar pattern, with employment among 22- to 25-year-olds in AI-exposed occupations down 13 percent in relative terms since late 2022 and nearly 20 percent among young software developers.
AI has barely displaced any jobs in Australia so far, but young workers entering highly exposed fields like software development are faring worse.
A large study of 25,000 workers in Denmark confirms the lack of economy-wide impact.

articles.title: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
articles.descEn: Following revelations about Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy Congress wants to crack down on exports of AI chips.
articles.titleEn: Congress wants to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI Following revelations about Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy Congress wants to crack down.
Bills such as the Remote Access Security Act , first introduced in the House in April 2025 but stalled in the Senate, are receiving renewed interest.
Both Democrats and Republicans have voiced support for various measures and bills that would tighten rules and have demanded that Huang and other Nvidia leaders testify before Congress.

articles.title: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
articles.descEn: Apple’s new Health AI Usage Study launches today with the goal of improving the efficacy of AI-powered health tools.
articles.titleEn: Apple’s new study looks to improve the effectiveness of AI health tools
summaryLinesEn: The company is conducting the Apple Health AI Usage Study in collaboration with OpenEvidence , a clinical AI platform used by healthcare professionals that generates answers based on medical information from sources like The New England Journal of Medicine .

Insights from this study will help advance the broader scientific conversation and ensure that as technology evolves, we continue building trusted tools that genuinely support people wherever they are on their health journey,” said Sumbul Desai, MD, Apple’s vice president of Health and Fitness.
The app is now available for download, and enrollment starts today, with Apple looking for up to 200,000 people to contribute.

articles.title: AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
articles.descEn: YouTube Music and Spotify want synthetic hosts to curate your playlists. Their awkward banter and bogus song trivia are ruining the vibe.
articles.titleEn: AI DJs Completely Kill My Groove
summaryLinesEn: Although Spotify claims it has “80 percent of listeners coming back to DJ week after week,” according to the company’s launch blog , I won’t be one of them.
YouTube’s AI DJ randomly interjects for about 30 seconds between songs, teeing up the vibe shift and providing context about the next track.
And since I’m a software reporter, I always enable the beta features available through YouTube Labs , which include Beyond the Beat.

articles.title: AT&T uses agentic AI to reinvent business processes from the ground up - SiliconANGLE
articles.descEn: AT&T uses agentic AI to reinvent business processes from the ground up - SiliconANGLE
articles.titleEn: AT&T uses agentic AI to reinvent business processes from the ground up - SiliconANGLE
summaryLinesEn: AT&T now processes about 45 billion AI tokens daily across the company, according to Luke Corbin (pictured, below), assistant vice president of digital transformation and AI at AT&T Business.
AT&T has moved quickly from experimenting with generative AI to systematically identifying business processes that can be redesigned around agentic capabilities.
Corbin said AT&T is now shifting its focus from improving existing processes toward using agents to launch services, enter markets and support new sales channels.

articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
articles.descEn: For the first time in a while, no OpenAI model leads the MathArena AI math benchmark. Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Anthropic's Fable 5.2 have knocked GPT-6.1 Sol from the top, though both cost significantly more. Gemini ignored the time limit in testing and almost never gave up on a task.
articles.titleEn: Gemini 4 Carbon takes the MathArena crown but costs 15 times more than GPT-6.1 Sol
summaryLinesEn: The model also almost never gives up on a task, a trait that can be read as either positive or negative .
In one case, it launched a script that ran for more than eleven hours without checking on its progress.
With the reasoning settings used in testing, Carbon and Fable 5.2 cost roughly 15 and 40 times as much as GPT-6.1 Sol, respectively.

articles.title: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
articles.descEn: Anthropic has made Claude Opus 5.5 the default model on all paid plans and published a guide that does away with old prompting habits. The main takeaway is to drop "think hard" and start at Medium effort.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic says outdated prompting habits are slowing down Claude Opus 5.5
summaryLinesEn: Anyone who regularly cranks Sonnet up to "Extra High" or "Max" effort ends up paying about as much as with Opus 5.5, Anthropic says.
Users who connect Claude to their own files and systems through connectors get significantly more tailored results, Anthropic says, because the model can pull in the information it needs on its own.
Anyone using Claude Opus 5.5 should first drop several prompting habits carried over from older model generations, according to Anthropic.

articles.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
articles.descEn: Fully automated ransomware hasn’t arrived—yet. But seemingly unsophisticated attackers are using AI tools to wreak havoc.
articles.titleEn: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
summaryLinesEn: “What we see is most of the recent increase was fueled by international attacks; the United States was a little more steady, but still high, still a lot of attacks,” says Cynthia Kaiser, former FBI cyber deputy director who now leads research for the anti-ransomware platform Halcyon.

Halcyon’s Kaiser agrees that more actors are using AI to attempt to strike out on their own with expanded capabilities to trick targets, exploit vulnerabilities, check their code, and even compromise other groups’ remote-access tools to gain redundant access to a victim in case one avenue gets blocked.
This would mean a 20 to 40 percent increase since the spring by some estimates.

localization.title: 새로운 AI 기반 랜섬웨어 붐을 조심하세요
summaryLines: 현재 랜섬웨어 방지 플랫폼인 Halcyon의 연구를 이끌고 있는 전직 FBI 사이버 부국장인 Cynthia Kaiser는 "우리가 보고 있는 것은 최근 증가의 대부분이 국제 공격에 의해 촉발되었다는 것임 · 미국은 좀 더 안정적이었지만 여전히 높았으며 여전히 공격이 많았음" · 라고 말함
Halcyon의 Kaiser는 더 많은 공격자가 AI를 사용하여 대상을 속이고, 취약점을 악용하고, 코드를 확인하고, 심지어 한 경로가 차단될 경우 피해자에 대한 중복 액세스를 얻기 위해 다른 그룹의 원격 액세스 도구를 손상시키는 확장된 기능을 통해 스스로 공격을 시도하고 있다는 데 동의함
이는 일부 추정에 따르면 봄 이후 20~40% 증가를 의미함

articles.title: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
articles.descEn: OpenAI is dissolving its standalone robotics team for the second time, but not because it lacks data. General-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can apparently control robots directly, making a dedicated unit unnecessary. The researchers are being redistributed across other teams in what the company frames as a way to accelerate its robotics efforts.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI reassigns robotics researchers to other teams as general-purpose models might make specialized robotics AI unnecessary
summaryLinesEn: Ad In an Nvidia study , an Astra-powered agent achieved a 74.8 percent success rate on simulated robotics tasks, compared to 51 percent for the best specialized models.
OpenAI shut down its robotics division in 2020 because, according to co-founder Wojciech Zaremba, the company lacked the training data it needed and large language models were a faster path to AGI.
OpenAI apparently believes that general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can control robots directly , reducing the need for specialized robotics models.

articles.title: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
articles.descEn: Runway releases its robotics model Praxis-1 with open weights and source code under the Apache 2.0 license. The model uses knowledge from video training for robot control and leads the World Action Model category on Nvidia's RoboLab-120 benchmark. It can't yet plan complex action sequences on its own, though.
articles.titleEn: Runway's open-source Praxis-1 turns video AI into a robot controller
summaryLinesEn: After fine-tuning on about 95 hours of robot data, the model hit an average success rate of 80 percent in simulated tests, according to Runway.
The company first introduced Praxis-1 in late September but initially gave access only to select partners.
Whether the approach actually needs less robot data overall than comparable models without general video pretraining is still an open question.

articles.title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
articles.descEn: Helen Toner, who studies AI safety and policy, says if we need to take AI warnings seriously, and we can’t rely on the tech industry to fix the problem.
articles.titleEn: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
summaryLinesEn: I have wanted to talk to you for 10 million years.

But it’s worth remembering what Helen and the board were supposed to do: OpenAI’s nonprofit board existed specifically to make sure the company didn’t betray its mission to build safe AI by prioritizing profit and growth over safety.

The CEOs of these frontier labs have since called for a slowdown and asked Washington for help, but the White House’s answer was a voluntary accord — one that relies in part on the kind of board accountability that failed at OpenAI.

articles.title: The Microsoft outage didn’t lose your email — here’s what it does mean for you
articles.descEn: No one has confirmed what caused the Microsoft outage that took down Outlook and Copilot, and nothing links it to layoffs or AI, but it's not the first time Microsoft's own changes broke its apps.
articles.titleEn: The Microsoft outage didn’t lose your email — here’s what it does mean for you
summaryLinesEn: On Friday, Microsoft traced the outage to a problem from "an earlier network capacity upgrade" that surfaced after a recent network change, and said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption."
By Friday, Microsoft said it was seeing "encouraging recovery progress."

Chris Versace, chief investment officer at Tematica Research, put the lesson simply: "The outage and how it hobbled many businesses and other enterprises is a reminder about the need for redundancies."

On Friday, Microsoft traced the outage to a problem from "an earlier network capacity upgrade" that surfaced after a recent network change, and said it was "deeply sorry for the disruption."
By Friday, Microsoft said it was seeing "encouraging recovery progress."
Chris Versace, chief investment officer at Tematica Research, put the lesson simply: "The outage and how it hobbled many businesses and other enterprises is a reminder about the need for redundancies."

summaryLinesEn: A lakebase is a transactional database that keeps its data on the lake, in an open format, so agents can create and discard databases on demand and other engines can work with the same data.

With Lakebase, we're building the next category for operational databases. by Kaitlin Baumgardner , Kevin Balaji , Brianna Helm , Jonathan Keller and Susan Pierce Databricks' position as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Lakehouse Platforms validates that we pioneered and established the lakehouse market category.

Databricks is named as the only Visionary in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Cloud Operational Database Management Systems, a strong competitive placement that highlights our strategic vision for the future of operational databases.

summaryLines: 레이크베이스는 데이터를 개방형 형식으로 레이크에 보관하는 트랜잭션 데이터베이스이므로 에이전트는 요청에 따라 데이터베이스를 생성 및 삭제할 수 있고 다른 엔진은 동일한 데이터로 작업할 수 있음

Lakebase를 통해 우리는 운영 데이터베이스를 위한 차세대 카테고리를 구축하고 있음 · 작성자 · Kaitlin Baumgardner, Kevin Balaji, Brianna Helm, Jonathan Keller 및 Susan Pierce Databricks가 2026년 데이터 레이크하우스 플랫폼 부문 Gartner 매직 쿼드런트에서 리더로 선정된 것은 우리가 레이크하우스 시장 카테고리를 개척하고 확립했음을 입증함

articles.title: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
articles.descEn: Artificial intelligence, once a cool feature living exclusively inside your favorite app, is upgrading. Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature. AI is now becoming part of operating systems and amping up how we use and interact with devices. The vision: instead of requiring people to […]
articles.titleEn: How DroiClaw is building an AI-native operating system for the agentic era
summaryLinesEn: The first smartphones shipping with DroiClaw, which currently include devices from Coolpad and Philips, are priced at approximately RMB 1,099 (around US$160).
Now, the shift is toward using AI as the foundation and not simply an added feature.
DroiClaw uses a hybrid architecture that combines on-device AI with cloud-based large language models to support different usage scenarios.

articles.title: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
articles.descEn: ElevenAI is a new meeting notetaker and dictation app aimed at teams and enterprises.
articles.titleEn: ElevenLabs' new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
summaryLinesEn: ElevenLabs also allows companies to integrate ElevenAgent and take follow-up actions such as writing a draft email based on meeting notes.
Plus, there’s a dictation feature, which lets users convert speech to cleaned-up text in any app with support for over 90 languages.
In the last few months, Fireflies , Wispr Flow , and Granola have all released competing capabilities in the dictation and meeting note-taking space.

articles.title: OPPO Partners with Manus to Bring Agentic AI Experiences to Smartphones | OPPO Malaysia
articles.descEn: OPPO today announced a collaboration with Manus, a leading AI agent platform, to bring next-generation agentic AI experiences to smartphones.
articles.titleEn: OPPO Partners with Manus to Bring Agentic AI Experiences to Smartphones | OPPO Malaysia
summaryLinesEn: Designed to move beyond simple question-and-answer interactions, AI Mind Pilot can understand a user's end goal, break it down into multiple steps, identify relevant information, select the appropriate tools, and deliver a finished result, including by working directly with files and photos stored on the device.
"Agentic AI marks an important shift from answering questions to helping users get things done." said Kai Tang, President of Software Engineering at OPPO.

By integrating Manus' agentic capabilities to OPPO AI Mind Pilot, the collaboration will help users turn complex, multi-step tasks into ready-to-use results—advancing OPPO's vision for Personalized Proactive Intelligence, where AI understands users and proactively helps them get things done.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
articles.descEn: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
articles.titleEn: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
summaryLinesEn: Last year, it wrote an $800 million check into a $2 billion Series B round for Reflection AI, before the open source startup began to earn meaningful revenue, according to the Wall Street Journal .

Under Huang, infrastructure companies that needed $100 million to $500 million in GPUs would often raise half of that amount at valuations of $1 billion or more from Nvidia just to get started, one VC said.
Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s embattled CEO who co-founded and led the company for 33 years, had officially stepped down .

articles.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
articles.descEn: OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, which its Dots agents can use to make purchases with your credit or debit cards.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
summaryLinesEn: Follow Follow See All AI OpenAI says ChatGPT Wallet won’t share your actual credit card info with its AI agents.

OpenAI says that in order for agents to use ChatGPT Wallet, “websites need to ensure agents are not inadvertently blocked, and payment and risk systems need to recognize legitimate purchases made by agents.”

Eventually, OpenAI says it expects “users to be able to delegate purchases entirely to their agent by setting clear parameters—such as spending limits, purchase categories, or time periods—and pre-approve those purchases.”

localization.title: ChatGPT 지갑을 사용하면 OpenAI의 Dots 에이전트가 귀하를 대신해 구매할 수 있음
summaryLines: 팔로우 팔로우 모두 보기 AI OpenAI에 따르면 ChatGPT Wallet은 실제 신용 카드 정보를 AI 에이전트와 공유하지 않음
OpenAI는 에이전트가 ChatGPT Wallet을 사용하려면 "웹 사이트는 에이전트가 실수로 차단되지 않도록 해야 하며 결제 및 위험 시스템은 에이전트의 합법적인 구매를 인식해야 합니다"라고 말함
결국 OpenAI는 "사용자가 지출 한도, 구매 카테고리 또는 기간과 같은 명확한 매개변수를 설정하여 구매를 에이전트에게 전적으로 위임하고 해당 구매를 사전 승인할 수 있을 것"을 기대한다고 말함

articles.title: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
articles.descEn: Mansa says its AI microdramas can serve as proofs of concept for what Black audiences want. Critics say the studio is selling out.
articles.titleEn: This Startup Is Betting on AI Microdramas to Get More Black Stories in Hollywood
summaryLinesEn: Despite Black, Indigenous, and people of color moviegoers over-indexing as ticket buyers, representing the majority of opening weekend domestic ticket sales, Black actors accounted for only 6.5 percent of movie leads while Black directors made up 3.3 percent of releases in 2025, according to the 2026 UCLA Hollywood Diversity report .

Hoorae Media, Issa Rae’s production company, expanded into the sector this year with two microdramas, including Screen Time , a couples thriller comedy that, as of October, had over 580 million views across TikTok and its in-house microdrama app, PineDrama.
“Mansa was one of the first vertical apps that was supposed to support and cultivate black talent, but here they are … another AI sellout,” said one user on Threads.

articles.title: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
articles.descEn: Duet is Anthropic’s consumer-grade AI agent, and it’s a helpful partner for catching things that might otherwise slip through the cracks.
articles.titleEn: Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful
summaryLinesEn: I’ll type up my own little blogs, thank you very much Claude.

I wonder if it would change how I work if I knew I didn’t really need to take responsibility for putting things on my calendar, writing down a to-do list, or paying attention in a meeting because Duet will just handle it.
Normally, the products I test don’t offer to help me write up my experience with them.

articles.title: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
articles.descEn: Anthropic's new Claude for Manufacturing plugin connects the AI directly to Autodesk Fusion, Oracle NetSuite, and Infor. Its 17 specialized skills let the AI draft quotes, compare suppliers, and place backup orders when deliveries are delayed, all after human approval. The plugin doesn't control physical machines yet, but Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard for that.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic's Claude for Manufacturing plugs AI directly into factory software to automate industrial workflows
summaryLinesEn: This cuts setup time from weeks or months to hours or minutes but still requires human oversight due to the AI's limited grasp of physical processes.
Anthropic has released Claude for Manufacturing, a plugin giving the AI direct access to industrial software to automate factory workflows.
For that, Anthropic is separately developing the Model Hardware Standard as a research preview, connecting AI agents to devices like robotic arms and microscopes via standardized drivers.

articles.title: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
articles.descEn: ChatGPT Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out on users' behalf, starting with a limited rollout to U.S. Pro subscribers.
articles.titleEn: ChatGPT's new Wallet lets AI agents shop and check out for you
summaryLinesEn: While companies like DoorDash and Uber have so far reported low numbers of orders placed by AI agents, Meta’s Muse, which now has over 10 million users, has seen AI-assisted shopping become a top activity on its app.
On Friday, OpenAI launched a new wallet feature that lets its agents, called dots , help you decide what to buy and then complete the purchase on your behalf.
ChatGPT Pro subscribers, ages 18 and up, with a U.S.-issued Visa, Mastercard, or American Express.

articles.title: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
articles.descEn: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI.
articles.titleEn: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
summaryLinesEn: The issue is growing more urgent as nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI, according to an Ernst and Young survey .
New York has protected state employees from AI displacement by law since late 2025.

Union leaders like Liz Shuler of the AFL-CIO, Lorena Gonzalez, and TWU's John Samuelsen support AI safety systems where they help workers but insist on mandatory human control over every AI application in the workplace, the Guardian reports .
articles.summary:
The issue is growing more urgent as nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI, according to an Ernst and Young survey .
New York has protected state employees from AI displacement by law since late 2025.
Union leaders like Liz Shuler of the AFL-CIO, Lorena Gonzalez, and TWU's John Samuelsen support AI safety systems where they help workers but insist on mandatory human control over every AI application in the workplace, the Guardian reports .

sourceContent.headline: Nearly 70 percent of US agencies use generative AI, and unions are finally catching up with guardrails
sourceContent.description: US public-sector unions are increasingly pushing through protections against AI surveillance and automated firings. In Oakland, a strike vote forced retraining programs instead of layoffs, and a transport union in Ohio won veto power over autonomous vehicles. California banned so-called bossware. All of this is happening while nearly 70 percent of US government agencies already use generative AI.

articles.descEn: Bloomberg found evidence of a network of Chinese companies smuggling NVIDIA chips with Alice Huang at the center.
articles.titleEn: Bloomberg details web of Chinese AI companies with smuggled NVIDIA chips linked to Alice Huang - Engadget
summaryLinesEn: The Shanghai AI facility where the smuggled NVIDIA units were installed is called the Yangtze River Delta Project, which Bloomberg says also has ties to Alice Huang.
Its president is Kang Wei, who is being reported as Alice's husband and the person who introduced her to Jensen Huang .
Former NVIDIA-CEO Jensen Huang is due to testify before Congress this month , and it's likely all of this information will be pored over by officials in the run-up to the event.

articles.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
articles.descEn: New research shows the most advanced AI models from China were trained on banned Nvidia chips.
articles.titleEn: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China's most powerful AI models — uh oh, Jensen!
summaryLinesEn: Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization, estimates that about two million advanced chips entered China in 2024 and 2025 through schemes designed to hide their final destination.

In May, the short-selling research firm Culper published a report arguing that Nvidia had a “ China problem ” because a significant share of its revenue was driven by Chinese demand, either through remote data centers or smuggling in violation of U.S. law.
Epoch’s data estimates that 275,000 Nvidia AI accelerators were imported to Malaysia in 2024 and 2025.

localization.title: 수출이 금지된 Nvidia 칩은 중국의 가장 강력한 AI 모델 뒤에 있음 · 아, Jensen
summaryLines: 비영리 연구 기관인 Epoch AI는 최종 목적지를 숨기려는 계획을 통해 2024년과 2025년에 약 200만 개의 첨단 칩이 중국에 유입된 것으로 추정함
지난 5월, 공매도 조사 회사인 컬퍼(Culper)는 엔비디아가 원격 데이터 센터를 통하거나 미국 법을 위반하여 밀수입하는 등 중국 수요에 의해 수익의 상당 부분을 차지했기 때문에 엔비디아가 "중국 문제"를 안고 있다고 주장하는 보고서를 발표함
Epoch의 데이터에 따르면 2024년과 2025년에 275,000개의 Nvidia AI 가속기가 말레이시아로 수입된 것으로 추정됨

articles.title: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
articles.descEn: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI-powered shopping with ChatGPT Wallet after scrapping its first approach, Instant Checkout. Users register a card once and confirm each purchase through Face ID or a fingerprint, while actual card details stay hidden behind payment tokens. Rivals such as Anthropic, Meta, and xAI already have their agents making purchases.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI rebuilt AI shopping from scratch with ChatGPT Wallet
summaryLinesEn: OpenAI is taking a second shot at AI shopping with ChatGPT Wallet, catching up with rivals like Anthropic, Meta, and xAI, whose agents can already shop online.
OpenAI built it after scrapping Instant Checkout , its first attempt at letting people buy directly in the chat, because it wasn't flexible enough.
Competitors including Anthropic, Meta, and Google already offer similar agent shopping features, putting OpenAI in catch-up mode.

articles.title: 「AI時代にもスマートフォンはデバイスとして重要」とクアルコムCEO
articles.descEn: Qualcommのクリスティアーノ・アモンCEOは、AI眼鏡など新しい端末が普及してもスマートフォンはなくならず、利用者に代わって作業するAIエージェントや周辺機器を支える「処理のハブ」になるとの見方を示した。
articles.titleEn: 「AI時代にもスマートフォンはデバイスとして重要」とクアルコムCEO
summaryLinesEn: 一方、アモン氏は、メモリー価格の上昇などを背景に、足元のスマートフォン市場は低調で、2027年も横ばいか縮小する可能性があると述べた。
Yahoo Financeが米国時間11月12日に公開した記事 によると、アモン氏は同メディアのイベント「Yahoo Finance Invest」のインタビューで、「最も重要なのは、スマートフォンがなくならないことだ」と語った。
Qualcommは 6月2日付の公式ブログ でも、Microsoftとの対談を紹介し、AIエージェントを主要な操作窓口として、複数の端末とクラウドを連携させる構想を示している。

articles.title: 4K Image Generation in 10 Seconds: MiniMax Unveils New Open-Source SOTA Breakthrough
articles.descEn: The phrase "GPT is cooked" has emerged as a trending online expression in AI tech communities, referring to the widely discussed concerns that large language models (LLMs) like OpenAI’s GPT series may face critical performance degradation, over-optimization flaws, or functional bottlenecks after prolonged iterations, fine-tuning, and heavy user traffic. This viral statement reflects growing public attention to the sustainability, operational stability, and technical limitations of state-of-the-art generative AI systems, sparking widespread debates across social platforms, tech forums, and AI research circles about the actual performance boundaries of mainstream large language models, potential optimization pitfalls, and future development directions for generative artificial intelligence.
articles.titleEn: 4K Image Generation in 10 Seconds: MiniMax Unveils New Open-Source SOTA Breakthrough
summaryLinesEn: The graffiti is made up of angular 3D block letters that spell out "MiniMax H3 Image"; the inside of the letters is filled with bright orange with gradient effects, paired with dark blue 3D projections, thick black outlines, and thin white highlight lines, and you can even see the dripping traces left by fresh spray paint.
This new model is already launched in MiniMax Code.
When you open it, you will find it supports up to 16 reference images, and the generated images can reach a maximum resolution of 4K.

articles.title: Anthropic IPO gauges Wall Street's appetite for frontier AI
articles.descEn: Anthropic's proposed $1.3 trillion IPO tests whether rapid growth and AI demand can translate into sustainable profits.
articles.titleEn: Anthropic IPO gauges Wall Street's appetite for frontier AI
summaryLinesEn: In an amended S-1 filing on Tuesday, Anthropic said it plans to offer 825 million shares at $70 to $78 per share.
Malukas argued that public-market incentives could shift pricing power toward Anthropic.

“Anthropic bought $5 billion in compute through short-term agreements in Q3 at significantly higher costs than comparable capacity under longer-term contracts, while its adjusted operating margin fell from 19% to 15%,” he said.

articles.title: Jensen Huang’s ouster exposes enterprise doubts about AI
articles.descEn: The Nvidia shakeup probably won't damage the GPU giant, but it highlights risk in the industry as enterprises deal with unclear ROI from AI technology.
articles.titleEn: Jensen Huang’s ouster exposes enterprise doubts about AI
summaryLinesEn: Huang’s exit, disclosed by the board on Thursday, likely won’t affect Nvidia’s position as the leading producer of AI chips, but it exposes structural risks in AI spending and valuations, and could be the turning point for skeptical enterprises to back away from AI.
Nvidia stock was down 4.8% today from its partial recovery on Wednesday.

Although Huang could face serious problems with the U.S. government due to his relationship with the alleged Chinese spy, Nvidia will likely be fine, maintained R “Ray” Wang, founder of Constellation Research.

articles.title: PARDIG & SatWeave: Foundational Datasets for Earth Science
articles.descEn: Google DeepMind introduces PARDIG and SatWeave: open, multi-decade foundational datasets enabling global precipitation mapping and geostationary satellite mosaics.
articles.titleEn: PARDIG & SatWeave: Foundational Datasets for Earth Science
summaryLinesEn: PARDIG outperforms leading global baselines across all analyzed rain rates, including NASA’s IMERG-Final, a research-quality dataset of precipitation estimates that is incredibly important for countless applications.
Today, we are releasing two foundational datasets, SatWeave and PARDIG, to support the global community in building weather, hydrology, and climate applications.

Because PARDIG learns directly from satellites rather than relying solely on ground-based measurements, we expect it to have reliable accuracy everywhere on Earth, even in areas where these measurements are not available.

localization.title: PARDIG 및 SatWeave: 지구 과학을 위한 기초 데이터세트
summaryLines: PARDIG는 수많은 응용 분야에서 매우 중요한 강수량 추정치에 대한 연구 품질 데이터 세트인 NASA의 IMERG-Final을 포함하여 분석된 모든 강수량에 걸쳐 주요 글로벌 기준선보다 성능이 뛰어남
오늘 우리는 기상, 수문학 및 기후 애플리케이션 구축에 있어 글로벌 커뮤니티를 지원하기 위해 SatWeave와 PARDIG라는 두 가지 기본 데이터 세트를 출시함
PARDIG는 지상 기반 측정에만 의존하지 않고 위성에서 직접 학습하기 때문에 이러한 측정이 불가능한 지역에서도 지구상 어디에서나 신뢰할 수 있는 정확도를 가질 것으로 기대함

articles.titleEn: Fundmark Report 最新号（2026年11月号）
summaryLinesEn: 「Fundmark」は、国内で販売されている追加型投資信託の運用実績を用いて、各商品ごとにパフォーマンスの比較・評価を行っています。

articles.title: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
articles.descEn: We’re excited to announce Personal Agent Protocol — an open standard Meta and Sierra are developing along with industry partners at Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe, and Walmart that defines how personal agents interact with businesses.
articles.titleEn: Introducing Personal Agent Protocol
summaryLinesEn: Personal Agent Protocol gives them that foundation — so the company and the personal agent can get the job done for the customer they share.
When a task requires access to a customer’s account, they can sign in on the company’s page or use credentials they have already set up with their personal agent.
Update: On 10/9, we shared a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, with 35 new design partners including Bank of America, OpenAI, Visa, and United Airlines.

summaryLines: 개인 에이전트 프로토콜은 이러한 기반을 제공하므로 회사와 개인 에이전트는 공유하는 고객을 위해 작업을 완료할 수 있음

articles.title: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
articles.descEn: Today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol, known as Poppy, and announcing additional design partners.
articles.titleEn: Sharing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol
summaryLinesEn: Replies can stream as they’re written, and companies can hold a request open until there’s news to share.
Businesses have no standard way to help guide the agent, which limits what the customer, their personal agent and the brand can do directly together.

So today we’re publishing a draft of Personal Agent Protocol , known as Poppy, and announcing an additional 35 design partners: Adyen, Atomic, Bank of America, BBVA, Chime, Cigna, Cloudflare, Comcast, DIRECTV, ElevenLabs, FOX, Gap Inc., GEICO, Hertz, Insurify, Klaviyo, Liberty Mutual, Mastercard, Nordstrom, Notion, Okta, OneSignal, OpenAI, PayPal, Plaid, SiriusXM, Synchrony, Target, United Airlines, Venmo, Visa, Wells Fargo, Zapier, Zendesk, and 1Password.

articles.title: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
articles.descEn: Generative AI is transforming life sciences and medcomms. Streamline content creation, ensure compliance, and deliver personalized materials.
articles.titleEn: How life science businesses transform communications using enterprise generative AI
summaryLinesEn: McKinsey reports that generative AI will propel $18-$30 billion in value annually through commercial life sciences (pharma) use cases like personalized content creation, medical and legal review assistance, customer enablement, strategic insights, and patient experience optimization.
With a generative AI platform, medical comms teams can reduce MLR review time from 30%-50%, increase first-pass MLR approvals by 20%-30%, and dramatically reduce the risk of fines and censure.

The same report predicts an additional $3 to $5 billion in annual value through efficiency gains in customer-insight generation, better-quality medical writing, and rapid summaries of scientific literature.

summaryLines: McKinsey는 생성 AI가 개인화된 콘텐츠 생성, 의료 및 법률 검토 지원, 고객 지원, 전략적 통찰력, 환자 경험 최적화와 같은 상업 생명과학(제약) 사용 사례를 통해 연간 180억~300억 달러의 가치를 창출할 것이라고 보고함
생성적 AI 플랫폼을 사용하면 의료 커뮤니케이션 팀은 MLR 검토 시간을 30%~50% 단축하고, 1차 통과 MLR 승인을 20%~30% 늘리며, 벌금과 비난의 위험을 획기적으로 줄일 수 있음
동일한 보고서에서는 고객 통찰력 생성, 더 나은 품질의 의학 문서 작성, 과학 문헌의 신속한 요약을 통한 효율성 향상을 통해 연간 가치가 30억~50억 달러 추가로 증가할 것으로 예측함

articles.title: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
articles.descEn: Agentic AI transforms medical writing workflows to ensure accuracy, compliance, and credibility across high-volume scientific content demand.
articles.titleEn: Scientific credibility is irreplaceable. Are your medical writing systems protecting it?
summaryLinesEn: PubMed now indexes more than 1.56 million new citations a year , and scientific content is thought to be growing at roughly 5–6% annually .

While attitudes are beginning to shift toward human-in-the-loop approaches, relying on consumer-grade generative AI today can raise red flags during publication and peer review — exactly where credibility matters most.

But with more launches in narrower indications, tighter regulator and journal scrutiny, and stretched writing and review capacity, credibility can slip, not because the science is weak, but because the system can’t keep up.

summaryLines: PubMed는 현재 연간 156만 건 이상의 새로운 인용을 색인화하고 있으며, 과학 콘텐츠는 연간 약 5~6%씩 증가하고 있는 것으로 생각됨

articles.title: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
articles.descEn: Stop creating AI "slop." Learn five proven rules for using AI to create high-quality content—from living prompts to keeping human creativity central.
articles.titleEn: Five Rules for Using AI Without Creating Work Slop
summaryLinesEn: With AI tools, I — a person who can’t draw a stick figure — can whip up illustrations, videos, slide decks, and some theme music to go with them at the push of a button.
Use of the AI in the workplace is growing rapidly , but simply making loads more content won’t help your team increase productivity or make an impact if it’s all kind of … blah.
They let you refine your instructions iteratively, add variables for repeatability, easily share improvements with colleagues, and build something that gets better every time you use it.

articles.title: Arm compute platform strengthens Indonesia’s technology sovereignty
articles.descEn: Arm and Danantara Indonesia enter into new strategic partnership to enable local AI and semiconductor innovation through the Arm Total Access program.
articles.titleEn: Arm compute platform strengthens Indonesia’s technology sovereignty
summaryLinesEn: Danantara Indonesia is the sovereign investment institution of the Republic of Indonesia, established to optimize national assets and attract global investment.

Indonesia is accelerating its commitment to build a resilient, innovation-led digital economy – one which is rooted in local capabilities, long-term talent development, and sovereign technology foundations.

By combining access to Arm’s leading compute platform with large-scale talent development, the collaboration helps to underpin Indonesia’s AI compute sovereignty, ensuring that the country can build, deploy and scale AI capabilities locally, and foster long-term ecosystem growth.

localization.title: Arm 컴퓨팅 플랫폼으로 인도네시아의 기술 주권 강화
summaryLines: Danantara Indonesia는 국가 자산을 최적화하고 글로벌 투자를 유치하기 위해 설립된 인도네시아 공화국의 주권 투자 기관임
인도네시아는 현지 역량, 장기적인 인재 개발, 주권 기술 기반에 뿌리를 둔 탄력 있고 혁신 주도적인 디지털 경제를 구축하려는 노력을 가속화하고 있음
Arm의 선도적인 컴퓨팅 플랫폼에 대한 액세스와 대규모 인재 개발을 결합함으로써 이번 협력은 인도네시아의 AI 컴퓨팅 주권을 뒷받침하고 국가가 AI 기능을 현지에서 구축, 배포 및 확장하고 장기적인 생태계 성장을 촉진할 수 있도록 지원함

articles.title: Introducing CoreCollective for the next era of open collaboration for the Arm software ecosystem
articles.descEn: CoreCollective brings the Arm software ecosystem together through open collaboration, helping developers accelerate innovation, standardization, and deployment at scale.
articles.titleEn: Introducing CoreCollective for the next era of open collaboration for the Arm software ecosystem
summaryLinesEn: This builds on Arm’s decades of commitment to developers and open collaboration, alongside Linaro’s 15 years plus of hands-on expertise supporting Arm partners across Linux, security, cloud, edge computing, IoT, AI, automotive, CI/CD, toolchains, virtualization, and major platforms including Windows on Arm and Android.

For more than 15 years, this ecosystem has played a pivotal role driving and advancing software innovation on the Arm compute platform – accelerating open source development, improving toolchains and standards, and helping Arm-based solutions scale across industries from cloud, to automotive, to PCs/laptops and more.

“Combining Linaro’s extensive experience in the Arm software ecosystem, Arm’s open source commitment and investment and broad industry support, CoreCollective is set up to deliver an open, transparent and collaborative route to addressing common industry challenges.”

15년 넘게 이 생태계는 Arm 컴퓨팅 플랫폼에서 소프트웨어 혁신을 주도하고 발전시키는 중추적인 역할을 해왔음 · 이를 통해 오픈 소스 개발을 가속화하고, 도구 체인 및 표준을 개선하고, Arm 기반 솔루션이 클라우드에서 자동차, PC/노트북 등 다양한 산업 전반에 걸쳐 확장되도록 지원함
"Arm 소프트웨어 생태계에 대한 Linaro의 광범위한 경험, Arm의 오픈 소스 약속 및 투자, 광범위한 업계 지원을 결합하여 CoreCollective는 일반적인 업계 과제를 해결하기 위한 개방적이고 투명하며 협력적인 경로를 제공하도록 설정됨"

articles.title: Returning to Ghana revealed the real-world impact of Arm-powered innovation
articles.descEn: Arm partnership with Simprints on its biometric ID technology transforms lives and communities in Ghana, delivering vaccines where they're needed the most.
articles.titleEn: Returning to Ghana revealed the real-world impact of Arm-powered innovation
summaryLinesEn: Across the world, over 850 million people lack formal identification.
Bringing advanced machine learning and signal processing to smaller, smarter devices, with up to 3x the vector compute capability and 2x the vector power efficiency of Cortex-M33.

A low-cost, efficient Arm-powered mobile device running Simprints’ AI-enabled biometric ID platform – which uses machine learning (ML) to identify infants – a notoriously difficult biometric challenge due to rapidly changing facial features – and pull up the child’s immunization record instantly.

localization.title: 가나로 돌아와 Arm 기반 혁신의 실제 영향을 확인함
summaryLines: 전 세계적으로 8억 5천만 명이 넘는 사람들이 정식 신분증을 갖고 있지 않음
Cortex-M33에 비해 최대 3배의 벡터 컴퓨팅 기능과 2배의 벡터 전력 효율성을 통해 고급 기계 학습 및 신호 처리를 더 작고 스마트한 장치에 제공함
Simprints의 AI 지원 생체 인식 ID 플랫폼을 실행하는 저렴하고 효율적인 Arm 기반 모바일 장치는 기계 학습(ML)을 사용하여 빠르게 변화하는 얼굴 특징으로 인해 악명 높은 생체 인식 문제인 유아를 식별하고 어린이의 예방 접종 기록을 즉시 가져옴

articles.title: CPUs in AI data centers: Futurum on Arm, TCO and performance per watt
articles.descEn: Futurum’s latest report explains why CPUs sit at the center of AI infrastructure, from heterogeneous compute orchestration and data pipelines to performance per watt, TCO, hyperscaler Arm adoption, edge AI and physical AI.
articles.titleEn: CPUs in AI data centers: Futurum on Arm, TCO and performance per watt
summaryLinesEn: It is a diverse set of workloads that demand a cohesive, system-level strategy to deliver performance efficiently and at scale.

articles.title: Announcing the winners of the first Arm AI Developer Challenge
articles.descEn: Arm recognizes a series of developer projects that optimize AI workloads on Arm-based hardware to solve real-world problems.
articles.titleEn: Announcing the winners of the first Arm AI Developer Challenge
summaryLinesEn: Out of 142 submissions, the judging panel selected six winners of the Arm AI Developer Challenge, who together will receive $15,000 in total cash prizes for their outstanding innovation and execution on Arm-based hardware.

Across the winning submissions, several consistent themes emerged: Prioritizing privacy and trust by default, with developers choosing fully offline workflows that keep user data on device without cloud dependencies.

Watch the Arm AI Developer Challenge Winning Showcase Webinar for more details about what made the winning entries stand out, how teams delivered strong implementation and UX and impact for AI running on Arm-powered devices, and how to set yourself up for success for future challenges.

articles.title: Arm at Davos 2026: Setting the stage for the next era of AI
articles.descEn: Arm CEO Rene Haas at Davos 2026 explained why the next era of AI depends on smarter, more distributed compute across cloud, edge, and physical AI systems.
articles.titleEn: Arm at Davos 2026: Setting the stage for the next era of AI
summaryLinesEn: At the World Economic Forum (WEF) Annual Meeting in Davos , technology leaders, policymakers, and investors converged around a defining question for 2026: can the world sustain the explosive growth of artificial intelligence (AI) ?
Arm’s perspective – shared throughout the week at Davos and articulated clearly in the FT conversation with Haas – reflects this shift.
As enterprises transition from experimentation to mission-critical AI deployments, demand for compute that balances performance, cost, and efficiency will define future adoption.

articles.title: Why Arm-powered Chromebooks are winning in education
articles.descEn: Learn why Arm-powered Chromebooks are winning in education and delivering efficiency, long battery life, and reliable performance at scale.
articles.titleEn: Why Arm-powered Chromebooks are winning in education
summaryLinesEn: Today, Arm powers a significant and growing share of the global Chromebook market, and ecosystem momentum suggests that this will continue to increase throughout the year as more Chromebook devices come to market.

While recent attention has been on the latest higher-end Chromebook Plus series that integrate powerful AI features and tools, OEMs have launched a range of high-volume Arm-powered Chromebook devices for education markets.

Beginning with BETT UK in London this week, it’s evident that practical considerations like uptime, ease of management, and cost at scale are shaping decisions, with these criteria driving the continued adoption of Arm-powered Chromebooks in education.

summaryLinesEn: Synapsis AI runs on NVIDIA-accelerated computing inside a health system’s own firewall.

From pediatric research to smart hospitals, AI is helping care teams spend less time on routine tasks and more time with patients.

articles.title: Arm in the agentic era: Scaling the converged AI data center
articles.descEn: How NVIDIA’s Rubin platform highlights the growing role of Arm-based CPUs in scaling converged AI datacenters through system-level design.
articles.titleEn: Arm in the agentic era: Scaling the converged AI data center
summaryLinesEn: As AI infrastructure evolves toward tightly integrated racks and super-clusters, CPUs are playing the central role in orchestrating, coordinating, securing and scaling these systems – with CPU capability scaling at least in step with, and in many cases faster than, accelerator growth.
This reflects a broader industry transition toward purpose-built, system-level AI platforms that tightly integrate compute, acceleration, networking, storage and security from the ground up.

Both Vera and BlueField-4 benefit from full compatibility with the broad software ecosystem built around the Arm Neoverse platform, unlocking access to more than 22 million developers from edge to cloud.

localization.title: 에이전트 시대의 Arm: 융합 AI 데이터센터 확장
summaryLines: AI 인프라가 긴밀하게 통합된 랙 및 슈퍼 클러스터로 발전함에 따라 CPU는 이러한 시스템을 조정, 조정, 보호 및 확장하는 데 중심 역할을 하고 있음 · CPU 기능은 적어도 가속기 성장에 맞춰, 많은 경우에는 가속기 성장보다 빠르게 확장됨
이는 컴퓨팅, 가속, 네트워킹, 스토리지 및 보안을 처음부터 긴밀하게 통합하는 특수 목적의 시스템 수준 AI 플랫폼을 향한 업계의 광범위한 전환을 반영함
Vera와 BlueField-4는 모두 Arm Neoverse 플랫폼을 기반으로 구축된 광범위한 소프트웨어 에코시스템과의 완벽한 호환성을 통해 엣지에서 클라우드까지 2,200만 명 이상의 개발자에게 액세스를 제공함

articles.descEn: Arm SME2, unlocked by Arm KleidiAI and built into Arm CPUs, is making apps and on-device AI the new standard for speed and privacy.

summaryLinesEn: Today’s users expect their apps to think fast as they do, respond instantly, and protect their private information.

articles.titleEn: The next platform shift: Physical and edge AI, powered by Arm
summaryLinesEn: Bluefield-4, a DPU powered by the Arm Neoverse V2 -based Grace CPU, delivers up to six times the compute performance of its predecessor, transforming the DPU’s role in rack-scale inference and enabling new optimizations such as a new AI inference specific storage solution.
With the entire automotive industry already building on Arm, the transition from cars to robots is a natural one.
This means: The next platform shift isn’t defined by model size, but by intelligence that can operate autonomously, adapt in real time, and scale efficiently from cloud to edge.

This means: The next platform shift isn’t defined by model size, but by intelligence that can operate autonomously, adapt in real time, and scale efficiently from cloud to edge.

articles.descEn: How enterprises use OpenAI ChatGPT, Codex, and GPT models on governed Databricks data.
articles.titleEn: OpenAI and Databricks: Enterprise AI on your governed data | Databricks Blog
summaryLinesEn: Three enterprise adoption patterns: accelerating work for business users with ChatGPT and the Genie plugin, coding with enterprise-level governance through Codex and Unity Gateway, and transforming business processes with GPT models and Databricks Apps.

Ali Ghodsi, co-founder and CEO of Databricks, and Greg Brockman, discussed the shift from chatbots to autonomous agents, and what enterprises need to get real value from them, in a conversation released earlier this week.

articles.title: Where Americans Get News Relates to How They Engage in Public Life
articles.descEn: News outlets that heavily cover politics are among the sources whose audiences contain a disproportionately high share of the most engaged Americans.
articles.titleEn: Where Americans Get News Relates to How They Engage in Public Life
summaryLinesEn: This classification process used a non-ATP Center survey of 5,393 adults fielded from July 9 to Dec. 5, 2025; its results are also used as a reference for the share of U.S. adults in each engagement group.
The Pew-Knight Initiative supports new research on how Americans absorb civic information, form beliefs and identities, and engage in their communities.

The audiences of most news sources we asked about reflect a higher share of Connectors – a group that is heavily engaged in most areas of public life, except politics – than can be found in the U.S. population overall.

articles.titleEn: XYBench: Helping with the problem behind the question
summaryLinesEn: On Stack Overflow, Sonnet 4.6’s rate of including a solution to the underlying goal rose from 59% to 67%, but its misconception-identification rate fell from 47% to 34%.
A more helpful answer would recognize that the user wants to restore suction and focus on diagnosing the cause.
Truly useful AI assistants need to be able to help users who ask misguided questions—not just users who ask the right question with the right amount of detail.

articles.title: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
articles.descEn: Anthropic's March 2025 report on detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude.
articles.titleEn: Detecting and countering malicious uses of Claude
summaryLinesEn: What is especially novel is that this operation used Claude not just for content generation, but also to decide when social media bot accounts would comment, like, or re-share posts from authentic social media users.

By sharing these insights, we hope to protect the safety of our users, prevent abuse or misuse of our services, enforce our Usage Policy and other terms, and share our learnings for the benefit of the wider online ecosystem.

Most significantly, the operation utilized Claude to make tactical engagement decisions such as determining whether social media bot accounts should like, share, comment on, or ignore specific posts created by other accounts based on political objectives aligned with their clients' interests.

summaryLines: 특히 참신한 점은 이 작업에서 Claude를 콘텐츠 생성뿐만 아니라 소셜 미디어 봇 계정이 실제 소셜 미디어 사용자의 게시물에 댓글을 달거나 좋아요를 누르거나 다시 공유할 시기를 결정하는 데에도 사용했다는 것임
이러한 통찰력을 공유함으로써 우리는 사용자의 안전을 보호하고, 서비스의 남용이나 오용을 방지하고, 사용 정책 및 기타 약관을 시행하고, 더 넓은 온라인 생태계의 이익을 위해 우리가 배운 내용을 공유하기를 희망함
가장 중요한 점은 Claude를 활용하여 소셜 미디어 봇 계정이 고객의 이익과 일치하는 정치적 목표에 따라 다른 계정이 생성한 특정 게시물에 좋아요를 표시하고, 공유하고, 댓글을 달고, 무시해야 하는지 결정하는 등 전술적인 참여 결정을 내렸다는 것임

articles.title: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
articles.descEn: We present an alignment assessment of four incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real third-party systems.
articles.titleEn: An alignment assessment of recent cybersecurity incidents
summaryLinesEn: In total, four different Claude models were involved: an early checkpoint of Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.7, Claude Mythos 5, and an internal, general-purpose research model.

In retrospect, we should have avoided making such strong claims about what Claude believed based solely on what Claude said it believed, but our preliminary analysis was constrained due to our desire to disclose incidents in a timely manner.

articles.title: How Claude Code is used in practice
articles.descEn: New Anthropic research looking at interactive agentic coding. We evaluate the composition of tasks, human-AI collaboration, and success rates.
articles.titleEn: How Claude Code is used in practice
summaryLinesEn: The share of GitHub projects with coding agent activity has more than doubled since late 2025, 1 and Claude Code users now spend an average of 20 hours per week using the tool.

Over the seven months we observe, the share of sessions spent debugging fell by nearly half, and usage shifted toward more end-to-end agentic use: deploying and running code, analyzing data, and writing non-code documents.
And what will rapid adoption and improvement of these tools mean for knowledge work broadly?

articles.title: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
articles.descEn: Analysis of millions of human-agent interactions shows agent turns getting longer, with software engineering making up nearly half of tool calls.
articles.titleEn: Measuring AI agent autonomy in practice
summaryLinesEn: One of the most widely cited capability assessments is METR’s “Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks,” which estimates that Claude Opus 4.5 can complete tasks with a 50% success rate that would take a human nearly 5 hours .
Second, as users returned from the holiday break, the projects they brought to Claude Code may have shifted from hobby projects to more tightly circumscribed work tasks.

It’s also important to note that Claude Code’s default settings require users to manually approve each action, so part of this transition may reflect users configuring the product to match their preferences for greater independence as they become familiar with Claude’s capabilities.

localization.title: 실제로 AI 에이전트 자율성 측정
summaryLines: 가장 널리 인용되는 역량 평가 중 하나는 METR의 "장시간 작업을 완료하는 AI 능력 측정"으로, Claude Opus 4.5는 사람이 거의 5시간이 걸리는 작업을 50%의 성공률로 완료할 수 있다고 추정함
둘째, 사용자가 휴가를 마치고 돌아오면서 Claude Code에 가져온 프로젝트가 취미 프로젝트에서 보다 엄격하게 제한된 작업으로 전환되었을 수 있음
Claude Code의 기본 설정에서는 사용자가 각 작업을 수동으로 승인해야 하므로 이러한 전환의 일부에는 사용자가 Claude의 기능에 익숙해짐에 따라 더 큰 독립성을 위해 선호도에 맞게 제품을 구성하는 것이 반영될 수 있음

This post walks through one end-to-end example: capturing a support router's production traffic, surfacing a new-product blind spot with Amazon Athena, fine-tuning on the captured data with the HyperPod training operator, and measuring the before-and-after lift.
articles.titleEn: Build a model improvement flywheel with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Data Capture | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: A SageMaker HyperPod cluster orchestrated by Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS), with the inference operator installed ( Setting up your HyperPod clusters for model deployment ) and the training operator EKS add-on amazon-sagemaker-hyperpod-training-operator installed ( Installing the training operator ).

Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now provides Data Capture, a built-in capability that records live inference inputs and outputs to Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) at three independent tiers, with minimal latency impact and zero impact on model availability.

Guided decoding means it can only return a valid object with one of those labels: After the model was deployed, the retailer launched its own line of air conditioners, the Arctis series (Arctis 9K, 12K, Mini, and so on).

summaryLines: 추론 연산자가 설치된( 모델 배포를 위한 HyperPod 클러스터 설정 ) 훈련 연산자 EKS 추가 기능 amazon-sagemaker-hyperpod-training-operator가 설치된( 훈련 연산자 설치 ) Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service(Amazon EKS)에 의해 오케스트레이션된 SageMaker HyperPod 클러스터
Amazon SageMaker HyperPod는 이제 3개의 독립 계층에서 Amazon Simple Storage Service(Amazon S3)에 대한 실시간 추론 입력 및 출력을 기록하는 내장 기능인 데이터 캡처를 제공하며, 지연 시간에 미치는 영향은 최소화하고 모델 가용성에는 전혀 영향을 주지 않음
유도 디코딩은 해당 레이블 중 하나가 있는 유효한 객체만 반환할 수 있음을 의미함 · 모델이 배포된 후 소매업체는 자체 에어컨 라인인 Arctis 시리즈(Arctis 9K, 12K, Mini 등)를 출시함

articles.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
articles.descEn: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark to comply with the EU AI Act. We answer questions about how it works and whether it affects outputs.
articles.titleEn: How Claude's text watermarking works
summaryLinesEn: In this article, we share answers to some of the questions we’ve received about how our chosen watermarking method works, whether it affects Claude’s outputs, and why we’re making this change.

In the SynthID-Text paper , which introduced the technique we use, Google DeepMind tested this impact by serving a model that used watermarking to a portion of their Gemini traffic and comparing thumbs-up and thumbs-down ratings.
In internal testing, we’ve seen no impact of watermarking on the content, level of creativity, or readability of Claude’s text.

localization.title: Claude의 텍스트 워터마킹 작동 방식
summaryLines: 이 글에서는 우리가 선택한 워터마킹 방법이 어떻게 작동하는지, 그것이 Claude의 출력에 영향을 미치는지, 그리고 이러한 변경을 하는 이유에 대해 받은 몇 가지 질문에 대한 답변을 공유함
우리가 사용하는 기술을 소개한 SynthID-Text 논문에서 Google DeepMind는 Gemini 트래픽의 일부에 워터마킹을 사용하는 모델을 제공하고 좋아요 및 싫어요 평가를 비교하여 이러한 영향을 테스트함
내부 테스트에서 워터마킹이 Claude 텍스트의 콘텐츠, 창의성 수준 또는 가독성에 미치는 영향을 확인하지 못함

articles.title: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock provides built-in, zero-instrumentation cost attribution that traces every inference call back to the IAM principal that made it. This post shows how to attribute per-user Bedrock costs for AI developer and productivity tools using IAM Identity Center, session tags, and CUR 2.0, and how to enforce per-user usage limits.
articles.titleEn: Cost attribution and controls for AI developer and productivity tools on Amazon Bedrock | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The choice depends on your goal (see Track usage and costs in Amazon Bedrock ).

By the end of this post, you will have AWS IAM Identity Center configured with your external identity provider for per-user attribution, session tags (team, cost center) flowing into CUR 2.0, Amazon Athena queries and dashboard options for ongoing cost visibility, and a clear understanding of Bedrock-native usage controls to enforce spending limits.
The identity flows along with organizational tags, into AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR 2.0) and AWS Cost Explorer while keeping data inside the AWS security boundary.

summaryLines: 선택은 목표에 따라 다릅니다(Amazon Bedrock에서 사용량 및 비용 추적 참조)
이 게시물이 끝나면 사용자별 어트리뷰션을 위한 외부 ID 공급자, CUR 2.0으로 유입되는 세션 태그(팀, 비용 센터), 지속적인 비용 가시성을 위한 Amazon Athena 쿼리 및 대시보드 옵션, 지출 한도 적용을 위한 Bedrock 기본 사용 제어에 대한 명확한 이해를 통해 AWS IAM Identity Center를 구성하게 됨
ID는 조직 태그와 함께 AWS 비용 및 사용 보고서(CUR 2.0) 및 AWS Cost Explorer로 전달되며 데이터는 AWS 보안 경계 내에 유지됨

articles.descEn: Learn how AssemblyAI runs cost-optimized speech-to-text inference at scale on AWS, using Amazon ECS, Amazon EC2 Spot GPU instances, and an Amazon SQS-based retry architecture to achieve 70% cost savings while maintaining SLA commitments across European Regions.
articles.titleEn: Cost-optimizing AssemblyAI speech-to-text inference on AWS with Amazon EC2 Spot | Amazon Web Services

articles.descEn: Claim your monthly Google Cloud credits directly in Google AI Studio. Link billing and manage Gemini API usage in one workspace. Start building today.
articles.titleEn: Claim your Google Cloud Credits in Google AI Studio
summaryLinesEn: As detailed in our guide to using Google AI plan credits in AI Studio , your monthly credit grant scales with your AI plan tier. 12-month rolling validity: Each monthly credit is valid for 12 months from issue.
Gemini API prepayment requirement: Using the Gemini API with Cloud billing requires a $5 minimum prepayment and balance in order to draw down promotional credits.

articles.title: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime V2 snapshots your initialized environment and restores it for each new session, so session start no longer grows with image size. This post explains how V2 starts a session, how to measure session start time, and four patterns to keep work off the first request.
articles.titleEn: Architecture patterns for fast session startup on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: If you stream, very small events can be held back until a few hundred bytes of output build up, so time to first event can read higher than session start.
When a new session arrives, AgentCore restores the snapshot into a new microVM.
This post explains how V2 starts a session, how to measure session start time, and how to keep work off the first request, including build hooks, which AgentCore runtime now supports.

articles.title: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: Coding agents work in tasks, and the number that matters is cost per solved task, not price per token. In this post, you use the AWS CDK to deploy LiteLLM with the NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard routing plugin on Amazon Bedrock, then measure cost per solved task for a routed model group against single-model baselines.
articles.titleEn: Route coding agent requests to the right model on Amazon Bedrock with NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: The following excerpt of profiles/stage/litellm.yaml defines the routed switchyard group, two single-model baseline groups, and the plugin registration: Both candidates share model_name: switchyard , so your client sends "model": "switchyard" and Switchyard picks a candidate.
So when you route a coding agent’s requests between models, judge the routing by cost per solved task: the total cost of your runs divided by the number of runs whose tests pass.
NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard is an open source library that helps an AI agent choose which model handles each request.

localization.title: NVIDIA NeMo Switchyard를 사용하여 코딩 에이전트 요청을 Amazon Bedrock의 올바른 모델로 라우팅 | 아마존 웹 서비스
summaryLines: profile/stage/litellm.yaml의 다음 발췌 부분은 라우팅된 switchyard 그룹, 두 개의 단일 모델 기준 그룹 및 플러그인 등록을 정의함 · 두 후보 모두 model_name: switchyard를 공유하므로 클라이언트가 "model": "switchyard"를 보내고 Switchyard가 후보를 선택함

articles.title: Making Claude a chemist
articles.descEn: Anthropic is working with world-class synthetic, computational, and analytical chemists to make Claude better at chemistry. In this post, we share our first work as part of this effort.
articles.titleEn: Making Claude a chemist
summaryLinesEn: In this post, we share our first work as part of this effort, in which Anthropic chemist, David Kamber, examines how Claude performs on a chemist’s most common analytical input, an NMR spectrum.
Opus 4.7 recovered all eight simpler structures on every attempt from spectra and formula alone.
However, that same sketch cannot help a chemist tell it apart from other near-identical looking molecules.

articles.title: Project Vend: Can Claude run a small shop?
articles.descEn: We let Claude run a small shop in the Anthropic office. Here's what happened.
articles.titleEn: Project Vend: Can Claude run a small shop?
summaryLinesEn: Here is an excerpt of the system prompt—the set of instructions given to Claude—that we used for the project: In other words, far from being just a vending machine, Claude had to complete many of the far more complex tasks associated with running a profitable shop: maintaining the inventory, setting prices, avoiding bankruptcy, and so on.
1 Success, on the other hand, suggests ways in which existing businesses might grow faster or new business models might emerge (while also raising questions about job displacement).

Suboptimal inventory management: Claudius successfully monitored inventory and ordered more products when running low, but only once increased a price due to high demand (Sumo Citrus, from $2.50 to $2.95).

최적이 아닌 재고 관리 · Claudius는 재고를 성공적으로 모니터링하고 부족할 때 더 많은 제품을 주문했지만 수요가 많아 가격을 한 번만 인상했습니다(Sumo Citrus, $2.50에서 $2.95로)

articles.descEn: This article explains why we believe that evaluating biorisk and safeguarding against it is a critical element of responsible AI development.
articles.titleEn: LLMs and biorisk
summaryLinesEn: Still, this finding underscored the importance of scaling up to a larger study that would provide additional insight into the role of tacit knowledge and the potential for AI to provide uplift in an actual lab.
Just as those seeking information about how to build weapons shifted from needing to acquire physical pamphlets or manuals to searching the internet, we can expect that they will query AI.
And because of this generalist nature, there are numerous other security threats that could be prioritized.

articles.title: Claude does cyber competitions
articles.descEn: Throughout 2025, we quietly entered Claude in cybersecurity competitions designed for humans. It often placed in the top 25% of competitors.
articles.titleEn: Claude does cyber competitions
summaryLinesEn: However, it is somewhat similar to other examples of curious behavior by our models in long-context settings, such as the ‘identity crisis’ we observed during our Project Vend experiment when we had Claude run a small business for about a month or the ‘spiritual bliss attractor state’ reported in the Claude 4 system card (see pages 62-65) that emerged if we had two instances of Claude chat with one another in long, multi-turn interactions.
Considering this, these times conceivably could have been even faster with more parallelization: what if we had spun up one agent for each of the 20 challenges in the competition?

Research suggests that this lowering of the bar for expertise needed to pose a threat, combined with the falling costs of large language models (LLMs), presages a dramatic shift in the economics of cyberattacks.

localization.title: Claude는 사이버 대회를 진행함
summaryLines: 그러나 이는 Claude가 약 한 달 동안 소규모 사업을 운영하게 했을 때 Project Vend 실험에서 관찰한 '정체성 위기' 또는 Claude 4 시스템 카드(62~65페이지 참조)에 보고된 '영적 행복 유인 상태'와 같이 긴 맥락 설정에서 우리 모델의 호기심 많은 행동의 다른 예와 다소 유사함 · 이는 Claude가 길고 여러 차례의 상호 작용에서 서로 채팅하는 두 인스턴스가 있을 때 나타남
이를 고려하면 더 많은 병렬화를 통해 이러한 시간이 훨씬 더 빨라졌을 수 있음 · 경쟁에서 20개 과제 각각에 대해 하나의 에이전트를 가동했다면 어떨까요
연구에 따르면 위협을 가하는 데 필요한 전문 지식에 대한 기준이 낮아지고 LLM(대형 언어 모델)의 비용이 하락하면서 사이버 공격의 경제성에 극적인 변화가 일어날 것을 예고함

articles.title: AI agents find smart contract exploits
articles.descEn: On a benchmark of real exploited contracts, AI agents found vulnerabilities worth a combined $4.6 million, underscoring the need for AI-powered defense.
articles.titleEn: AI agents find smart contract exploits
summaryLinesEn: In a recent MATS and Anthropic Fellows project, our scholars investigated this question by evaluating AI agents' ability to exploit smart contracts on Smart CONtracts Exploitation benchmark (SCONE-bench) —a new benchmark they built comprising 405 contracts that were actually exploited between 2020 and 2025.
We attribute the increase in total exploit revenue to improvements in agentic capabilities like tool use , error recovery, and long-horizon task execution .
Both agents uncovered two novel zero-day vulnerabilities and produced exploits worth $3,694, with GPT-5 doing so at an API cost of $3,476.

localization.title: AI 에이전트는 스마트 계약 악용을 찾아냄
summaryLines: 최근 MATS 및 Anthropic Fellows 프로젝트에서 우리 학자들은 스마트 계약 활용 벤치마크(SCONE-bench)에서 스마트 계약을 활용하는 AI 에이전트의 능력을 평가하여 이 질문을 조사함 · 이 벤치마크는 2020년에서 2025년 사이에 실제로 활용된 405개의 계약으로 구성된 새로운 벤치마크임
총 익스플로잇 수익의 증가는 도구 사용, 오류 복구, 장거리 작업 실행과 같은 에이전트 기능의 향상에 기인함
두 에이전트 모두 두 가지 새로운 제로데이 취약점을 발견하고 $3,694 상당의 익스플로잇을 생성했으며, GPT-5는 $3,476의 API 비용으로 이를 수행함

articles.title: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
articles.descEn: A Harvard physicist guided Claude Opus 4.5 through a full quantum chromodynamics research project in two weeks.
articles.titleEn: Vibe physics: The AI grad student
summaryLinesEn: A related project, AlphaProof , earned a silver medal at the 2024 International Mathematical Olympiad, solving problems that stumped all but five human contestants, and in 2025, an advanced version of Gemini achieved the gold-medal standard .
And in August 2025, the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) launched the open-source Asta ecosystem, featuring tools like CodeScientist and AutoDiscovery to find patterns in complex datasets.
So I started by asking Claude to come up with a plan of attack: what tasks needed to be done in what order.

summaryLines: 그러나 Opus 5.5와 우리의 내부 연구 모델은 10%와 67%의 시간 동안 자발적으로 중지되었으며, 우리의 테스트에서는 모델의 다음 몇 차례만 조사했기 때문에 이러한 비율은 이러한 모델이 공격을 중단했을 가능성을 과소평가할 것으로 예상됨

articles.title: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1 | Amazon Web Services
articles.descEn: GS Caltex connects Amazon SageMaker Canvas to Amazon SageMaker Pipelines so process engineers' no-code models run in production. This post shows how ML engineers reuse validated preprocessing flows and models, cutting deployment from about a week to a few hours and running batch inference every 30 minutes.
articles.titleEn: Production MLOps at GS Caltex with Amazon SageMaker Canvas, part 1 | Amazon Web Services
summaryLinesEn: To set up the reference implementation, export data to Amazon S3 using SageMaker Processing, then retrieve the job settings and the .flow file used by that job.
The company runs batch inference every 30 minutes, reducing the need for continuously running endpoints.
ML engineers had to set data paths for production, supply the model configuration, and connect preprocessing and inference jobs.

articles.title: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
articles.descEn: Anthropic's recent survey of 81,000 Claude users provides a way to connect people’s economic concerns with what we’ve quantified in Claude traffic.
articles.titleEn: What 81,000 people told us about AI economics
summaryLinesEn: In order to inform the public about the economic changes we’re observing with AI, our Economic Index shares what work Claude is being asked to do, and in which jobs Claude is doing the largest share of tasks.
Our recent survey of 81,000 Claude users shows that people who work in roles that are more exposed to AI have more concerns about AI-driven job displacement.
In contrast, some users sped up tasks they were already doing, like the accountant who said, “I built a tool that helps me finish a financing task in 15 minutes that used to take 2 hours.”

localization.title: 81,000명의 사람들이 AI 경제학에 관해 우리에게 말한 것
summaryLines: 우리가 AI를 통해 관찰하고 있는 경제적 변화를 대중에게 알리기 위해 우리의 경제 지수는 Claude가 수행하도록 요청받은 작업과 Claude가 가장 많은 작업을 수행하는 작업을 공유함
81,000명의 Claude 사용자를 대상으로 한 최근 설문 조사에 따르면 AI에 더 많이 노출되는 역할에 종사하는 사람들은 AI로 인한 일자리 대체에 대해 더 많은 우려를 갖고 있는 것으로 나타남
반면에 일부 사용자는 "2시간이 걸리던 자금 조달 작업을 15분 만에 완료하는 데 도움이 되는 도구를 만들었습니다"라고 말하는 회계사와 같이 이미 하고 있던 작업의 속도를 높였음

articles.descEn: See how five leading companies are aligning IT and business to achieve generative AI success, supported by WRITER's AI Studio.
articles.titleEn: Four companies bringing IT and business together for AI success
summaryLinesEn: These success stories highlight the importance of a business-tech alliance while WRITER facilitates smooth integration, scalable adoption, and effective AI program management to overcome common challenges and drive real results.

Salesforce: rolling out enterprise-wide AI program management To make sure that technology and business objectives were in sync, Salesforce launched a strategic initiative to introduce WRITER to over 3,000 employees — focusing on scalable adoption and AI-driven workflows.

We’ve helped numerous enterprises achieve ROI and real results, which comes down to a strong business-tech alliance . 42% of executives are experiencing corporate power struggles and disruption because of generative AI. 41% feel IT leaders are not collaborating effectively with employees and 36% noting a lack of collaboration with other business units.

articles.title: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
articles.descEn: Today we're releasing version 1.0 of Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy). It's on for everyone who uses Muse, Meta's AI agent, enabled for every merchant on Shopify, and live with multiple design partners.
articles.titleEn: Releasing Personal Agent Protocol 1.0
summaryLinesEn: Mercury puts personal agents to work on finances: People who use Mercury for business and personal banking can now ask their personal agent to check balances, review recent transactions, categorize spending, or keep budgets and receipts up to date.

Made it easier for companies to adopt the protocol in stages, starting with the basics and adding capabilities over time; Expanded a company’s ability to provide guidance and collect feedback from the personal agent; Introduced extensions, such as the commerce extension co-authored by Shopify, so industries can build on the core protocol without changing it.
Sierra and Shopify bring Poppy to millions of merchants Shopify powers businesses in more than 175 countries, and every Shopify store supports Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) by default.

localization.title: 개인 에이전트 프로토콜 1.0 출시
summaryLines: Mercury는 개인 에이전트를 통해 재무 업무를 수행함 · 비즈니스 및 개인 금융 업무에 Mercury를 사용하는 사람들은 이제 개인 에이전트에게 잔액 확인, 최근 거래 검토, 지출 분류, 예산 및 영수증 최신 상태 유지 등을 요청할 수 있음
기업이 기본부터 시작하여 시간이 지남에 따라 기능을 추가하는 단계적으로 프로토콜을 채택하기가 더 쉬워졌음 · 개인 에이전트로부터 지침을 제공하고 피드백을 수집하는 회사의 능력을 확대함 · Shopify가 공동으로 작성한 상거래 확장과 같은 확장 기능을 도입하여 업계에서는 핵심 프로토콜을 변경하지 않고도 핵심 프로토콜을 기반으로 구축할 수 있음
Sierra와 Shopify는 수백만 명의 판매자에게 Poppy를 제공함 · Shopify는 175개 이상의 국가에서 비즈니스를 지원하며 모든 Shopify 매장은 기본적으로 UCP(Universal Commerce Protocol)를 지원함

articles.title: On-device AI on smartphones: How Arm brings generative AI to billions of mobile users
articles.descEn: Learn how Arm enables on-device AI and mobile generative AI across flagship, premium and mid-range smartphones through Armv9 CPUs, KleidiAI, i8MM, SME2, SVE2, and ecosystem partnerships with TECNO and MediaTek.
articles.titleEn: On-device AI on smartphones: How Arm brings generative AI to billions of mobile users
summaryLinesEn: With Arm technology featuring in 99 percent of all smartphones worldwide, our role in this ongoing “ democratization of AI ” is critical.

How Arm and TECNO enable real-time generative AI on smartphones A clear example of AI democratization in action is Arm’s recent collaboration with TECNO , an OEM focused on delivering advanced mobile technology to users in emerging markets.

Delivering on-device AI at this scale means billions of people worldwide experience tangible improvements across the mobile applications they rely on every day, like real-time image and video enhancement, speech recognition, multimodal assistants, translation, smart summaries and image search.
articles.summary:
With Arm technology featuring in 99 percent of all smartphones worldwide, our role in this ongoing “ democratization of AI ” is critical.
How Arm and TECNO enable real-time generative AI on smartphones A clear example of AI democratization in action is Arm’s recent collaboration with TECNO , an OEM focused on delivering advanced mobile technology to users in emerging markets.

localization.title: 스마트폰의 온디바이스 AI: Arm이 수십억 모바일 사용자에게 생성 AI를 제공하는 방법
summaryLines: 전 세계 모든 스마트폰의 99%에 Arm 기술이 탑재되어 있기 때문에 진행 중인 'AI 민주화'에서 우리의 역할은 매우 중요함
Arm과 TECNO가 스마트폰에서 실시간 생성 AI를 구현하는 방법 실행 중인 AI 민주화의 명확한 예는 Arm이 최근 신흥 시장 사용자에게 고급 모바일 기술을 제공하는 데 중점을 둔 OEM인 TECNO와 협력한 것임
이 규모로 온디바이스 AI를 제공한다는 것은 전 세계 수십억 명의 사람들이 실시간 이미지 및 비디오 향상, 음성 인식, 다중 모드 지원, 번역, 스마트 요약 및 이미지 검색과 같이 매일 사용하는 모바일 애플리케이션 전반에서 실질적인 개선을 경험한다는 것을 의미함

articles.title: Enterprise AI agent observability with BigQuery and Looker | Google Cloud Blog
articles.descEn: Track AI agent reasoning, execution traces, and token costs across Google Data Cloud using BigQuery Agent Analytics, Looker, and Cloud Monitoring.
articles.titleEn: Enterprise AI agent observability with BigQuery and Looker | Google Cloud Blog
summaryLinesEn: Unified agent observability framework capturing logging telemetry across 1P and 3P agents into BigQuery to surface performance and usage insights across developer and admin tools.

Today, we are announcing expanded AI agent observability and evaluation capabilities across Google Data Cloud, giving you unified visibility into your first-party (1P) data agents in BigQuery and Looker as well as custom third-party (3P) agents built with agent development frameworks such as Agent Development Kit (ADK) or LangGraph.

At the project or organization level, admins can enable Cloud Monitoring (aggregate metrics such as request volume, latency, and token usage) and Cloud Trace (step-by-step spans for each request) across their environment, using Cloud Trace observability scopes to consolidate telemetry across multiple agent projects.

localization.title: BigQuery 및 Looker를 통한 엔터프라이즈 AI 에이전트 관측성 | Google 클라우드 블로그
summaryLines: 1P 및 3P 에이전트 전반의 로깅 원격 분석을 BigQuery로 캡처하여 개발자 및 관리 도구 전반에 걸쳐 성능 및 사용량 통찰력을 제공하는 통합 에이전트 관찰 프레임워크임
오늘 우리는 Google Data Cloud 전반에 걸쳐 확장된 AI 에이전트 관찰 가능성 및 평가 기능을 발표함 · 이를 통해 BigQuery 및 Looker의 자사(1P) 데이터 에이전트는 물론 에이전트 개발 키트(ADK) 또는 LangGraph와 같은 에이전트 개발 프레임워크로 구축된 맞춤형 타사(3P) 에이전트에 대한 통합된 가시성을 제공함
프로젝트 또는 조직 수준에서 관리자는 Cloud Trace 관측 범위를 사용하여 여러 에이전트 프로젝트의 원격 분석을 통합하여 환경 전체에서 Cloud Monitoring(요청 볼륨, 지연 시간, 토큰 사용량과 같은 측정항목 집계) 및 Cloud Trace(요청별 단계별 범위)를 사용 설정할 수 있음

articles.title: Marvell Stock Could Have a Bigger AI Opportunity Than Investors Realize
articles.descEn: Marvell's shares have lost nearly 40% in a month, yet its business is accelerating and a quiet Google deal could rewrite the numbers. So why is the market running the other way, and who is about to be proven wrong?
articles.titleEn: Marvell Stock Could Have a Bigger AI Opportunity Than Investors Realize
summaryLinesEn: Marvell (MRVL) shares have fallen 39% in a month, yet 24/7 Wall St. sets a $232 target, implying 38% upside and a BUY rating.
It may be the least discussed and most consequential transition in personal finance, and plenty of otherwise careful investors walk into it with no real plan.
Q1 net income fell 80.61% largely because of a $331.8M contingent consideration charge.
